'go brjod/ lha dar dkar po/raṭā dkar 'o ma'i mtsho gter las 'khrungs mdzes sdug chu skyes bzhad pa'i steng / /ras mdzes brgyad dang brgyad kyi lang tsho shel gyi lcug phran gzhon nu bzhin/ /ra5 'byams shes bya'i zab gnas rjen pa rgyud mangs gdangs su ston mdzad pa'i/ /ras mdzes yid 'ong ngang pa'i bu mos shes rab sgron me'i snang ba ཿ6pa/ /de yang 〈g.yuspatsho'i dril chung 〉zhes pa'i snyan deb 'di yi rtsom pa po ye shes dge legs ni/ sdod kyi bkod pas mtho ris dga' tshal la skyengs pa ster zhing /bcud kyi skye bos nam mkha'i skar tshogs kyi grangs la 'khu ba'i mtho zhing brjid pa'i sa mtho'i yul yar 'brog ste/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs par grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi yi ya gyal g.yu mtsho sgeg mo'i nye 'dabs su 'jig rten khams kyi ltad mor byon/ dgung grangs bcu gsum bar skyid sdug spelama'i 'tsho ba la rol zhing / de rjes dgung grangs bcu drug son pa'i skabs thub bstan ra smad dgon pa'i chos sgor zhugs te/ nges pa don gyi dge ba'i bshesaganyen dam pa dpal 'byor ye shes mchog gi zhabs pad gtsug tu bsten 1

cing / thun mong phyi nang gi sngon 'gro dang / spyod 'jug chen mo/ rgyal sras lag len/ bshes springs/ sum rtags dag gsum sogs la sbyang brtson lhod med mdzad/ dgung grangs bco brgyad du son skabs spobs nyams ldan pa'i ngang snyan ngag gi gar stegs thog zhugs shing / ma bcos sems kyi gsang gtam snyan rtsom gyi lam nas snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i glu dbyangs gyer 'go tshugs/ smyug 'dzin pa'i khrod du khong la rig pa'i rlung gzhon zhes pa'i ming yang thogs/ khong gi snyan rtsom brjodabya zab cing yul dus dang 'tshams pa/ rjod byed tshig zor yang ba srol rgyun gyi gzhung dang mthun pa sogs kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon yod pa ni zur bstan leb mthong ltar ro/ /gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ rang blo shes bya'i gnas la ma sbyangs na/ / thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring / / de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang rgyal sras kyis/ / shes bya'i gnas kun sbyongs zhes legs par gsungs/ / zhes pa'i bka' lung snying la bcangs te rgya mtsho chen po chu dang /mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi ngoms pa'i dpe ltar khong ni rtag tu theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tshol bar brel zhing / mthar 1997lor phul byung legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas khri srong lnga rig nang bstan slob gling lung rigs smra ba'i dga' tshal du/rigs pa smra ba'i khyu tshogs kyi khrod du zhugs shing / mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal gyis phyug pa'i mkhan chen lung rigs nyi ma'i zhabs pad yun ring bsten pa'iskal bzang thob/ mkhan chen gang gis kyang sras kyi thu bor gzigs te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i shes bya bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bstsal/ slob glingade ru dus yun bgrang bya bdun tsam slob gnyer mdzad cing / mthar slob 2

thon gyi yig rgyugs chen mo'i skabs khong la phul byung gi slob ma'i go ming thob pa ma zad/ mkhan slobalongs kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog silaspa 'thor ba'i gnas su gyur ro/ /dares par bskrun zhus pa'i 〈g.yu mtsho'i dril chung 〉zhes pa'i deb 'di bzhin khong gis snga phyir brtsams pa'i rtsom yig 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa zhig yin zhing / de'i nang 〈dad pa'i rang sgrakhyi〈don spyi'i skar khung khyi〈gangs ri'i bsil rlung khyi〈'o ma'i shel phreng khyi〈mdza' sems kyi pho nya 〉bcas 'khodayod/ rtsom de rnams kyi brjod bya mtha' gcig tu rtsom pa po'i myong tshor brjod byar byas pa'i nges pa med de/ brjod bya 'ga' zhig ni rtsom pa po'i mthong thos kyi yul du gyur pa'i khor yug dang / khor yug de'i khrod kyi mi yi sems khams dang tshor ba brjod byar byas pa yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ / gang ltar yang rtsom gshis ni mi gshis la rag zer ba ltar rjod byed tshig gi sbyor bar rtsom pa po'i bag chags dang 'du shes kyi shan zhugs pa ni smos med do/ / gzhan yang snga phyir na gzhonasnyan ngag pa khong gis 〈gangs ri'i zla gzhon 〉dang 〈zhogs pa'i cong sgra 〉sogs dus deb khag gi nang rtsom gang mang spel myong ba ma zad/ klog pa pos tshad mtho'i gdeng 'jog kyang gnang bzhin gda'/'byungachar yang khong dang khong 'dra ba'i bod kyi ser mo ba'i khrod kyi snyan ngagapa rnams kyis bod kyi shes rig gi mdun lam gleng ba sogs mdor na slob gso'ispa lag tshang ba'i rtsom yig gang mang spel te sto ṭa'i shes dpal tshes pa'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i smon 'dun dang / go la skum po'i khyon 'di 'tshe med zhi bde'i 'odasnang gis khyab ste skye 'gro kun blo bde bag phebs kyi 'tsho bar longs spyod pa'i smon lam lan brgyar 'debs pa lags/3

slar smras pa/twe nas snyan ngagi mkhan la ngagi gi lha mos mngags pa khyod/ /shes bya'i gnas kun brtag pas kus gyis bsngags brjod me tog 'thor/ /dge bcu'i las swā 'dun zhing swā rgya can la bslu med kyi/ /legus bshad smra maXs khyed laspaXs pa'i mtshan snyan don gyis thob/ /ces pa'ang bsam yas pa ngag dbang bzang pos rab gnas me phag lo'i sa zla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i nyin dang ba'i blos ched du brjod pa dza yaca/4

gtang rag mchod sprin/ma rig pa'i srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong du dug lnga'i rang sgra kun rtog gi gzugs su 'phos pa'i 〈g.yu mtsho'i dril chung 〉'di ni lhag bsam gyi rlung pos ma bskul la/ 'gran rtsod kyi lag pas ngal bas ma dkrol/ 'di ni ngo srung gi dar dkar dang bcos ma'i mdzes rgyan gyis de bas ma spud/ 'di ni kho ba'i kun gzhi'i dbus nas phyungs ba'i dwangs ma zhig yin/ 'on kyang rgyud chags sdang rmongasagasum gyis dngos rgyu byas te skyes pa'i nyes skyon gyi phung po zhig yin phyir/bstan 'gror phan pa'i legs cha med mod/ rang blo tshul 'di la snying dbus nas 'dunapas da lam par sgrun zhus pa yin/ par skrun byed pa'i brgyud rim nang chedadu bka' drin gtang rag gi mchod sprin 'bul yul ni kho bor shes rab kyi 'drenakhyed stsol ba'i bshes gnyen dpal 'byor ye shes mchog dang / tshe rabs kun gyi rigs bdag mkhan chen a dkar rdo rje/ bka' drin 'khor med kyi bshes gnyen bstan pa rin chen lags kyis gtsos bshes gnyen yongs dang /gangs ri'i zla gzhon gyi rtsom sgrig pa thub bstan rab gsal lags dang zhang phur bu tshe ring / bstan 'gror lhag bsam che ba'i bsam dgon dbu 'dzin legs bshad thogs med/ blo bzang mkhyen rab/ tshe ring lags kyis gtsos pa'i dbu 'dzinayongs dang 'dus dmangs lhan rgyas/ deb chung 'di'i glog klad pa chos grogs bstan 'dzin thabs mkhas dang kho bor rgyun du thugs khur dang la rgya zab 5

pa'i grogs mchog bstan 'dzin bu chung gis gtsos pa'i grogs mchog yongs dang /'dig dpe sgrun khang gi las 'dzin lhan rgyas/ lhag tu deb 'di'i mthun rkyen yongasaljogs bsam yas gtsug lag khang nas bstsal ba sogs mdor na dngos brgyudagang rung gi sgo nas thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gnang mkhan lhan rgyas la/kho bo'i snying khams kyi ldum ra'i klong nas bka' drin dran pa'i sems 'gul dang dga' spro/ yi rangs dang bde skyid kyi 'dab stong dbang med du bzhad pa'i semasadabus kyi chu skyes 'di bka' drin gtang rag gi mchod sprin du nam 'tsho'i bar 'bul rgyu yin/rtsom pa pos lha ldan nas/

dad pa'irang sgra/yid ches dad pa'i sor mo'i sgyu rtsal gyis//dam par bsngags pa'i bstod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbyangs//snyan tshig gling bu'i lam nas drangs pa 'di//sgra 'dzin gzhon nu spro ba'i gsos su 'bul//no

thog ma'i sems bskyed/tshul khrims gtsange ma'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar 'thul/ /med byung mkhyen dpyod lo 'dab rab tu bzhad/ /brtse bas skye 'gro'i tsha gdung bsil ba'i gter/ /bshes gnyen ma la yar skyes rgyal gyur cig /shel dkar lhun po'i dpal 'dzin yid 'phrog sku/ /snying gi gdung ba kun sel byams brtse'i gsung / /blo gter dngos grub char ltar bsnyil ba'i thugs/ /mtsho byung sgeg mos byang chub bar du skyongs/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig snyan ngag mchog /yid kyi lcags kyu rna ba'i bdud rtsi dang / /med byung sgyu rtsal stong ldan mdza' na mo/ /bde sdug gsang gtam brngod pa'i snying grogs yin/ /sgyid lug mun pa'i mal nang mngon zhen gyi/ /rmi lam bde ba'i dpal la ma chags par/ /gangs phrug gzhen nu rmongs gnyid las sangs te/ /

rang yig thog nas rtsom yig spel bar rangs /snyan ngag smra 'dod 'dod pas rab myos pas/ /tshig spyor spel legs legs pa'i rgyan med kyang / /rtsom yig gzhon nu nu 'bur g.yo bzhin du/ /sgren mor rgyu bar bar gcod nus sam ci/ /gtonge phod lhag bsam sa zla ma mchis pa'i/ /rgyu spyor bsam dgon 'dus dmangs sku drin dang / /kho bo'i rnam dpyod bzo yi sgyu rtsal las/ /g.yu mtsho'i dril chung gsar du bshad 'di med/ /lhag bsam 'o chu dkar pos ma bkrus la/ /'gran rtsod me lce dmar pos ma bsregs shing / /ngo srung mdzes pa'i gos kyis ma skrud par/ /ma bcos sems kyis ci bder gsil bar bya/ /2006 lo'i zla 9tshes 22nyin/bla ma rgyang 'bod/stobs bcu mnga' ba yi bdag nyid/ /

rkang gnyis zlos gar du byon pa'i/ /'bangs nga'i rigs bdag gi gtsug rgyan/ /skyabs rje a dkar de mkhyen no/ /'di snang srid pa yi phun tshogs/ /sdug bsngal me 'ob tu gzigs pas/ /skyo shas nges 'byung gis bskul ba'i/ /sdom brtson a dkar de mkhyen no/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo la'ang byams brtse'i/ /'dzum pa'i spyan ras ni g.yo ba/ /gzhan phan byams sems kyi bdud rtsis/ /brlan pa'i a dkar de mkhyen no/ /kun rdzob sbang bya ru ma 'dzin/ /don dam blang byar yang ma zhen/ /zung 'jug dbu ma yi lta ba/ /bzhed pa'i a dkar de mkhyen no/ /mtshungs bral gtong phod kyi sgo nas/ /shes brtson dad ldan gyi slob bu/ /zab rgyas chos char gyi sbyin pas/ /tshim mdzad a dkar de mkhyen no/ /4

chags sdang ngo srung kun spangs shing / /kun la bu gcig ltar brtse ba/ /ris med tshul khrims kyis btsun pa'i/ /skyabs rje a dkar de mkhyen no/ /lhag bsam shel dkar gyi thag pas/ /lci ba'i bstan pa yi khur chen/ /rnam dpyod phrag pa ru bzod pa'i/ /zhus med a dkar de mkhyen no/ /brtse ldan lhag bsam gyi rlung pos/ /spro ba'i rang dbang ni bsgyur bas/ /bu slob brtson 'grus kyis skyong bar/ /zla med a dkar de mkhyen no/ /phyogs ris bying rgod kun spangs pas/ /rnam rtog rlung po yis mi g.yo/ /rang tshugs shin sbyangs kyi bsam gtan/ /ldan pa'i a dkar de mkhyen no/ /phra zhib rigs pa yi lam nas/ / gzhung lugs thogs med du bkral zhing / /chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab/ /

mnga' ba'i a dkar de mkhyen no/ /mdor na legs tshogs kyi 'byung khungs/ /nyesaskyon ma lus kyi gnyen po/ /kho bor khyed nyid las med pas/ /'di nas byang chub bar skyongs shig / 2001lo'i zla 12tshes14nyin /tshangs sras gsol 'debs blo gter 'dod 'jo/med byung lang tshos sgeg pa'i mtsho byung ma/ / ma khyed 'bod do mgon med bu chung bdag /bdag med yal bar ma 'dor brtse bas mkhyen/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas skyongs shig dbyangs can ma/ /dran shes bung ba'i yid dbang 'dar 'jug pa'i/ /mdzes sku dung gi ‘ga phran g.yo ba las/ /shel bum brang skyes zung dang pad dkar bzhin/ /mig gi bdud rtsir stsol cig dbyangs can ma/ /rab snyan 'gyur khug stong ldan dri za'i gsung / /thos pa tsam gyis yid dbang rab myos te/ /

me+ongs pa'i zug rngu sel ba'i sman gyi mchog /sgra 'dzin lam du stsol cig dbyangs can ma/ /dmigs bcas mtshan ma'i spros pa rab zhi yang / /brtse bas bdag sogs nyid kyi bur bzung ste/ /blo gter dngos grub ci 'dod stsol mdzad pa'i/ /brtse ldan thugs kyis skyongs shig dbyangs can ma/ /brgyad gnyis lang tshos myos pa'i snyem pa yis/ /mdzes pa'i gar stabs sgyur dang lhan cig tu/ /chosakun gdangs su 'gug pa'i rgyud mngasakyis/ /ma rig gnyid las slongs shig dbyangs can ma/ /mtshar sdug pad dkar dgyes pa'i bzhin ras dbus/ /gnag snum yid 'ong smin ma'i gzhu mchog las/ /'phos pa'i g.yo ldan bung ba'i zur mig mdas/ /rmongs pa'i bla srog cod cig dbyangs can ma/ /mtshungs med med byung lang tsho'i gzi byin dang / /mdza' gcig rtse dgas myos pa'i 'jo sgeg gis/ /yang yang kho bo'i yid dbang rab 'phrog pas/ /zag med dga' bdes skyongs shig dbyangs can ma/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i thang chen yangs pa sa /7

myur mgyogs cang shes blogros rta pho yis/ / snyan rtsom gom 'gros thogs med spo ba la/ /spobs pa'i snang ba stsol cig dbyangs can ma/ /bdag sogs gdung shugs drag pos nyer bskul te/ /brtse ldan khyed las skyabs gzhan mi re na/ /mtshungs med snyan ngag smra ba'i cod pan de/ /bdag gi spyi bor chings shig dbyangs can ma/ /gang dran snyan tshig byis pa'i ngu ngag gis/ /mtsho byung ma khyed yus kyis 'bod lags na/ /brtse ba'i zhal gzigs gsung gis dbugs dbyung nas/ /bu nga gto du skyongs shig dbyangs can ma/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i rlung gzhon bser bu yis/ /bdag blo'i gti mug sprin rum kun bsal te/ /dbyangs can dga' ma'i zla zhal legs mjal nas/ /blo gros kun da rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /2003 lo'i zla 3tshes3nyin/

mtsho byung sgeg mo'i bstod dbyangs rab gsal ma/rab gsal nyi gzhen 'phros pa'i gangs ri yang / /rab rib byed pa'i ngang dkar bu mo'i sku/ /rab mdzes 'ja' tshon skyengs pa'i na bza' yis /rab tu bklubs te dad pa'i yid mkhar spyon/ /rab dkar byams dang snying rje'i 'o ma'i mtshor/ /rab 'khrungs chu skyes ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng / /rab myos bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin mas/ /rab byung bdag dang 'grogs shig mtsho byung ma/ /rab dwangs zla shel zhun mas bskus pa'i sku/ /rab bshad shin tu dgyes pa pad ma'i bzhin/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i g.yo ldan ri dwags mig /rab mdzes dri za'i rgyan gcig mtsho byung ma/ /rab 'jam gnag snum smin ma'i rol sgeg zung / /rab mtshar dbang po'i gzhu ltar yang yang g.yo/ /rab dkar smin mtshams mdzod spu'i 'od zer gyis/ /rab slo+ongs bdag blo'i mun sel mtsho byung ma/ /

rab mtho mdog legs dwangs gtsang dri med shangs/ /rab dmar byu ru'i dpal 'dzin yid 'ong mchu/ /rab snyoms mu tig dkar po'i thags bzang tshems/ /rab yangs ro 'dzin mnga' ba'i mtsho byung ma/ /rab mtshar pad dkar gzhen nu'i lang tsho yi/ /rab mdzes rgyan gcig dkar zlum shel dkar gyi/ /rab rgyas nu 'bur cung zad g.yo bawo du/ /rab snyan rgyud mangs 'chang ba'i mtsho byung ma/ /rab gnag dbu skra sil bus sku stod khebs/ /rab sgeg tsog pu'i tshul gyis g.yon du 'gying / /rab mnyen phyag zung yang yang bsgyur na yang / /rab dul zhi ba'i thugs mnga' mtsho byung ma/ /rab yangs blo gter 'dzad med stsol ba'i gter/ /rab bsil dung zla mtsho byung sgeg pa mos/ /rab rib rmongs pa'i tsha gdung kun bsal nas/ /rab 'byams blo gros kun da rgyas rgyur cig /0 rang lo 5 005lo'i zla tshes0nyin/

tshangs sras gsol 'debs me+ongs mun sel ba'i nyi gzhon/dkar mdzes sku gzugs dung gi lhag phran la/ /mtshar sdug mtshan dpe'i me tog bshad pa'i dbus/ /brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i ge sar legs smin pa'i/ /mdzes ldan yid kyi me tog dbyangs ldan ma/ /med byung byams dang snying rje'i 'o ma'i mtshor/ /'khor ba'i skyon bral chu skyes gzhen nu dang / /gzhan phan rab rgyas ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng / /shes rab rang gzugs rab mdzes smin legs tshul/ /shes bya'i sgrib pas ma sbags sku mdog dkar/ /dkar 'jam bde ba'i nu 'bur mchog tu mdzes/ /mdzes sdug lang tshos rgyal kun dgyes mdzad yum/ /yum mchog dbyangasacan lha mos blo gter stsol/ /'gro la bu ltar brtse bas chags pa'i tshul/ /me+odas pa'i ngal ba bsang phyir 'jo sgeg nyams/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs rjen par ngo sprod phyir/ /sku stod dar gyis mdzes sbud brang sked gsal/ /11

smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'i sher phyin gyi/ /sku smad 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i na bzas g.yogs/ /med byung sbyin sogs pha rol phyin drug gi /rna cha mgrin rgyan sogs kyis rab tu mdzes/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul bas ma 'dzingasaganag snum gyi/ /dbu skras sku stod khebs shing thor cog rtser/ /srid gsum rgyan dang sdug kun rab bsil ba'i /ut+pal tshes bdag zung gis gsal bar mtshon/ /snyan 'jebs rna ba'i bdud rtsi rgyud mangs kyis/ /stong dang rten 'byung 'doms pa'i dbyangasakyi sgras/ /bdag yid ting 'dzin ro yis myos byas te/ /kun rtog drwa ba'i zug rngu myur zhi shoge /brtan g.yo'i snyan dgu gcig bsdus snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i glu dbyangs drug 'gyur gsung / /gsung gi cha shas rna bar lhung ba'i tshe/ /tshe rabasakun tu smra ba'i dbang por 'gyur/ /'gyur khug stong ldan snyan 'jebs rna ba'i dpyid/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dbyangs bzhin shin tu snyan/ /12

snyan ngag rtsom gyis mang thos mkhas pa'i yid/ /yid 'phrog nusapa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig kye/ /kye ma gtan gyi skyabs gcig tshangs sras ma/ /ma gcig khyed la me+ongs sel sman mnga' yang / /yang yang rmongs pa'i nad kyis mnar ba bdag /bdag med 'dor ba thugs kyis cang phod dam/ /dam tshig thugasarjes dgongs shig dbyangs can ma/ /ma ma khyed kyi'ang kho bo 'dor lags na/ /na chung bdag la khyed las gzhan pa'i skyabs/ /skyabs de gang yin khyed kyis gsung du gsol/ /gsol 'debs smre ngag yus kyi gdung shugasa'adi/ /'di phyi'i skyabs gcig mtsho byung sgeg mo'i thugs/ /thugs rje'i shugs kyis bskul bsabadag gi blo/ /blo ldan smra ba'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog /rang lo 23 2003 lo+o'i zla 8tshes 15nyin/ sgra dbyangs lha mar bstad 'bul/rab yangs dwangs shing gtsang ba'i rgya mtsho'i ngor/ /13

rab tu mdzesapa'i yid 'ong tshangs srasam/ /rab gdung yid kyi dad pas 'bod lags na/ /rab mdzes dbyangs can lha mos blo gter stsol/ /dkar mdzes kun da'i dpal 'dzin ye shes sku/ /snyan 'jebs yid 'ong yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /brtse ba'i nyams ldan blo gter stsol mdzad thugs/ /sgra dbyangs lha mos blo gter bstsal du gsol/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho dar ba'i tshul/ /sgeg pa'i gar dang chags pa'i zur mig bshad/ /mdzes sdug phyag gis rgyud mangs sgra 'byin pa'i/ /ngang dkar bu mos bdag la blo gter stsol/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog brtse ldan tshangs sras mar/ /srid na rin bral 'dod yon sna lnga yis/ /stong gsum byur bur bkang ste legs phul bas/ /brtse ldan khyed kyis blo gter bstsal du gsol/ /tha mal chu yis lus grib bkrus pa na/ /mi gtsang dwangs shing gtsang bar gyur ba bzhin/ /bdag gi mgrin par khyed kyi bdud rtsi'i chus/ /skye 'gag bkrus shing ngag gi blo gter stsol/ /rang lo 18 1998lo'i zla 7tshes12be/14

bsam yas bshad grwar phul ba'i snyan rtsom/mkhan slob chos gsum med byung thugs bskyed dang / /'dir 'dus blo gsar yongs kyi las smon mthus/ /khri srong lnga rig nang bstan slob gling zhes/ /phyogs bcur grags pa'i dga' ba gang gis mtshon/ /chos ston bla ma bzang zhing mthun rkyen 'dzoms/ /chos grogs dam tshig gtsang zhing mkhas btsun bzang / /chos sde chen po brag dmar bsam yas kyi/ /chos grwa'i nang du slebs 'di skal ba bzang / /rgya che'i gzhung lugs thos pas zhi zhing dul/ /thos don yang yang bsam pas nges shes rnyed/ /rnyed don sgom pas nyon mongs rab zhi bas/ /thos bsam gnad smin bsam yas bshad grwa ba/ /mtshams sprin gzhon nu'i dpal yang skyengs byed pa'i/ /ngur smig 'amang ba'i blo gsar phu nu'i dbus/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri yi steng bzhugs nas/ /gzhung lugs 'gal med 'chad 'di shin tu med/ /15

mthon mthing g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin yul ljongs dang / /med byung lag mthil ltar mnyam rtsod grwa'i nang / /rigs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i mtshan nyid pas/ /zla bral rigs lam rtsod 'di blta mi bzod/ /dben zhing nyams dga' mu 'brel grwa shag nang / /dkar 'jam yid 'ong shog bu'i thang steng / /tshig spyor spel legs rtsom phreng do shal gyis/ /gzur gnas mkhas par mgrin rgyan ci 'dod spel/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i gzhung lugs kun la mkhas/ /med byung 'dul ba'i spyod pa shin tu btsun/ /phyogs ris gdon gyis ma bslad thugs rgyud bzang / /phu nu 'di 'dra rdzogs ldan dus na'ang dkon/ /phyi yi mdzes sdug sum rtsen yul la 'gran/ /nang gi yon tan gzhan gyis mtshungs zla bral/ /phan tshun la rgya phu nur co 'dri ba'i/ /bsam yas bshad grwa'i dge mtshan brjod par bral /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i bsam yas bshad grwa yi/ /mkhas btsun bzang ba'i brtse ldan phu nu rnams/ /16

mkhas dang grub pa'i nor gyis rab phyug pa'i/ / mkhas pa'i dbang por 'gyur bar snying nas smon/ /rang lo 25 2004 lo'i zla 5tshes 22nyin/dpal bsam yas sprel lo'i smon lam chen mo gsar bzhad u rdu wa ra'i dga' tshal/lhag bsam zla bral mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ /dpag yas nus mthu mnga' ba'i pad+ma 'byung / /bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan chos rgyal khri srong rjes/ /gtsug lag khang 'dir slar yang shisapar stsol/ /ngo mtshar mdzes sdug lha yi khang bzang dngos/ /rtsa chen rig dngos rnam sras gan mdzod sbun/ /'dzam gling mdzes rgyan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang / /phyogs bzhi'i skye bo'i mig gi bdud rtsi dngos/ /mkhan slob chos gsum thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /'dzad med 'phrin las sbrang char bab dang lhan/ /'dir 'dus 'dus tshogs dad pa'i sa bon las/ /sprel lo'i smon lama.u sdu wa ra bzhad/ /17

rtse gcig chos la gzhol ba'i 'dus sde rnams/ /phyogs gnyis 'dzin pa'i gdon gyis ma bslad par/ /lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun grub bsam yas su/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dge 'dun 'dus 'di med/ /ye ma rdzogs ldan skal bzang shar ba 'am/ /yang na kho bor rmi lam rmis sam ci bsam yas sbrel lo'i smon lam mo 'di/ /dngos su tshogs kyang da dung 'phyang mo nyug /mjal ba tsam gyis snying nas dang ba 'dren/ /rigs pa'i rol rtsed mdzad pas rmongs mun sel/ /mnyam gshib byung bas dam tshig 'o chu 'dres/ /smon lam tshogs 'dir dge mtshan brjod las 'das/ /las smon bzang po'i bslu med nus mthu las/ /grogs kyi yang rtse chos mthun snying gi grogs/ /nang bstan slob grwa khri srong slob gling nang / /kun tu mjal bar smon cig grogs mchog kun/ /ring ring thag ring yul nas phebs pa dang / /18
nye nye gnas khang gcig nang ltomatshar mtshar dge maphywa 'bum yang yang gnas masho sdusdi ṭ+wāṃ /

skasgoneri 4/tshogs drug snang ba yul gyi 'jig rten la/ /mngon rjes zung gis drangs pa'i nges shes kyis/ /don spyi'i skar khung brgyud nas lta ba'i skabs/ /ngo mtshar yid kyi ltad mo ci yang mthong / /

snang ba sems sgrub kyi mgur ma/sems 'khrul bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /sems 'khrul snang can gyi 'khyam po ngas/ /sems dag pa'i gnas lugs mthong ba'i phyir/ /sems gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos thams cad sems kyi ngang tshul yin/ /sems nyid las gzhan pa'i chos gzhan med/ /sems nyid kyang btsal na stong pa yin/ /stong de yang btsal na rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems chags pas bslus na kun la chags/ /sems sdang bas 'khrul na kun la sdang / /sems rmongs pas bsgrib na kun la rmongs/ /sems nyid las dbang chen gzhan yod min/ /khong sgom dben par shin tu skyid/ /nga 'khyam po grong nang shin tu skyid/ /don dben pa grong khyer gnyis po ni/ /gang skyid par yod dam khyed kyis smos/ /21

rje bla mas thar par bde skyid rtsi/ /blun kho bos 'khor bar bde skyid rtsi/ /nged bde skyid 'dod pa mi mthun de/ /ngas bsam na sems kyis byasapar snyam/ /gzhan mi gtsang lus kyi bshang gci dang / /rang mi gtsang lus kyi bshang gci gnyis/ /don mi gtsang yin par tsā na yang / /rang gtsang bar 'dzin pa sems kyis byas/ /gang sdug bsngal bzung na sdug bsngal yin/ /gang bde bar bzung na sdug bsngal min/ /spyir 'khor ba'i bde sdug yod do cog/ /sems rang gis gang 'dzin yin par nges/ /skyid thar pa zhes grags dwangs gtsang dang / /sdug 'khor ba zhes pa'i mi gtsang gnyis//sems 'khrul dang ma 'khrul tsam zhig las/ /gzhan rigasapas dpyad kyang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /dma' dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs sa gzhi dang / /mtho nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing / /ngas bsam na rang gi sems nyid las/ /22

gzhan phyi rol grub par yod dam snyam/ /nang kun gzhir bag chags sad pa las/ /rkyen phyi rol gzugs brnyan snang bar gyur/ /don de'i phyir rgyal ba thabs mkhas pas/ /khams gsum po sems tsam yin par gsungs//phyi yul gyi bde sdug thams cad dang / /nang sems kyi dga' skyo 'du bral sogs/ /sems sgyu ma'i 'khrul snang shes gyur nas/ /rkyen gang la'ang gzung 'dzin bral bar shog /rang lo 24 2004 lo'i zla 10tshes 18nyin/grwa rkyang gi 'tsho ba/srid pa'i phun tshogs chu yi lha bar gzigs/ /sgyu ma'i nor la chags zhen til tsam dben/ /mthon por ngo srung dman par brnyas bcos bral/ /tshad ldan bshes gnyen a dkar rdo rjes skyongs/ / —sngon bsags legs byas bzang po'i rgyu mthun las/ /tshe 'dir ngur smig 'chang ba'i skal bzang thob /23

dwangs gtsang tshul khrims srog las gces 'dzin pa'i/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba 'di phyi don dang ldan/ /kun la dag snang mos gus ma 'byongs kyang / /rang gi bla mar yid ches dad pa thob/ /ci gsungs bka' bzhin bsgrubs te gus pas mchod/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba dag snang yang rtse'i phul/ /sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i skyes bu dang / /sku thog gong ma'i yang srid ma yin pas/ /dka' spyad sdug khur brtson pas thos bsam byas/ /grwa rkyang 'otsho ba mchog dman kun dang mthun/ /'chad tshe dma' ba'i stan la 'khod na yang / /mtshungs bral lung dang rigs pa zung 'brel gyis/ /tshig don zhabrul med ngang nas 'chad mkhas pa'i/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho bas sangs rgyas bstan pa spel/ /(rtsod pa'i tshe na thal 'gyur 'gying nyams bcas /sde bdun rigs pa'i gad rgyangs cher bsgrags te/ /mkhas rlom wa skyes snying rtsa 'dar byed pa'i/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba dngos stobs rigs pa'i gter/ /24

rtsom yig spel ba'i skabs su snying dbus nas/ /gang shar lhug por 'bri zhing lhag par du/ /la rgya mi rigs khe phan gtso bor 'dzin/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba dwangs gtsang la rgya'i gter/ /rang gi grub mthar zhen pas dbu 'phang bstod/ /gzhan gyi grub mthar sdang bas dmod pa sogs/ /chos spong las ngan nam yang mi gsog pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba shākya'i bstan pa'i rgyan/ /rlabs chen mtshungs zla bral ba'i lhag bsam ste/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i sems bskyed mi ldan yang / /rgyun du gzhan la gnod sems ma mchis pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba gzhan phan byams brtse ldan/ / 'dod pa'i khams la chags bral ma byas kyang / /bde gshegs bslab par shin tu gus pas na/ /'dod pa'i bde ba don du mi gnyer bas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho bar gzhan gyis do zla bral/ /bcas dang rang bzhin nyes par bag zon che/ /rnam dkar bya bar spro bas ci nus sgrub/ /nyin ltar bshad sgrub zung gis dus 'da' ba'i/ /25

grwa rkyang 'tsho bar nang pa'i bstan pa gnas/ /rin chen khri la 'gying ba'i khengs sems dang / /dar gos rgyan gyis bklubs pa'i rlom sems med/ /rgyun du grwa chas hrul po gtsang mar bzhes/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba zhi dul bab chags ldan/ /sbyin bdag nor ngo srung ba'i sku ngal dang / /rang gi 'khor 'bangs skyong ba'i zang zing med/ /ci rnyed longs su spyod cing gsog 'jog dben/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba chog shes nor dang ldan/ /nang sa'i mdza' mo'i yon bdag mi 'dod la/ /rlangs 'khor par chas kha par de bas kyang / /shing phreng ser pos 'khor gsum skor 'dod pa'i/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba dam pa'i chos dang mthun/ /mang na brgya lor dmar po gsum bzhi tsam/ /nyung na shog sgor lnga drug las med kyang / /rang nyid phongs pa'i snang ba til tsam med/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba bdag 'dzin zhen chags dben/ /dpe cha mal stan grwa chas cha tshang dang / /26

smyu gu dpe deb dung phan chab tog bcas/ /de min gzhan la bsags bsrung ma mchis pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba sems bag shin tu yangs/ /che 'dod ngo srung can la khong dgod 'chor/ /nyam chung tshul ldan btsun par yid smon skyes/ /tshad ldan zog po'i dbye ba 'byed mkhas pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba mtshungs bral dpyod shes rno/ /gos chen ser pos bklubs pa'i bla sprul las/ /ngur smrig hrul po la'i ba'i mtshan nyid par/ /snying nas dad cing khyim pa dang 'gal yang / /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba 'dul ba'i lugs dang mthun/ /r+sā po'i rna bar sbrang rtsi lta bu'i gtam/ /nyam chung thog tu shin tu btsan pa'i gtam/ /kun la mi gtsang lta bu'i gtam spangs pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba ya rabs blo bzang ldan/ /dwangs bsil 'tshe med zhi bde'i lam bur gshegs/ /nyam chung kun gyi bran du khas blangs kyang / /rang gi rigs la 'bu ba'i gnyen por bzhengs/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba zhum med spobs sems ldan/ /27

'khor ba spangs te ngur smig 'chang na yang / /dpyod ldan bsam pas bho ṭa'i skad yig la/ /rang gi srog las shin tu gces 'dzin pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho bar gangs can mes po dgyes/ /mthon por ngo dga' bsu ba'i rang don med/ /dman par brnyas bcos shod pa'i nga rgyal bral/ /bar mar 'gran rtsod bya ba'i don med pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba gnas zos mda' las bde/ /tshad ldan gzhan phyogs yin yang gtsug tu bkur/ /zog po rang phyogs yin yang phangs med dor/ /phyogs ris chags sdang dug chus ma bslad pas/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho bar phyogs ris zhen chags med/ /rgyu nor snyan grags go sa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gzhan dang 'gran pa'i 'khon 'dzin ma mchis pas /brnab sems bral zhing kun dang mthun pas na/ /grwa rkyang 'tsho ba 'tshe med zhi bde'i phul/ /de ltar dge mtshan kun gyi gter gyur pa'i/ /nyam chung tshul ldan grwa rkyang 'tsho ba la /28

snying nas dga' bas de yi rang bzhin rnams/ /'khyog med drang po'i lam nas cung zad smras/ /gna' rabs gtam du blun po'i gral mgo las/ /mkhas pa'i gral mjug bzang bar thos pas na/ /da nas kho bo'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /grwa rkyang kho na'i 'tsho bar gnas par shog /2005 lo'i zla 8tshes 7nyin/༄7/ /g.yu mtsho'i dus bzhi'i ngo mtshar/mtshar sdug 'od chags lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin mnyen lhug sku gzugs dung gi lcug phran ldem pa'i rtser/ /rab tu 'dzum pa'i pad+ma'i bzhin la ling ling g.yo ba bung ba'i mig zung ches cher mdzes/ /dkar mdzes reg 'jam shin tu rgyas pa'i nu 'bur khur gyis phra ldem sked skabs dub pas na/ tāspyad mangs sngon po dkrol ba'i zol gyis g.yon du 'dzin pas ngal ba sel mdzad dbyangs can ma/ /nyin mtshan dus drug kun tu gdung shugs kyis/ /mtsho byung ma khyed snying nas 'bod lags na/ /dad pa'i rlabs phreng 'phyur ba'i 'o ma'i mtshor/ /ngang dkar bu mo rtag tu rol gyur cig /'dzam gling sgron me khri srong slob gling nang / /nang don rig gzhung slob spyong byed dang lhan/ /29

lhan cig snyan ngag smra bar smon na yang / /yang dag brngod bya'i mdza' mo rnyed ma gyur/ /de nas sngo bsangs lha lam yangs pa'i klong/ /gser zhun dpal 'dzin brtse ldan ngang ser zung / /mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol te lho phyogs su/ /bskyod pas g.yu mtsho'i dus bzhi'i ngo mtshar dran/ /g.ya' spang gangs ri spel mas mu khyud bskor/ /mthon mthing rtswa thang yangs pa'i sa gzhi'i steng / /g.yang dkar ri dwags tshom bur bkod 'dra ba'i/ /pha yul yar 'brog g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal dngos/ /mtho sgang rta ljang tsha zer bzod dka' bas/ /sngo bsangs bu mo'i lang tsho rab bzhur te/ /ngo mtshar yar 'brog sa yi lte ba rtswa /dwangs gtsang g.yu yi mtsho mo chil ler 'khyil/ /brjid pa'i rlabs phreng phreng bar g.yo ba g.yu 'brug dgung du 'phyo ba dngos/ /snyan pa'i rlabs sgra sgra 'dzin bdud rtsi rab snyan dri za'i dbyangs kyi sbun/ /rab mdzes chu bya bya rigs du ma rgyu skar grangs kyi rjes su 'gro/ /pha mtha' mi mngon mngon par 'phags pa'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho e ma mtshar/ /30

dgid/dri bzhon gzhon nus yang yang rab bskul bas/ /nor 'dzin 'dzin mas kha ba'i gos dor te/ /rab mdzes mdzes sdug sngo ljang lang tsho yi/ /sgeg nyams nyams 'gyur ngom pa'i dus 'di med/ /dbyid zla ra ba'i dkar phyogs dge ba'i nyin/ /dpyid kyi bu mo bsu ba'i rten 'brel la/ /dpyid mgo'i kha ba'i me tog rab 'thor bas/ /daphyid dpal myur du byon pa'i pho nyar gyur/ /mtshar mtshar g.yu mtsho sgeg mos dal bu'i ngang / /dkar dkar rgya dar seng ras yongs bsal te/ /mdzes mdzes mthon mthing bzhin ras ngom pa'i tshe/ /yang yang brtse ba'i chu bya dga' bdes myos/ /gzhan yul dpyid dpal lang tsho bayid na yang / /rang yul skya thang nyid du gnas pas na/ /g.yu mtsho sgeg mo thugs kyis ma bzod par/ /daphyid dpal bsu phyir thugs sems lang long g.yo/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas lang tsho bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /sa yi mal nang yun ring mnal ba yi/ /rtsi thog gzhon nu me+ongs gnyid las sangs te/ /31

dpyid dpal bzhad phyir phangs pa med par bstsal/ /mdzes mdzes lag mthil ltar mnyam sa gzhi'i steng / /nag nag byang 'brong dar ma khros 'dra ba'i/ /bajid brjid sbra gur nang gi 'brog pa yang / /mtshar mtshar dpyid dpal bsu bar shin tu brel/ /dkar nag phyugs kyi yid sems 'gug pa'i ched/ /rtswa thang bzhin ras chu yis yang yang bkrus/ /dkar chu 'o ma'i rgya mtsho skyil 'dod pas/ /lhas ra'i rdzing bur gzhig gsos legs par byas/ /'bri g.yag du ma'i ngur sgra ldi ri ri/ /'dogs khyi thu po'i ngar skad 'u ru mā /sbra gur nag po'i dar lcog brel tshub tshub/ /drang bden 'grog pa'i 'tsho ba skyid lhang lhang / /ma pham brtse sems nor bu'i gter gcig pu/ /ma bcos drang bden yar 'brog gzhen nu ma/ /ma rabs 'phyon ma'i g.yo 'phrul mi mkhas kyang / /ma smad gtan grogs byed par mtshungs zla bral/ /de tshe nor 'dzin sgeg mo rab myos pas/ /reg 'jam lang tsho'i tsha drod 'phel bas na/ /chu 'dzin gzhon nu'ang chags pas ma bzod par/ /lang tsho'i rngul chu sbrang char sil sil babs/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mos shis pa'i glu dbyangs 'then/ /32

rkang 'thung gzhon nus sgeg pa'i gar stabs g.yo/ /me tog sna tshogs dga' bas shin tu 'dzum/ /lus can kun kyang brjod dka'i bde bas myos/ /g.yu mtshos dpyid dpal bsu ba'i lhag bsam la/ /la rgya can gyi khu byug bu mo yang / /yang yang snying gi dbus nas rangs pas na/ /na thang 'di steng g.yu mtshor bstod par phebs/ /bag phebs ri dwags dga' ba'i rtse 'jor rol/ /rab mdzes bya tshogs snyan pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol//g.yang dkar lu gus ma mor glu dbyangs 'then/ /dpyid dus yul 'di'i dge mtshan brngod las 'das/ /gdod ma'i gangs ri'i chu dang gsar du brdol ba'i chu mig kun bskams te/ /re zhig khyed kyi gsos su gyur pa'i gsar byung chu sna med na yang/ /dwangasagatsang lhag bsamagasaragatod snying stobasanyamasapa med pa'ibakhri mtsho khyed/ /gangs can bod rigs gzhen nu yongs kyi zla bral spobs pa'i bla mtsho yin/ /gas/lha lam klong nas dbyar rnga ldir dang lhan/ / lhan cig sbrang char zil ma'i bdud rtsis brlan/ /brlan gsher can gyi sngo ljang sa gzhi'i steng/ /33

steng phyogs lha yul mog pa'i mdzes ljongs bshad/ /sngo bsangs bu mo sa mtho'i yul 'dir ring nasarjes su chags na yang / /ngo tsha'i tshul du chu 'dzin sprin gyis bzhin ras dkyil 'khor yongs bkab ste/ /brtse dung bdud rtsi'i chab rgyun bstsal zhing ma gsang snyan 'jebs 'brug sgra yis/ /lhad med snying gtam lhug por bshad pas yul 'di'i lang tsho shin tu 'phel/ /sngo ljang sa gzhi lta na sdug pa'i lus/ /mtsho dang mtshe 'u thig le'i sgro mdangs mtshar/ /sgrug sprin dbang po'i gzhu yi gtsug phud can/ /yar 'brog yul 'di rma bya'i rjes su 'gro/ /dkar dkar chu shel lhun po'i gangs ri dang / /brdzid bajid rdza ri smug po'i mdun ngos su/ /chil chil drag tu 'bab pa'i rbab chu yi/ /'ur 'ur bzhur sgra dri za'i dbyangs kyi spun/ /dri zhim sba ma ba lu'i nags gseb du/ /spu sdug mdzes pa'i 'jol mo gsung dbyangs snyan/ /yid 'ong spang gshongs bde mo'i phang ba na/ /spang rgyan me tog mdzes pa'i lang tsho ngoms/ /khor yug dben zhing nyams dga'i ne'u gsing klong / /bag phebs rgyu ba'i ri dwags gzhon nu rnams/ /la la bde ba'i gnyid la yur ba dang / /'ga' zhig ngo mtshar rtse 'jo'i gar la rol/ /g.yu yi me long g.yu mtsho'i spun zla yi/ /34

g.yu gshongs dkar mo gling gi rtswa thang 'di/ /g.yu mtsho phyug mo nyid dang zhakhrul dogs nas/ /g.yu mtshor gu rus phyag rjes 'jog par mdzad/ /mu mtha' bral ba'i rtswa thang de yi steng / /'jam pa'i dri bzhon dal bur g.yo ba'i tshe /mdzes pa'i me tog mgo lcog ldem ldem ngang / /brtse grogs bung ba mgron du 'bod pa bzhin/ /dkar dkar dung la 'bu ba'i bal ldan dang / /nag nag mun ltar 'thibs pa'i 'bri dang g.yag /lhang lhang 'tsher ba'i cang shes rta pho sogs/ /mang mang rtswa thang steng du ci dgar rol/ /g.yu yi gzhong pa'i dbyibs can spang khug nang / /gang sar tshom bu bkod 'dra'i sbra spyor steng / /du zhag sngon po lang long 'phyur ba'i khrod/ /snyan 'jebs 'brog glus yid sems phyogs der bkug /sa mtho'i 'brog pa bzhin ras cung nag kyang / /dkar gtsang nang gi thugs sems gangs ri'i spun/ /rtswa thang steng du khyim gzhis chags na yang / /blo gsar gzhon nu'i pha khyim slob grwar bcol/ /brtson 'grus skya ba 'dzin pa'i ngang pa yis /drag po'i rlabs phreng sogs la ma 'dzems par/ /mtsho mo'i pha mthar brgal ba'i snying stobs 'dis/ /35

yar 'brog gzhen nur 'dzad med stobs shugs bstsal/ /dus 'dir char shugs shin tu 'phel bas na/ /dwangs gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan chu klung dang / /rnyog ma'i shwa 'od mi gtsang rdzab chu sogs/ /chu bo thams cad g.yu mtsho'i nang du babs/ /'on kyang khyed kyi rang bzhin dwangs gtsang la/ /rnyog ma'i dri mas nam yang mi tshugs pas/ /khyed ni gangs can bod rigs gzhon nu yi/ /rab dwangs lhad med sems kyi rgya mtsho yin/ /mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal gyis phyug pa'i nor 'dzin sgeg mos sngo ljang na bza' mdzes par bklubs/ /rab mtshar 'ja' tshon ska rags gsol zhing mdzes pa'i me rtag tshogs kyi pang gdan bcings/ khrel dkar gangs ri'i bzhin ras mdzes shing rab 'jam rkang 'thung lan bus sku stod khebs/ /g.yu yi spang ri'i nu 'bur g.yo ba'i yar 'brog dbyar gyi sgeg mo e ma mtshang/ /ston/gtsang gtsang g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin nam mkha'i dbyings/ /mdzes mdzes sprin dkar gzhen nu'i tshom bu bkod/ /ser ser dbyig 'dzin bu mo'i phang ba mā /legs legs smin pa'i 'bras bzang byur bur khengs/ /36

yangs pa'i rtswa thang mtshams sprin gzhon nu'i mdog /mdog legs rtswa 'bru'i dmar mdangs shin tu bkra/ /bkra mdangs sha shed rab tu rgyas pa'i phyugs/ /phyugs rigs du mas yul 'di dog por byas/ /nam mkha' sngo zhing dwangs la nyi 'od 'tsher/ /rab dkar lho sprin byang du lang long g.yo/ /khrung khrung dkar mos ru star legs bsgrigs te/ /dbyangs snyan 'byin zhing g.yu mtsho'i phyogs su bskyod/ /ston gyi dus 'dir yar 'brog g.yu mtsho shin tu dwangs shing rab gsal bas/ /g.yu mtsho'i nang nas sngo bsangs nam mkha' dkar 'jam sprin gyi 'ja' tshon dang / /brdzid pa'i ri bo rtswa thang la sogs shin tu gsal bar snang gyur pa'i/ /gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin skyengs byed khyed ni gangs can gzhon nu'i dran shes mtsho/ /yid 'ong ngang phrug g.yu mtsho'i klong du 'phyo/ /g.yang dkar lu gu rtswa thang steng du rtse/ /ri dwags phru gu spang gshongs phang bar rol/ /be 'u nag po sbra gur 'gram nas rgyugs/ /srid pa'i gangs ri dkar po las bzhur zhing / /dwangs bsil zla shel zhun ma las bsgrubs pa'i/ /dal bur rgyu ba'i rab chu sngon mo'i nang / /gser gyi nya mo'i 'phar mchongs yi gar 'ong / /mgo bor stong skud dmar pos rab brgyan cing / /re lde'i gad ta'i nang du thang khug dang / /37

lag tu 'ur rdo thogs pa'i 'brog pa yis/ /'bri g.yag lhas ra'i phyogs su nye bar bkug /g.yang dkar bal gyi snying po las bsgrubs pa'i/ /shad ma sbu phrug bklubs pa'i 'brog mo yis/ /g.yon mar bzho zo g.yas par phye rtsam 'byer/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bzho 'bod lhang lhang 'then/ /'jam mnyen sor mo'i 'phrul gyi sgyu rtsal las/ /brgyud bzang sha shed legs pa'i 'bri mo yi/ /myos 'bur rdzing bu'i sgo glegs phye bas na/ /zhim mngar 'o ma nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /zho zom 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong / / 'bri mar ser po'i rba rlabs 'phyur ba'i tshe /'brog pa'i 'dzum mdangs sbas kyang shin tu gsal/ /'brog mo'i glu dbyangs dma' rung gsal bar thos/ /phyur skam gsos pa'i phung po ri ltar spungs/ /'bri mar ltang gi rtsig pa ba gam bzhin/ /sha mar thud kyi gter kha rab brdol bas/ /ro 'dzin gzhon nu'ang dbang med 'dar bar byas/ /ston gyi chu bo 'chi gsos bdud rtsi'i sman/ /ston ka'i dus kyi 'o ma mar khu dngos/ /ston gyi 'bri mar spang gi ser sha dang / /ston 'dir yod tshad bzang drug sman du grags/ /38

dgun/'ur lding rlung po rna ba'i lam du 'ur/ /grang reg tshor bas lus sems gnyis ka grang / /gang sar bu yug 'tshub cing kha bas gang / /dkar gtsang kha ba'i khrod kyi yar 'brog dkar/ / gangs phrug gzhon nu'i lte khrag 'pho sa mes po'i rtswa thang 'di yi steng / /mi gtsang ljan ldin mang pos khengs par dri bzhon thugs kyis ma bzod par/ /lang tsho'i stobs shugs shin tu bsgril te mi gtsang dngos po kun bsdus nas/ /bar snang dbyings su shugs kyis khyer bas 'ga' zhig g.yu mtsho'i nang du lhung / /de tshe g.yu mtsho sgeg mo rab khros pas//nga rgyal drag pos rlabs kyi khro gnyer g.yo/ /zhe sdang po'i har sgras gnam sa 'gengs//lus po'ang bsran tshugs bral te g.yo zhing 'dar//nyam chung chu bya'i tshogs rnams rab skrag ste/ /smre ngag shor yang thams cad gcig mthun gyis/ /stobs shugs mtshungs bral dgun gyi rlung po la/ /'thab pa'i phyir du rlung po'i dkyil du lding / /de nas g.yu mtsho'i sgeg mo cung zhi bas/ /brtse ba'i bya tshogs dbus su mngags pa dang / /rang gi med byung lang tsho bsrung ba'i thabs /sra mkhregs 'khyag pa'i go chas yongs su bklubs/ /39

g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin g.yu mtsho sgeg mo yis/ /dkar mdzes rgya dar dkar po klub pa'i tshe /rgyus meng skyes bus rgyus yod rlom pa'i tshul/ /shel dkar thang 'di chu shel red ces gleng / /phyi nang kun gsal 'khyag pa'i sgo khrab kyi/ /'og nas g.yu mtshos zhib par lta ba'i tshe/ /gzhan phan gtsang sbra ldan pa'i rlung po yis /srid pa'i ljan ldin ma lus sel bar mthong / /gzhung drang lhag bsam can gyi rlung po la/ /khros pa'ang g.yu mtsho thugs sems rab skyengs te/ /dgun rlung rgyu 'grul gtan nas ma 'chad bar/ /rab dkar 'khyag pa'i 'og tu ngo tshas yib/ /chu bo thams cad shel dkar gong bur gyur/ /sa gzhi chen mo grang ba'i zug rngus gas/ /khrung khrung dkar po'ang skyo bas smre ngag 'byin/ /dgun gyi dus 'dir yod tshad grang cang cang / /bzod par dka' ba'i dgun gyi grang ngar mda'/ /sbra gur nag pos 'geb par mi nus pas/ /'brog pa grang reg zug rngus mnar dogs te/ /khang pa'i nang du drod kyi go btsan bzung / /grang zug reg bya lus pos ma bzod par/ /gzhan rnams dro ba'i khung bur yib na yang / /40

sa mtho'i khyad nor g.yag gu rog po yis/ /shin tu dpa' tshul bstan te ri rtser 'gying / /'ur 'ur grang rlung bser bu g.yo ba'i khrod/ /lhung lhung kha ba'i me tog babs pas na/ /yangs yangs mu mtha' med pa'i yar 'brog yul/ /dkar dkar shel gyi sa gzhi'i sbun zlar gyur/ /dpyid dus yul 'dis bdud rtsi'i gru char gzhibs/ /dbyar dus g.yu yi lang tsho'i mdzes sdug ngoms/ /ston dus gser mdog nor bu'i rgyan gyis spud/ /dgun dus kha ba dkar po'i na bza' bklubs/ /lhag bsam dri bzhen rlung pos bskul ba yi/ /gangs can gzhon nu'i zhum med snying stobs kyi/ /rlabs phreng 'byur ba'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho 'di/ /srid mtha'i bar du'ang dwangs mar gnas par nges /rang lo 4 04441/'dod mji 'gogabamidran shesago khrab/rab mdzes brdzid nyams ldan pa'i bdag lus la/ /rtsa chen rnyed dka' srid na rin bral ba'i/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga'i ngur smig gos kyis spud/ /gzi byin ldan pa'i tshig rgyan zhwa ser rgyon/ / 4

mig sngar mdzes pa'i snyan ngag sham thabs bzhes/ /tshar du dngar ba'i mngon brjod ska ragasaḥngs/ /lci yang spel legs sdeb spyor phreng ba 'chang / /rang skyon gsal byed skar rtsis me long btags/ /dran shes khrab dang tshul khrims phub rgyan nas/ /lag tu shes rab ral gri zhig 'byer te/ /thal 'gyur rigs pa'i gar stabs zlos gar nyams/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo brjod kyis mi lang ngang / /cang shes blo gros rta pho'i steng bzhon nas/ /yangs shing rgya che'i shes rig thang chen steng / /brtson pa'i srab kyis kha lo'i dbang bsgyur bas/ /le lo rnam g.yeng phyogs su mi shor bar/ /rab bsgrims mi rtag lcag gis myur bskul te/ /'gro ba'i dus der lam gyi mdun phyogs nas/ /yid 'ong mdzes sdug ldan pa'i lus phra zhig /rin chen dar gyi na bza' lhabs se lhab/ /dbyangs snyan khu byug gsung skad snyan se snyan/ /rab mdzes mdongs mtha'i gar stabs shig shig ngang / /mdzes sdug nya rgyas dkyil 'khor bzhin ras nas/ /ut+pal dkyus ring mig gi zur mda' zhig /shin tu g.yo ba'i 'phrul gyis 'phangs na yang / /bdag lus dran shes go khrab rab btsan pas/ /42

sdom gsum srog la gnod med bde bar gnas/ /smin legs ma yis tshul de shes ma thag /bcos min 'dzum gyis mchu yi 'dab ma bshad/ /rab dkar tshems phreng ge sar legs bstan nas/ /brtse dung 'ching zhags yin zer lcagasasgrog zhig /klad la bskor zhing bdag gi lus por bcings/ /nga yis lag 'byer shes rab ral gri des/ /de ma thag tu 'ching zhags dum bur bcad/ /'on kyang sdug gu ma yi stongo bsom la/ /mda' dang zhags pas 'dad dan ma grub kyang / /'dod chags mdung gis thar srog gcod bsam nas/ /mig yangs ma de yid kyi shing rtas myos/ /ngag nas 'dod gtam g.yo 'phrul ci rigs byed/ /rtags can ma des klan ka'i mngon 'dod mdung / /lang tsho'i shugs kyis bdag la bsnun na yang / /bdag gi tshul khrims sra zhing mkhregs pa'i phub/ /'big par ma nus bya thabs dben nas lus/ /tshul de mthong bas phran gyi 'char sgo la/ /dran shes khrab dang shes rab ral gri dang / /tshul khrims sra zhing mkhregs pa'i phub med na/ /gzugs 'tshong ma des nga yi thar sgog dang / /sdom gsum rin chen nor bu 'phrog nges bsam/ /43

mig zur mda' dang g.yo sgyu'i 'ching zhags dang / /d+kus ma'i 'dzum dang mgo 'dod mdung la sogs/ /dgra chen rnams kyi dug mtshon 'gog nus pa'i/ /dran shes khrab dang tshul khrims phub btsan la/ /sdom ldan rnams kyis mig ltar gces par 'tshal/ /rang lo 0 000lo'i zla tshes6nyin/bzhes gnyen dang bral ba'i smre ngagamatshan mo'i mgon bzhin mig gi dpal gyur sku/ /maphywa nyid rig par dbang 'byor legs ltad gsung / /mtshan 'dzin spros bral ye shes mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /mawo ldan bshes gnyen dam pa snying nas dran/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i chu gter las/ /'byungs pa'i bshes gnyen rab dwangs tshes bdag des/ /gdul bya ku mud brtse bas ma bskyangs par/ /chu lha'i lto bar gzim pa snying nas dran/ /dwangs gtsang tshul khrims gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng / /thos bsam sgom pa'i rlan gsher la sogs las/ /yo byung ba'i bshes gnyen kun 'byung dpag bsam ljon/ /

skal dman dbul phongs bdag gi snying nasadran/ /rab dwangs thugs rgyud lha lam yangs pa mā /snying rje'i slog sprin lang long rab g.yos pas/ /gdul bya'i nyon than tsha ba'i gdung bsil ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dbyar gyi sbrang char snying nas dran/ /rnam dpyod mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shing / /lhag bsam dkar po'i zer 'od stong ldan gyis/ /skal ldan blo gsar chu skyes legs skyong ba'i/ /bshes gnyen rta bdun dbang po snying nas dran/ /yon tan nya gang skyon bral dwangs shing gtsang / /thun gsum 'gro la brtse bas rab bcings pas/ /sdug bsngal me lce bsil zhid mun sel ba'i/ /bshes gnyen ri bong 'dzin pa snying nas dran/ /rnam rtog rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rgyud brtan/ /byin chags tshad med bzhi yi bang rim can/ /rtsa chen 'phags nor bdun gyis legs bsgrubs pa'i/ /bshes gnyen sa 'dzin dbang po snying nas dran/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rnam dpyod gting mtha' bral/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rba klong rab tu 'phyur/ /45

yon to nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzang kun 'du ba'i/ /bshes gar+sā sin skyo'i bdag po snying nas dran/ /skyon kun bral ba'i thugs rgyud dkar gtsang la/ /gzhan phan mdzad bzang rta ljang gis bskul bas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i nying khu legs babs pa'i/ /bshesaganyen kha ba'i rdul brtsegs snying nasadran/ /sdom pa gsum gyi lo 'dab rab tu bshad/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i dri ngad phyogs bcur 'thul/ /skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan mchog /bzhes gar+sā chu yi lang tsho snying nas dran/ /rnam dpyod rtsal rdzogs shes bya'i gangs rir 'gying / /lung dang rigs pa'i gsung rab khur gyis bajid/ /bstan pa'i chom rkun wa skyes klad 'gems pa'i/ /bshes gar+sā gdong lnga'i dbang po snying nas dran/ /kye ma kye ma gdul bya'i bsod nams dman/ /kyi spyod kyi spyod bshes gnyen zhi bar gshegs/ /skyo zhing skyo zhing sdug bsngal khung bur tshud/ /46 babs shing babs shing mchi ma'i char rgyun babs/ /

'bod do 'bod do 'o dod snying nas 'bod/ /gson cig gson cig gser snyan dbang pos gson/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /skyobs shig skyobs shig 'di phyi bar do skyobs/ /zungs shig zungs shig thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs/ /drongs shig drongs shig 'khor ba'i gnas nas drongs/ /smon no smon no snying dbus snying nas smon/ /smon pa'i re 'bras 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lo 20 2000 lo'i zla 10tshes 25nyin/grags par gdams pa/rang rgyud dug mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong dkyil du/ /'dod chags drag po'i rba rlabs 'phyur ba'i 'og /med byung so thar gru gzings 'bying nyen pas/ /dran pa'i ded dpon ma g.yeng grogs mchog lags/ /mi shes mun nag mtshan mor rgyu ba yi/ /rnam rtog ma rungs g.yo can chom po 'dis/ /bslab gsum rin chen nor bu rku nyen pas/ /shes bzhin bya ra ma g.yeng grogs mchog lags/ /47

khrel dang ngo tshe'i gos bral gcer bur lus/ /tha shal ngan spyod rang gzugs gsal bar mngon/ /ya rabs dam pa skyengs pa'i gzhir gyur pas/ /tha mal gos spyon mi phan grogs mchog lags/ /smin legs sems rgyud 'khyog po'i gzhu mo las/ /'phos pa'i drang 'gro 'dod chags dug gi mdas/ /so thar srog gi dbang po 'gag nyen pas/ /tshul khrims go btsan zungs shig grogs mchog lags/ /thog ma khyim nas bzhud tshe dpa' skad kyis/ /lha chos gtsang ma bsgrub ces grwa sa 'grim/ /mtha' ma skya min ser min ngang tshul gyis/ /pha ma'i thugs dgongs ma dkrugs grogs mchog lags/ /srid gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig ngur smig gos/ /rnam pa kun tu 'bral med 'chang ba dang / /yang sgos bho ṭa'i srol dang mi mthun gos/ /dor nas gna' bo'i gzhung skyongs grogs mchog lags/ /skad rigs thams cad shes na legs mod de/ /bod pas bod skad brjed na mtshang yin pas/ /48

gzhan skad kho na spyad de rang gi rigs/ /brlag pa'i dug 'di spongs shig grogs mchog lags/ /mes po'i rig gzhung gser phye thal bar rtsi/ /gzhan gzhung phyag dar phung po gser phyer rlom/ /blang dor blo mig ldongs pa'i mngon zhen 'di/ /rmongs dad lags pas spongs shig grogs mchog lags/ /dpe char mi brtson mkhas pa'i go 'phang dang / /yon tan med kyang kun las rgyal 'dod 'di/ /rgyu med 'bras bu 'dod pa'i mtshang yin pas/ /spangs nas brtson pa'i go rgyu+on grogs mchog lags/ /sems can kun dang mi mthun dgra chen de/ /rang rgyal gzhan pham bsam ngan 'di lags pas/ /dman sa bzung ste kun dang 'cham mthun ngang / /gyong gun rang gis khur cig grogs mchog lags/ /spyad pas mi ngom 'dod yon spu gri'i sor/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs cung chags sbrang rtsi la/ /ldag na lce yi dbang po chad nyen pas/ /legs nyes blang dor ma 'phyug grogs mchog lags/ /rang lo 21 2001 lo'i zla 11tshes 5nyin/49

nges 'byung /drang bden byang chub sems kyi thugs bskyed des bskul bas/ /drang bden 'tshe med zhi bde'i lam bu ru gshegs pa'i/ /drang srong chen po kun mkhyen go bo yi ta mas/ /drang gtam smra ba'i zla bral spobs pa de stsol cig /mi gsal 'du byed kun slong ma rig gi me+ongs pas/ /kun nas bslangs te 'phen pa'i zag bcas kyi phung por/ /bag chags yongs su 'dzin pa'i las dbang gi rnam shes/ /zhugs pas sdug bsngal sdong po'i sa bon de btab bo/ / ming gzugs yongs su smin pas skye mched kun dod de/ /skye mched yul dang phrad pas 'jam rtsub kyi reg bya/ / bde sdug nyams su myong ba'i tshor ba de skyes pas/ /yang yang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar byung / /mi bzod sdug bsngal gsum gyi gting mtha' de dpog dka'/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs drag po ru 'phyur ba'i/ /mi bden skad cig g.yo ba snying med kyi 'khor bar/ /dga' bas zhen chags 'os pa cung zad tsam ma mchis /50

dbyar dus chu 'dzin gzhen nu'i bzhin ras kyi dbus nas/ /dwangs bsil gru char me tog sil sil du 'thor bas/ /shin tu bshad pa'i yid 'ong mdzes sdug gi dpal yang / /dbang po'i gzhu bzhin yal bas skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /mtshar sdug 'od chags gzhon nu'i lang tsho yi me tog /shin tu mdzes pas yid dbang cig car du 'phrog kyang / /mi rtag rga ba'i sad kyis bkrag mdangs kun bcom ste/ /sdong rgan skam po'i lus por skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /skra bcad lus bsgyur khyim pa'i cha lugs kun spangs te/ /rlabs chen sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chos sgo ru zhugs kyang / /rnga rol 'ur sgras lha 'dre dkrog pa la brtson pa'i/ /grong chog mkhan po'i mdzad par skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /mtshungs bral lung dang rigs pa'i rtsal chen de rdzogs shing / /sgra dang tshad ma'i mche sder ral gri ltar rno yang / /legs bshad gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i rig pa yi seng ge/ /'dod yon grong du 'phyan par skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /mu med dkar 'jam shog bu'i thang chen gyi steng la/ /rlung gi shugs 'chang cang shes blo gros kyi rta pho/ /51

snyan rtsom gom 'gros spo bar thogs pa rang med kyang / /la rgya'i gser srab chad par skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /shin tu dka' bas bsgrubs pa'i bsags srung gi nor dang / /'bad brtson chen pos sbyangs pa'i med byung gi yon tan/ /zhabs rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin tshor med ngang yal bas/ /sngar byas las kyi 'bras bur skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /lha chos sgrub par 'di snang zhen thag de ma 'chad/ /'dod yon longs su spyod par phyi ma ru 'jigs te/ /re dwogs ngang nas mi tshe stong zad du gtong ba'i/ /da lta'i bya bar bsam tshe skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /re 'ga' dben ri'i phug par khu sim du yib 'dod/ /skabs re rgyal khams bskor ba'i 'dun pa yang 'gog med/ /ma 'ongs 'dun phugs 'dam gyi phur pa dang 'dra bar/ /mi brtan shin tu g.yo bas skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /skye 'gro'i tshe srog chu yi chu bur dang mtshungs shing / /'tsho ba'i don go rang dbang bde skyid de yin rung / /rtag par las med snang ba gang dran gyis 'da' ba'i/ /mdo med 'khyam po'i 'tsho bar skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /52

mdza' ba'i gnyen bshes rgud par chags zhen gyis ma bzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo skyid par phrag dog gis ma bzod/ /snying gi bde skyid dkrugs pa'i chags sdang gi phung 'dres/ /nyin mtshan kun tu gnod pas skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /dga' ba'i dus su ngo bstod 'brug sgra ltar ldir la/ /sdug pa'idus na ngo gdong lto sprin bzhin gnag pa/ /rgyun du mi brtan g.yo ba'i glog zhags der 'gran pa'i/ /khrel med grogs ngan gshis la skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /mdun du kha nas brtse dung dri bsung zhig 'thul la/ /rgyab tu rkub kyis 'phyon ma'i rtug dri de 'byin zhing / /thang ga'i ri mo 'dra ba'i brtse grogs kyi ngo srung / /shin tu gsal bar rig pas skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /byams dang brtse ba'i bka' drin mtshungs zla dang bral ba'i/ /grong gseb skyed ma dwangs gtsang grong khyer nang phebs skabs/ /khrel med bu yis gzhal dka'i bka' drin kun brjed de/ /skyug bro mthong chung byed par skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /dmangs kyi khrag dang rngul chu'i thigs pa de gzhibs nas/ /'khor 'bangs mi ser skyid sdug snying dbus nas brjed pas/ /thugs spro'i log 'tshor rtag tu bag med kyis rol ba'i/ /53

khrel med dpon ngan 'tsho bar skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /rang nyid bde na gzhan la ci zhig kyang phod pas/ /shin tu don chung rgyan gos 'ba' zhig gi ched du/ /nyes med ri dwags du ma'i tshe srog de 'phrog nas/ /pags gos rgyan du rloms par skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /lhag bsam snying rje'i mtsho mo gting nas su bskam pas/ /ma bcos zas kyi yang bcud nas rtsam gyi sman las/ /'bu srin za ba lus por phan snang zhig rlom ste/ /srin po'i brtul zhugs 'dzin par skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /gsar thon khyi yi lud kyang rin r+sā du rtsi la/ /rnying na gser phye yin yang thal ba rang rtsi ba'i/ /gsar zhen ling rtag mthug pos rnam dpyod kyi blo mig /ldongs pa'i sngon thon can der skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /deng gi bya spyod thams cad than ltas rang rtsi zhing / /gna' bo'i srol rgyun yod rgu dge mtshan du rlom ste/ /rjes lus mun pa'i thag pas lus sems kun bcings pa'i /bag 'khum rnying zhen can der skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /skad yig rig gzhung pha yul gsar pa yi ched du/ /zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i lhag bsam til 'bru tsam med par/ /54

rang gi bu phrug dngul phog kho na yi don du/ /slob grwar gtong ba'i bsam par skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /gangs can rig gzhung lhag bsam stobs ldan gyi skyes bur/ /ngo mtshar 'jo sgeg med byung tshan rig gi mdzangs ma/ /bag mar bsus te thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas/ /rang rigs rgyas par mi byed skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /lhag par bho ṭa'i pha skad dwangs gtsang gi bu mo/ /mi mthun gzhan gyi skad dang btsan shugs kyis bsdebs pas/ /rgya skad bod skad min pa'i nal phrug gi phung 'dres/ /pha khyim 'phrog tu dwogs pas skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /mdor na rang rigs ched du legs skyes de ma nus/ /brtse ldan pha mar bsnyen bkur zhabs tog kyang ma bsgrubs/ /khrel dang la rgya gzhan phan snying rje sogs med kyang / /gangs phrug gzhen nur 'bod pas skyo ba zhig skyes byung / /rang lo 25 2005 lo'i zla 9tshes 7sko/skyon mtshang dong sprugam dad mkhris pa'i nad chen gdug pa yis/ /55

dag snang mig gi dbang po bslad pas na/ /'di na mi shes yul du gyur pa yi/ /mchog dman mtha' dag skyon gyi ser por mthong /ma rig mun pa mthug po'i dong du lhungs/ /bdag 'dzin lcags sgrog dam pos lus sems bcings /chags sdang dug gi dbyug pas brdungs pas na/ /'bor ba'i btson ra 'di ru nyon re mongs/ /thog ma skyed ma'i mngal nas btsa' ba'i tshe/ /kha mig thams cad khrag dang bshang gcis btums/ /bzod dka'i ngu skad 'don 'go brtsam ma thag /skyon gyi chu mig yongs su brdol ba yin/ /bsnyen bkur snyan grags rgyu nor longs spyod dang / /rang gi 'dod pa'i bde skyid 'thob pa'i slad/ /bcos ma'i tshul 'chos dar gos bsal bas na/ /mi sdug skyon gyi rang gzugs 'di dag mngon/ /rin chen gser khrir 'gying ba'i bla chen tshor/ /gtsang mkhas gzhan phan yon tan til tsam dben/ /grub mthar phyogs ris shin tu che ba 'dis/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid med nas bshig /56

sa dge bka' rnying chos lugs so so'i thad/ /phan tshun sdang zhugs drag po byed pa tshos/ /grub mtha' gang zhig dar yang gangs can gyi/ /rig gzhung dar ba tsam yang ma shes mtshang / /mi tshe thos par bskyal ba'i mtshan nyid pas/ /tha snyad tshig 'khri skam por gces pa las/ /chos dang rang rgyud mnyam du ma bsres pas/ /rang rgyud shing skam bzhin du rengs 'di mtshang / /mu+on pa'i malo du ma rig gti mug sgom/ /stang cha rnam rtag la klung kun la nyul/ /gsal cha rgyu nor re skug ma 'gag pa'i/ /zung 'jug dug gsum sgom pa'i rnal 'byor mtshang ri /btsun pa yongs kyi zhabs 'dren sprul ming dang / /rnal 'byor kun gyi zhabs 'dren ral can gnyis/ /rdzun gyi gong bu 'di gnyis thon pas na/ /shes ldan rnams kyi dad pa nyams pa'i mtshang / /lha pa mo pa blang dor me long 'dzin/ /rtag tu lha gsol klu gsol dus 'da' zhing/ /57

la klung yongs rdzogs gshin 'dre gson 'dre yis/ /khengs par 'dzin 'di rmongs dad mun pa'i mtshang / /brgya lor ched du rgya mo gtsug tu bkur/ /chos dang mi gshis ngo tsha sdom pa sogs/ /dngul dang brjes te sngon byon mkhas grub kyi/ /rdzun 'bag rgyu+on pa rgya nyul mkhan po'i mtshang / /rang nyid za rgyag spyod gsum bya ba'i ched/ /mi rigs la rgya dmangs kyi khe phan 'tshong / /skog za'i mgrin pa sgra gcan dang mtshungs pa/ /log 'tshor rol ba'i dpon ngan rnams kyi mtshang / /bag 'khum skyid lug gdon gyis gzir bas na/ /pha yul legs skyes 'bul rgyu gting nas brjed/ /rgyun du chang rag sho sbag rgyan 'dzugs la/ /rol ba'i skye bo de dag rjes lus mtshang / /rnam dpyod blo mig cung zad ldan na yang / /rang rigs don du rtsom yig mi spel bar/ /rang gi khe phan rtsom yon kho na'i ched/ /dus chen che bstod sgrug pa'i rtsom de mtshang / /58

bho ṭa'i rig gzhung rgya mtsho rdzab chur rtsi/ /gzhan lta mchog 'dzin skom gyis rab gdungs pas/ /gsar dar gzhan gyi rig gzhung smig sgyu la/ /yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsir 'dzin 'di mtshang / /bod yig rmang gzhi bzang ba'i lo chung 'gas/ /tshan rtsal deng rabs sngon thon rig gnas rnams/ /srol dang 'gal bar brtsis te spong ba yang / /bod ljongs yar rgyas 'gog pa'i rnying zhen mtshang / /rgyal gnyer bod kyi slob grwa mang po'i nang / /rgya yig dbyin yig slob tshan mang ba las/ /bod yig slob tshan shin tu nyung drags pas/ /bho ṭa'i skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i mtshang / /gangs can mi rigs gong spel gleng na yang / /rgya skad bod skad bsres te smra nus na/ /deng rabs shes yon can du rlom pa 'di/ /bho ṭa'i mi rigs rtsa brlag 'gro ba'i mtshang / /bod kyi grong gseb lung khug mang po'i nang / /phyug gyur lam bur mos pa'i pha ma 'gas/ /bu phrug slob grwa 'grim du mi 'jug par/ /59

zhor las yong 'bab gsog par gtong 'di mtshang / /sgor mo'i ched du mi rigs la rgya 'tshong / /'tsho gnas ched du pha sha za yang spobs/ /gsar gtod ched du rig dngos spong ba rnams/ /snyigs dor bcud len mi shes klad med mtshang / /mdor na mthun sgril lhag bsam mi ldan na/ /mi bzod chags sdang srid pa'i dgra chen 'di/ /chung na khyim tshang che na 'dzam gling yongs/ /rdul phran bzhin du rlog pa'i skyon mtshang yin/ / skyon mtshang dong sprug ces pa'i skyon mtshang 'di/ /skyon gyi gong bu su la phog na yang / /skyon las yon tan mi mthong kho bo yis/ /skyon sel tshul du nongs pa gsol re kan/ /rang lo 26 2006 lo'i zlo 10tshes 9nyin/thub bstan ra ba smad dgan/mdzes sdug ngo mtshar 'bum gyis phyug gyur pa'i/ /'dzam gling gtsug rgyan gangs can bho ṭa yi/ /

thog ma'i 'byung gnas bod ljongs lho kha zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags pas sa gsum dog par byas/ /de yi cha shas gong dkar rdzong chen gyi/ /lte bar gnas pa'i ra smad mdzes sdug la / /'khyam po bdag gi yid dbang rab g.yos te/ /gang dran rtsom gyi ca co sgrog par 'dod/ /dwangs gtsang yar klung gtsang po'i nye 'dabs su/ /rab yangs nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i phang ba rtswa /gnas pa'i skyid gshongs yul gru'i mdzes rgyan te/ /gong dkar ra smad ces pa'i grags pas khyab /dwangs gtsang lag mthil ltar mnyam gong dkar rdzong gi lte ba'i lam chen steng / /steng phyogs lha yul mog par byed pa'i ra smad grwa tshang mjal dang lhan/ /lhan cig lam 'gram ljon shing phreng tshogs sngo ljang na bzas bklubs gyur nas/ /nas chang bdud rtsi'i nying khu thogs te nyid kyi phebs bsur chas pa bzhin/ /lam 'gram shin tu 'grig pa'i rdo gcal dang / /bar bar mdzes pa'i me tog sna mang sogs/ /yid 'ong lta na sdug pa'i mdzes ljongs kyis/ /skye bo'i yid kyi spro ba ngang gis 'phel/ /gna' deng bzo rtsal mdzes pa'i khang bzang dang / /61

lam bar mi tshogs mang ba'i khrom lam du/ /ltad mor g.yengs te mdun du phebs pa'i mthar/ /rdzong gi lam po che yi bzhi mdor slebs/ /gzhon nu dar ma'i lag mthil rab skyengs pa'i/ /ra smad lam du sku nyid zhugs gyur te/ /dal bur byon pa'i 'dren byed gzigs mo la/ /dpal ldan ra smad rnam rgyal khang bzang dngos/ /yid 'ong rta babs bzhi ldan rgyal sgo'i steng / /gser zhun mdangs 'dzin ri dwags pho mo dang / /sprin dkar gsham bu mdzes pa'i klong dkyil du/ /ra smad ces pa'i sgo byang gsal bar mngon/ /mdzes mdzes bzo bkod legs pa'i ra smad dgon/ /dkar dkar rdo thal dkar pos mchog tu sbud/ /dmar dmar rab mdzes yid 'ong spen bad steng / /lhang lhang gsil ba'i dril bu rna ba'i dpyid/ /gser mngal can gyi blo las ma thon la/ /bi shā kame'i phyag gis ma bskrun kyang / /bkod legs gzi byin 'bar ba'i dgon sde 'di/ /'jig rten lha mi'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing / /dkar nag rdo yi sgyu rtsal las grub pa'i/ /ngo mtshar dga' 'khyil g.yung drung ri mo yis/ /62

mchog tu mdzes pa'i khod snyoms rdo gcal de/ /bho ṭa'i srol rgyun ngom pa'i phul du gyur/ /phra ldem mnyen lhug ldan pa'i lang tsho ngom zhing g.yu yi bsil grib 'chang ba'i ljon shing dang / /dwangs gtsang dben zhing nyams dga' shin tu skyid pa'i mu 'brel grwa shag rnams kyi mdun ngos su/ /kho ra khor yug in+d+ra'i yang zhun lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i sngo ljang yid 'ong gling kha'i nang / /mig gi bdud rtsi rkang 'thung rigs dang me rtag tshogs kyis sum rtsen tshal yang skyengs par byas/ /bzo bkod rab tu mdzes pa'i rdo skas dang / /dwangs gtsang dkar cha dod pa'i sgo 'phyor 'og /med du byung ba'i srid pa'i 'khor lo dang / /rmor chen phyag bstar ldebs bris sogs kyis mdzes/ /'du khang nang du rten gyi gtso bo ste/ /zhabs drung kun dga'i thugs rten sgrol ljang dang / /thub pa'i dbang po nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs/ /byin can rten gzhan grangs med rab tu bzhugs/ /yul skor rnams kyi spyan gyi gzigs mo dang / /dad ldan kun gyi phyag mchod bya ba'i yul/ /bla ma lha khang chos grwa khang chen sogs/ /gzim chung la sogs lha khang gzhan yang mchis /63

gsang phu bla khag bcu yi ya gyal du/ /gyur pa'i stag tshang ra smad gra tshang 'di/ /spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi'i dus dkyil du/ /gling smad shes rab dpal ldan mchog gisabatab/ /gsang phu'i gdan rabs so lnga gling smad pas/ /gsang phu'i grwa tshang smad du rdo ba yi/ /ra ba bskor te 'chad nyan gnang bas na/ /ra ba smad kyi ming yang de ltar thogs/ /mkhas dbang sde bdun bstan pa rab gsal dang / /stag phrug kun dka' dpal 'byor gtso byas pa'i/ /rab 'byams mdo sngags smra dbang du ma yis/ /bshad sgrub zung gis nyin mtshan 'da' bar byas/ /de rjes ra smad mkhan thogs bcu pa mchog /skyabs rje 'phrin las dpal 'byor dus skabs su/ /jo bos lung bstan mdzad pa'i sa gzhi ste/ /skyid gshongs yul gru 'di ru gnas spos mdzad/ /shel grong mchod khang rtsed thang 'bras bu gling / /rdza yul byams sems dgon gyis gtso byas pa'i/ /bu dgon bco lnga khang tshan lnga tsam mchis/ /lhag par ra smad mkhan thogs nyer lnga pa/ /snyan brgyud mnga' bdag rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / /64

gang des ra smad gdan rabs 'dzin pa'i skabs/ /mkhas grags dbyar rngas 'dzin ma'i pha mtha' brgal/ /mdor na gling smad shes rab dpal ldan nas/ /ra ba smad pa'i mkhan thogs zhe gcig pa/ /skyabs rje ngag dbang dpal 'byor ye shes bar/ /mkhas grub du mas gdan sa rgyas par bskyangs/ /dpag med bka' drin gzhal zla ma mchis pa'i/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa mchog /bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa gcig pu ste/ /bshes gnyen chen po dpal 'byor ye shes kyis/ /phyi nang gang sar nyams gso rgya cheraganang / /bshad grwa gsar btsugs dge 'dun du ma bsdus/ /skal ldan gdul bya smin grol 'god pa sogs/ /lung rtogs zung gi bstan pa rgya cher spel/ /zhi dul dad brtson ldan pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /bstan 'gro'i don la sman par gyur pa'i ched/ /shes rig spyi dang bho ṭa'i rig gzhung la/ /nyin mtshan dbyer med 'dzin skyong spel bzhin mchis/ /de ltar ra smad lo rgyus chu gter las/ /cung zad blangs pa bdud rtsi'i gru char 'di/ /65

don gnyer rnams kyi sems kyi zhing sa rtswa /dad pa'i myu gu bshad pa'i gsos su bran/ /yang yang snying gi dbus nas rab dran pa'i/ /ring ring lo mang gshib pa'o chos grogs rnams/ /dung dung brtse ba'i 'brel thag ma chad bar/ /skyid skyid ra smad dgon du mjal bar smon/ /

sa'a'i 'i7 pho5rab dkar yid kyi gangs ri'i rtse mo nas/ /dwangs gtsang la rgya'i btī+o rma po 'a / /nyes skyon phung po ma lus sel ba dang / /sa rig ba dan g.yo ba'i du ldangs/ /ts+tsharku~X/tsho cistodhaḥ tshohūṃjikhropruṭ+wāṃram̐rnyocitshocicici cici cicichi/kādurdzumi(/cirtse ༷ dudroṭ+wāṃ hūṃ tram̐rje tsūhūṃbye /༷ citwe‘ci/shābye / rdo sh+laur+ṣami⑩/ sto stergyurngo 1ci rīrtsitsho citho hūṃ tso klo ṅgelngelngaritshordosho )miciciwa tshoXpehūṃXshāsh+laulho/ṅge/sprerīchik+ṣe+otram̐k+ṣiṃsh+laulhed+ngharnyedzi rmitsa rmorme9dze/sprerngoX d+dha tsho (tshodī lnge ༷tshoXṣ+yorte /dzāstsatshoci phu ṭ+wāṃ.au/ ḍā/dh+wa smibyeskyeci ༷ cipy-i cimi ci〉 dzosh+tsatsho— dz+wa tsho mornyacicire4 rtsisnacicicirmyordzatram̐rda ṣ+ṭih+phucichami rtsi0 cirmokyemirdo dhe tsho tsho3ji — ci— ci 2r+ṣaṭ+wāṃ mirdo ci ri cici ri ji dzethetre — rdzo rmo ci ci tsho ri —67

zhi bde'i bgrod lam/ye ma/gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam/byams pa dang snying rje/byang chub kyi sems bskyed/spyi snyoms kyi bsam pa/ 'di ni/bde skyid kyi sa bon/'tsho gnas kyi rmang gzhi/yar rgyas kyi dngos rgyu/mthun sgril gyi bla srogayod 3 kyi yod 3/skye 'gro kun gyi spyi nor/red lags/byams pa dang snying rje/gzhan phan dang lhag bsam/khyed dang bral ba'i/chos dang rig gzhung /tshan rig dang sngon thon sogs ni/

yid can kun la/dngos brgyud gang rung gi sgo nas/sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu ster ba'i/bzod bral gyi btsan dug dngos/lhag tu/spyi snyoms kyi bsam pa'i lcags kyu mi ldan par/tshan rtsal gyi glang spyon bag med du bzhon tshe/'jig rten hril po/dngangs skrag dang /ngu sgras khengs nges la/snying 'jags kyi yul gru kun rdog pas brdzis/zungs khrag dmar po'i rgya mtsho 'khyil nges/daphyod dang / dga' zhen dang 'khon 'dzin/bde skyid dang sdug bsngal/rjes lus dang sngon thon/bsam pa'i 'byer so 'dra min tsam la thug pas/phyi dngos po'i 'phel rgyas las/nang sems kyi 'phel rgyas gtso bor 'dzin/gzhan phan dang spyi stoms kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon bskrun dgos/wa ye/mtho sgang gi gzhon nu/ khyed rang /

bsil ldan kha ba'i ldongs su gnas kyang /bskal pa'i bar du'ang mi sangs pa'i/rmongs gnyid stug por yur na/mi rigs gzhan pa'i rnam daphyod kyi chu 'dzin las ldir ba'i tshan rtsal gyi dbyar rnga thos sam/longs dang /gangs ri'i bu phrug tsho/pha mesakyi snying nor/srol bzang gi dwangs ma/mi rigs kyi bla srog ste/byams dang snying rje'i rnam shes/tshol rtsal gyi lus por grong 'jug byed mi ran nam/'an kyang /gangs can gyi gzhen nu/brgya lor kho na'i ched du/mi rabs phyi ma'i mdun lam btsongs tshe/bho ṭa'i zhabs 'dren/la rgya'i 'khyam po/mi rigaso kyi chom rkun/gsan dang /nga tsho'i/pham kha dang /70

nor 'khrul/phung gzhi ni/nga rgyal dang phyogs 'dzin/rang rnyas 'dzin gyi bsam ga 'di rnams red/nga tsho'i/ rgyal kha dang /dge mtshan ni/snying rje dang /spyi sems/bdag gzhan 'dra mtshungs kyi bsam pa 'di dag red/gal te/byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi dngos rgyu byas pa'i/tshan rtsal zhig dar rgyas phyin tshe/'dzam gling 'di bde ba can gyi zhing khams su 'gyur nges la/gal te/nga rgyal dang chags sdang gis dngos rgyu byas pa'i/tshan rtsal zhig dar rgyasaphyin tshe/'dzam gling 'di mnar med pa'i dmyal khams su 'gyur nges/rgyu mtshan ni/khyed kyis me shugs 'phur mda' dang /rdul phran mtshon cha'i drag shugs ngoms tshe/gzhan gyis kyang de ltar ngom nges la/khyed kyis zhi bde dang spyi phan gyi lhag bsam bcangs tshe/7

gozhan gyis kyang de ltar 'chang nges pas so/ /sams dang /mkhyen spyan dang mig rgyang ring ba'i mkhas dbang rnams/spyi snyoms kyi bsam pa dang bral ba'i/nang zhabrug can/phyogs 'dzin gyi skye bo rnams dang /gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam dang bral ba'i/zhi bde'i dgra/phyi gling pa'i 'jigs skul ring lugs kyi ngang tshul la/bsom tshe/mdar na/'byung 'gyur skye bo kun gyi/khe phan dang /'tsho gnas/bde skyid bcas kyi ched/nga tsho kun gyis/gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam/byams pa dang snying rje/byang chub kyi sems bskyed/spyi snyoms kyi bsam pa ste/zhi bde'i bgrod lam du mi skyod thabs med yin lags/ /72

mimadzo' smro/sngo bsangs in+d+ra nī la'i nam mkha'/dkar 'jam zho gsar spungs pa'i chu 'dzin/drod 'jam gser 'od 'phro ba'i nyi ma/shel dkar mchod rten brtsegs pa'i gangs ri/sprin dkar dum bur 'chad pa dwangs bsil gyi rbab chu/g.yu mdog nu 'bur skyengs pa sngo ljang gi spang ri/rab yangs mu mtha' bral ba mthon mthing gi rtswa thang /khra chil rnam par bkra ba me tog gi dri bsung /mtshar sdug lang tshos snyem pa rkang 'thung gi sgeg nyams/g.yang gzar brag ri rgan pos sprin dkar og tshom ngom pa'i zhing khams/ye ma/de dag las kyang khyad du 'phags pa ni/ bsil ldan kha ba ri pa'i shes rig gi skyed tshal nang /'tsho gnas gnang ba'i gangs gzhon gyi mdza' mo ste/bho ṭo'i skad yig mdzes ma khyed nyid/gsan dang /gnas lnga rig pa'i mdzes sku/snyan ngag gi lang tsho/73

zlos gar dang skar rtsis kyi sgyu rtsal/mngon brjod dang tshig rgyan gyi 'jo sgegagasar gtod dang phugs bsam gyi zur mig g.yo bzhin/la rgya dang brtse sems kyi bdag nyid/dge mtshan 'bum gyis phyug pa'i mdza' mo lags/khyed ni/gzhan phan lhag bsam gyi 'byung khungs/mi rigs la rgya'i srol 'dzin/blo dkar gzhung drang gi mig dpe/'dzad med rig dngos kyi gter mdzod/gangs can mi rigs kyi bla srog ngo ma khyed ni/yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten/rang rigs bsrung bar go khrab/blo mig 'byed par thur ma/dge mtshan stsol bar ljon bzang /mtho sgang bod kyi khyim 'dzin/phyi rabs blo gsar ba'i skyed ma/red lags/mdza' mo khyed ni/nye ring gi dri mas ma gos pas/mi chen dpon po'i lha lcam/74

nyam chung gi 'dug rogs/grwa gzhon gyi rtse rogs/dwa phrug gi ma yum/'khyam po'i snying nye/bod gangs can skye 'gro yongs kyi snying nor red/'chor sgeg rmad du byung ba'i mdza' mo lags/khyed kyi rin bral lang tshor/lo rgyus dang dus rabs kyi rdung rdega'akhyam po'i lag grib sogs phog myong yod srid la/khyed kyi bzhin ras la/srol rgyun 'bri maro/gsar byung sha gsas kyang / byugs myong yod srid mod/'on kyang / lhan skyes kyi lang tsho/bcos min gyi ngo gdong /lhad med kyi thugs sems/nam yang 'gyur ba med pas/nga tsho'i yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrogakye kye/ thon mi'i sras mo/gangs gzhon gyi 'dun ma/brtse ldan bho ṭa'i skad yig lags/dkar 'ardzam shog bu'i ngos nas/75

mig lam brgyud mdza' sems kyi mtsho mor phebs/lang tsho'i me tog bshad pa'i bod gangs can gzhon nur snying gtam shod/mdza' gcig rtse dgas myos pa'i mdza' mo lags/blo gros lang tsho 'phel ba'i gangs gzhon/yid la brnag bya 'dod gdung gi skru long rgyas/sngar med rtse 'dzo gsar pa'i dga' ston la rol bar 'dod kyang /phyi bshol/ le lo/rnam g.yeng gi mal du bag 'khum dang /chog 'dzin gyi gnyid du yur na/mdza' mo khyed la zur mig tsam yang mi lta bas/drang bden brtse sems kyi zhags pa dang /mig zur yid kyi lcags kyus/dbang du bsdus/ khyed kyi gtan grogs dang /bho ṭa'i pha khyim 'dzin par/snying stobs dang stobs shugs stsol cigazla bral gdung sems can gyi mdza' mo lags/dngos gnas/ khyed dang bral na nga tshor/ la rgya dang gzi brdzid/shes rig dang mdun lam/sogs dang bral bar nges la/gsar gtod kyi 'char snang /'phel rgyas kyi spobs sems/76

rang tshugs kyi dran shes/sngon thon thabs lam 'tshol ba'i lam bu ni de bas kyang rnyed mi srid/bzod pa'i go cha bzhes pa'i mdza' mo lags/ngo ma/ khyed la sgro btags dang mthong chung /phan med dang rjes lus kyi zhwa mo bkon na/nga tsho bho ṭa'i mi brgyud 'di/klad med bla 'khyams/blang dor gyi blo mig ldongs pa'i dmus long yin pas/'od stong 'phro ba'i lo rgyus/srid na dkon pa'i rig dngos/gtsug lag smregs bam sogs la/gces spras mi thub la/rang dang mi rabs rjes mar/bla na med pa'i phugs bsam/bde skyid kyi mdun lam nam yang 'tshol mi thub/dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i mdza' mo lags/khyed la zol med brtse sems bcangs/yod tshad kyi yod tshad/snying gi grogs mor bcol na/rnying chen bag 'khum/rjes lus gtan nas ma yin la/tshan rig gi lang tsho dang /

rang as kun spyod bzang ba'i/gzhan gyi skad yig mdzes ma/bodagangasatsogatso nu'i sa marabasusanane khrelar+sāglad radebasakyang mayin lags/a ho/ mkhas mdzangs med du byung ba'i mdza' mo lags/khyed kyis/bod gangs can mi rigs la 'dzin pa'i la rgya/gangs phrug gzhen nur bcangs pa'i brtse sems/phugs bsam dang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs/mi rigs 'di dang mi rigs 'di yi rig gzhung ne/zla bral spobs pa'i drang gtam ste/lhad med snying khongs nas brdol ba'i chas r+sā gyi snying gto de dgasgra 'dzin lam du gyur ma thag 'khram po kho bo'ang /lus kyi ba spu g.yos/ ngag gi skad sgra 'dar/yid la lhag bsam dang la rgya'i rlabs phreng drag tu 'phyur bas mi rigs kyi la rgya dang /khyed la bcangs pa'i brtse sems nam mkha' ma zhig bar gnas nges/zhi dul thugs gshis bzang ba'i mdza' mo lags/nyid la/ gangs phrug gzhon nus/dga' zhen dang yid ches/gces spras dang srung skyobs/lhag bsam dang sems khur byed pa rnams/rnying zhen bag 'bum gyi 'ja thag ma yin par rang rigasate/78 bho ṭa'i shes ldan skye bos/

rang skad yig la bcangs pa'i la rgya yin par e mkhyen/kwa ye/ yab rje thon mi'i sras mo/med byung gi mdza' mo ste/brtse ldan bod kyi skad yig lags/khyed kyang / gangs gzhon rnams dang rgyun du 'grogs/yab rje thon mi'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i/mi rabs phyi ma skye 'tshag ma byas na/gangs can skad yig smra ba'i rigs brgyud/rabs chad rtsa brlag tu phyin tshe/nga tsho/ sngon thon dang deng rabs can gyi lam bur bskyod kyang /mi rigs kyi rin thang dang bral ba'i/nad ro zhig tu 'gyur bar thugs kyis bzod dam/gson dang / gangs gzhon gyi mdza' mo lags/mdor na/ khyed mchog ni/nga tsho/ bod kha ba can skye 'gro yongs kyi/lam ston gyi 'dren byed/mthun sgril gyi bla srogal rgya yi snying dmar/mi rigs kyi srog rtsa/yod tshad kyi gces nor/ 79

mitshe'ib11da 'che'ib /bod krita sdongabaskyod ba/kho bos sngar 'das zin pa'i lo chung gi dus tshod la phyi mig cig lta dus/ slob grogs rnams ni rang rang gi slob sbyong la brtson/ gya gyu dang rnam g.yeng / phyi bshol dang bag med/le lo sogs kyis ma gos/ drang bden dang dran shes/ brtson 'grus dang mngon zhen/bag phebs dang gus zhabs/ gzhan phan sogs ya rabs kyi spyod pas phyug lhag bsam dang nyam chung mtshan ldan gyi sgo nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar rol bas/ de dag rnams ni yid can kun gyi 'dren byed kyi mdzes rgyan dang / sgra 'dzin gyi bdud rtsi/ rig gnas kyi bdag po/ lo rgyus kyi deb ther/ ya rabs kyi mthun dpe/ mi rigs kyi la rgya/ srol bzang gi byed po/ drang bden gyi rkang gnyis su gyur/ kun gyi cha 'jog gi yul dang /bsngags 'os kyi gnas/ /bkur 'os kyi mi/ blo dkar gyi grogs po/gces 'os kyi khyad nor/yon tan gyi rgya mtsho/ 'gyur med kyi rdo rje/ lhad med kyi gser zhun/ dwangs gtsang gi shel dkar dang gnyis su ma mchis/ de bzhin bdag kyang ya rabs kyi mi bzang rnams la mig dpe bltas te/ phyis 'byung gi mdun lam lam log tu mi shor bar/ phyis shes rmongs ba glang rdzi bo'i khrod du mi 'phyan pa'i sems shugs snying gi khong / rus pa'i gting du bcangs nas/ blo dkar dang bden 'dzin gyi la rgya/ ngom med kyi slob sbyong / zhum med kyi brtson 'grus/ sra mkhregs kyi go cha/ dor med kyi dran shes sogs kyi sgo nas rlabs chen mdzad bzang gi lam bu'i thog tu mi tshe bskyod 'dod kyi sems shugs snying dbus nas skye khul byas/ 'on kyang / kho bo ni kha bshad chu yi lha ba dang / lag len gser gyi thigs ṭ+wāṃḍi dpe ltar chags/ gang yin zer na/ kha bshad dang stong bsam la cha bzhag na ni/ kha

nas snyan ngag mkhas can slob dpon dbyug pa can lta bu zhig kyang byed nges dang / stong bsam yang de bzhin du 'khor/ skabs 'gar rig pa'i gnas lngar dbang 'byor ba'i nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta zhig kyang byed 'dod zer/ skabs 'gar stong gsum skad kyis chod pa'i 'byor ldan gyi mi drag zhig kyang byed 'dod zer/ skabs 'gar dpa' rtsal do med kyi drag rtsal mkhas can zhig kyang byed nges zer/ skabs 'gar sdom gsum nor gyis phyug pa'i kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen lta bu zhig kyang byed nges zer/ skabs 'gar rigs gzugs yon tan lang tsho shes rig sogs kyi sgo nas skye bo kun gyi smon bya'i yul dang bsngags bya'i gnas su gyur nas/snyan pa'i grags pas dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor kun tu dbyar rnga ltar ldir/ dbu 'phang gi ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor bsnyegs shing / mdor na/ che 'dod dang grags 'dod ni ri rgyal lhun po bas kyang che ba zhig byed 'dod zer/ ha ha/ gong gi stong bsam dang kha 'chal de dag rnams ni/ mkhas pa rnams thugs khrel ba'i rgyu dang / blun po rnams kyis kyang ba'ad bgad byed pa'i gnas su 'gyur nges/ gang lags she na/ de dag thob byed kyi rgyu kho bo'i brtson 'grus ni/ rlung chen nang gi mar me/ rnam dpyod nyin skar gyi spun zla/ blo stobs sgyu ma'i skyes bur mtshungs/ bag yod ni chu bur bzhin/ bzod bsran sgong shun dang 'dra/ lang tsho mo gsham gyi bu mo/ yon tan smig sgyu'i mtsho bzhin zab/rig pa ri bong gi rwa ltar rno/ sems rgyud sdong dum bzhin gnag bden 'dzin gyi la rgya ston gyi sprin/ blang dor gyi shes tshad rgya khab kyi mig g.yo sgyu ni sprul pa ltar mkhas/ zhe snang me las kyang tsha/ 'dod chags rgya mtsho bzhin/ nga rgyal brag ri ltar sra/ gti mug gi mun nag sprin rum/ phyi tshul la ngur smig gi sgro mdangs/ nang sems ngang ser bzhin chags pas bcings/ dus tshod ni phyag dar bzhin dor/ slob khang la btson khang du bzung / dge rgan la btson srung gi 'du shes/ slob tshan tshugs par bkag nyar du bsam/ slob khrid tha tshig tu mngon/ rig gnas dug ltar spangs/ slob grogs 81

la dgra ru bzung / brtse ldan gyi pha ma zung sdang mig dang dbyug pas bkur/ pha ma'i drin lan mthong chung dang skyug bros 'jal/ pha ma'i re 'bras rus sbal gyi spu bzhin gtan med/rang nyid kyi mdun lam mi gtsang gi khrod du 'phangs/ rdza khang dang chang khang sogs la spro skyid kyi pho brang du bzung / ja chang gnyis por zhim mngar gyi bdud rtsir rlom/ shing lcags sogs kyi rkub stegs la za 'og gi gdan du 'dzin/ sgyu ma'i brnyan 'phrin don gnas kyi ltad mor snyam/ zhabs zhu'i bu mor rang gi khyim thab du bsam/ rdzun gtam dang 'chal gtam drang bden gyi gtam bzang bzhin ngom/ khrel med kyi spyod ngan mkhas mdzangs kyi yon tan du rtsi/ don med nyam chung la brnyas bcos grags can gyi dpa' blor mngon/ sems bzang pha khu'i bslab bya la snying med kyi brag cha bzhin 'dzin/ mi bden 'chor ma'i g.yo gtam sogs la lhad med kyi gtam du bsam pa'i mjug 'bras su/ da lta bcos ma'i 'dzum mdangs dang / sred ldan 'dren byed kyi zur mdas dran shes kyi go khrab rmeg med du gtor/ yid kyi shing rta'i shang lang gis thar pa'i srog rtsa bcad/ dge ba'i rgyu nor bcom/ slob dpon gyi gnang sbyin dben/ pha ma'i 'dzum mdangs shor/ rang nyid kyi snyan grags nyams/ chos grogs kyi la rgya dor/ snying nye'i yid ches bral/ kha yod tshad kyis 'phya dmod dang skur 'debs/ thos tshad gtam ngan dang dma' 'bebs bsam ra blo 'gyod dang skyo gdung / mthong ra la 'dzem zon dang 'jab 'dzur/ de ltar gyur na shi gson gyi dad rdzas chud zos/ bstan pa'i chom rkun/ dge 'dun gyi mtshan shas/ nang pa'i bla 'tshong / nyi ma'i gnyen gyi zhabs 'dren/ seng ger brdzus pa'i wa skyes/ dam nyams kyi mi kha/ mi dge'i bang mdzod/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bur/ phyi ma dmyal ba'i bud shing / yun ring gi sdug bsngal/ bzod dka'i mnar gcod/ bde ba'i skabs bral nyam thag gi sems can zhig tu gyur tshe/ 'jigs skrag dang blo 'gyod chen pos skyo gdung ngang nas/ smre ngag dang 'o dod 'bod pa sogs ni smos ci dgos/ 'on 82

kyang blun rmongs kho bos ni skyes nas da bar du bgrang bya nyi shu lhag tsam gyi mi tshe dang / rin chen sa le sbram las kyang ches rnyed par dka' ba'i gzhon nu'i lang tsho/ blo gsar gyi rig pa/ kun 'byung gi nor bu/ bde skyid kyi sa bon/ rnyed dka'i dus tshod/ shes rig spyong ba'i go skabs/ 'byung 'gyur mi tshe'i rten gzhi/ de rnams ni btsan po'i dbang dang / mdzes ma'i gzugs/ phyug po'i rgyu nor/ 'jam po'i ngagamakhas pa'i blo gros/ rgan po'i 'bel gtam/ dpa' bo'i blo stobs/ bden 'dzin gyi la rgya/nyam chung gi zhu ba/ shed gyi stobs rtsal sogs/ gang gis kyang bslu thabs bral/med thabs med pa'i lo chung gi dus tshod de rnams phangasamed stong zad btang bas/ da lta phangs sems drag po skyes nas/ de'i sngon gyi rang nyid ni rkang gnyis mi yin nam/ rkang bzhi'i ba lang gang yin 'phyang mo nyug da lta'i dus 'dir gal srid stong zad du phyin pa'i dus tshod de rnams bskyar gsab dang slar gso yong rgyu yod tshe/ kho bos dka' ba brgya phrag mang po yang spyod nus la/ ngal ba khri stong mang po yang phrag tu khur nus/ gal srid lo chung gi dus tshod de rnams tshur 'thob rgyu zhig yod na ni/ sha khrag gi lus po dum bu stong du yang gtong nus la/ snying dmar gyi pags pa yang bshu bar nus zhes pa ni mo gsham gyi bu mo yod na kho bos lhad med kyi brtse dung 'chang nges yin zhes pa lta bu sgro btags kyi tshig ma yin par kha zhe gnyis med kyi bden gtam zhig yin rung / kye ma/ zhes smre ngag gi sgra dang bcas/ de ni nor bu rang lag yod dus nor nyams ma chod/ nor bu gzhan lag shor dus nor nyams chod/ ces pa'i dpe ltar chags zin 'dug pas mig chu lhung lhung du 'bab pa las bya thabs gzhan ma mchis/ de sngon lo chung gi dus tshod rnams phangs med ngang phyag dar dang ljan ldin bzhin bor te gdon gyis myos pa'i blun rmongs kyi skye bo nga dang nga 'dra bas/rnam g.yeng dang le lo/ chud zos dang 'phro brlag bag med dang sos dal/ gnyid dang snyoms las/ 'du 'dzi dang chags zhen/ brtse dung dang lus phra/ chang khang dang 83
