sbag khang / za khang dang rtsed khang / brnyan 'phrin dang khrom gzhung / rdzun gtam dang 'chal gtam/ sang spyong dang gnangs spyong kho nas dus 'da'/ 'dod yon gyis bslus shing srid pa'i dga' bde cung zad tsam la chags/ ches rnyed par dka' ba'i lo chung gi dus tshod nang mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig dang rig gzhung la legs skyes 'bul rgyu lta ci/rang nyid bho ṭa'i bu phrug zhig yin kyang rang gi skad yig dang rig gzhung / pha yul gyi 'dzugs skrun sogs kyi ched legs skyes til 'bru tsam yang 'bul ma thub pas/ ngo gnong gis rang gi mes po dang mi rigs gzhan gyi mdun du gdong yang ji ltar ston nus snyam nas da lta skyo gdung dang blo 'gyod/ phangs sems dang khong khro/ sdug bsngal dang mig chu/ ngu 'bod dang smre ngag dbang med du shor/ de sngon lo chung gi dus tshod nang rnam g.yeng kho nas dus 'da' ba tsam las/ dge mtshan til 'bru tsam yang dben pas/ kho bo btsa' dus skyed mar sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyes pa tsam du zad pas/ rang gis rang la mthong chung dang dma' 'bebs/brnyas bcos/ 'khang ra sogs byas te yid la bud shing med kyang skyo gdung gi me lce drag tu 'bar/ 'dren byed la chu 'dzin med kyang mchi ma'i sbrang char lhung lhung du babs/ ngag la glog 'od med kyang smre ngag gi 'brug sgra lhang lhang du ldir ba sogs byed pa ni smos ci dgos/ de bas na sems ldan na gzhen ya rabs kyi bu chung mkhas mdzangs ldan pa khyed rnams kyis ma 'ongs pa'i dus su rang nyid 'gyod pa'i gnas su mi lhung ba'i ched/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i lo chung gi dus tshod dang / gzhon nu'i lang tshor brtsi chen dang mthong chen gnang 'os/ 'on kyang kho bo'i da lta'i gnas stangs ni/ med byung shes rig gi skyed tshal nang / nang rig pa'i rtswa thang yangs la/ snyan ngag gi rkang 'thung mdzes/ mngon brjod dang tshig rgyan gyi me tog bkra la/ sgra dang tshad ma'i bsil rlung g.yo zhing / gso rig gi chu klung dal bur rgyu ba'i klong du rig pa'i rol rtsed gyi tshul du gnas bzhin yod/ mdor na/ rnyed par dka' ba'i lo chung gi dus tshod dang gzhon nu'i lang tshor nga tsho kun gyis khog pa'i 84

snying dang / dpral ba'i mig gi 'bras bu bzhin gces spras gnang rgyu'i smon 'dun yang snying dbus nas zhu rgyu yin/rngogad can /khri11thakham/chu shel gangs ri dkar po'i pho brang gi dbus/la rgya dang lhag bsam gyi lus zungs brtas/snying stobs dang phugs bsam gyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i/bod gangs can gyi slob ma/khyed cag ni/nga tsho/ bsil ldan kha ba can gyi bla srogamathon mthing g.yu yi rtswa thang gi phang bar/ya rabs dang gzhan phan gyi gshis bzang 'dzin/dka' spyad dang drang bden gyi gzi byin 'phro ba'i/bod gangs can gyi slob ma/khyed cag ni/nga tsho/ mtho sgang bod kyi lam ston/dwangs bsil gangs chu sngon mo'i nye 'gram du/shes rig dang byang sems kyi myu gu bshad/las 'bras dang mthun sgril gyi dge mtshan 'bar ba'i/bod gangs can gyi slob ma/85

dza ya'i dbang po'i gsung dang mkhas pa'i gzhung / /wa ler blo la bzung ste tshig don bsam/ /zhwa ser chos grwa chen por co 'dri ba'i/ /za zi'i dri ma bral ba'i rtsod grwa rtswa /'a cag lung rigs smra ba'i gar stabs kyi/ /ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i 'gying nyams med/ /ra ba gangs kyis bskor ba'i mtshan nyid pas/ /la rgya dgongs te gnas 'dir phebs gyur nas/ /sha tsha'i ngang nas blo skyed gnang res kyis/ /sa steng kun tu grags pas khyab par mdzad/ /ha ha rang snang skyid pa'i ka rtsom 'di/ /a ho khri srong slob grwa'i dge mtshan la/ /ha cang brjod dka'i dga' bas myos bzhin du/ /a ma'i o los sor mo'i ngal bas bskrun/ /rang 31 3 003ma'ire zla ches nyin/lha chosabyed parakadamasab/kwa ye gson dang 'dir tshogs dge 'dun kun/ /kha dog dmar ser ngur smig gis sbud de/ /ga dus yin yang bdag pas gzhan gces kyis/ / 89

nga 'dzin dug shing sdong po'i rtsa ba chod/ /ca co'i 'khor ba dug sbrul tshang lta bur/ /cha rkyen sdug bsngal gang 'dod 'grub pa las/ /ja chang tsam yang mthun rkyen rnyed dka' ba'i/ /nya nyor 'khor ba sbangs te lha chos mdzod/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs don/ /tha chad sdug bsngal 'byung rtsa 'khor ba 'dir/ /da nas bzung ste thar 'dod nges 'byung gis/ /na chung rnams kyis dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /pa lo bcad nas chog shes nor brten cing / /pha rol 'gro ba kun la snying brtse'i ngang / /ba lang 'dra ba'i blun me+ongs sems can la/ /ma ltar brtse ba dgongs te lha chos mdzod/ /tsa na yin yang spyod ngan snying nas spongs/ /tsha grang dka' sdug spyad nas lung rtogs gnyis/ /dza yas ji skad gsungs pa de bzhin du/ /wa ler thugs la bcangs te lha chos mdzod/ /zha nye ma 'dres dngul dkar 'dul ba'i khrims/ /za zi'i dri mas ma sbags dran shes kyis/ /'a cag lus srog las kyang gces bsrungs te/ /ya rabs tshul mothun sgo nos lha chos mdzod/ /ra smad 'khyam pas bab cal smra ba yang / /90

la rgya khrims gtsang ldan pa'i chos grogs tshor/ /sha tsha'i ngang nas cung zhig phan bsam ste/ /sa steng 'di ru gtam 'chal chu mig brdol/ /ha ha shes mig bral ba'i dmus long ngas/ /a rogs snang byed ldan par lam ston tshul/ /ha lam sangs rgyas ka kha'i dper song yang / /a mchod 'khyam po'i snying gi dbus nas thal/ /rang lo 20 2000 lo'i zla 2tshes yīn/lha/na bami thangabasgyu'i ba /ka li'i nang du klad par skyon shor bas/ /kha nas gang thon smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /ga sar khyi bzhin rgyun du 'khyam 'gro ba'i/ /nga yi ngang tshul srong por gleng bar bya/ /ca dngos nor dang pha ma sbun dang bral/ /cha med mi yi yul khams 'grim par bskos/ /ja ro ji bzhin mi gtsang phyag dar gyi/ /nya nyor khrod du dga' ba kho bo'i gshis/ /ta thā ga ta'i na bza' 'chang na yang / /tha mal nyon mongs ring nas goms pa'i mthus/ /da lta khrel dang ngo tshas bsgribs tsam las/ /91

na gzhon dus nas rang rgyud shin tu rengs/ /pa pha a mar rgyal po sgog rlung slong / /pha rol dgra bo'i glo snying tshim byed pa/ /ba nyal mdzo grod spyod pas dus 'da' ba'i/ /ma rabs mi yi tha mar gyur 'di skyo/ /tsa ge tsi ge'i bya bar gal po che/ /tsha rting bar du nyal rgyur bde skyid rtsi/ /dza lang spyod pas dpa' bo'i tshul rlom yang / /wa ltar sems rtsa sdar la khug 'di mtshar/ /zhwa mo mi gyon mgo skyes gtsang mar bzhar/ /za stangs byed stangs 'gro stangs sdod stangs ngan/ /'a 'ur sgra chen 'chal gtam smra bzhin du/ /ya yud pho hreng 'tsho ba'i lam bur bskyod/ /ra smad 'khyam po'i ming can shes rmongs pa/ /la dgu klung dgu brgal nas rgyal khams 'grim/ /sha khrag lus dang rnam shes ma bral bar/ /sa mtha' bskor nas 'dzam gling blta bar 'dod/ / ha cang bsgrub par dka' ba'i 'jig rten gyi/ /a gsar can gyi mdun ma ring dor nas/ /ha gnyid sad pa'i tshul du shes rig sbyongs/ /a tsi bho ṭa'i bdag po gangs gzhon tsho/ /rang lo 22 2002 lo'i zla 2tshes 3nyin/92

lcabatag/smoka ma la yi mdzes ldan chu skyes gzhon nu yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi dgyes pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /kha 'bras mtshar zhing me bya'i lus la dbyangs snyan rna ba'i sbrang rtsi ka la ping ka'i gsung gis brgyan/ /ga dus mjal yang khyed kyi mdzes sdug lha klu mi sogs mdzes ldan bu mo sus kyang 'gran mi nus/ /nga yi las bskos brtse grogs snying gi nor bu lhad med sems kyi brten sa yid 'ong ma khyed dran/ /ca co kun spangs ngag 'jam smra mkhas ldan zhing mthong ba'i mod la dga' ba'i dpal ster sdug gu ma'i/ /cha 'jog sku la nu 'bur rab rgyas sked skabs mnyen la byin pa e na ya ltar rim bzhin phra/ /ja chang la sogs yid la mi dran 'jam zhing dmar mdzes mchu dang rab dkar thags bzang tshems sogs dang / /nya rgyas zla ltar mdzes zhal ri dwags mig cana.āt+pal dkyus ring mig gi zur mda' bshad mdzad dran/ /tā re'i sgyu 'phrul kun da'i dbyibs ltar rab mdzes sku lus dkar zhing gtsang la dmar mdangs cung zad 'tsher/ /tha mal 'jud mthun g.yo dris ma gos sa gzhi pad+ma'i steng du mi 'gyur rdo brag brtse dung ldan/ /da lta bdag gi khyed mthong tshe na dran shes ma brtan dbang med yid 'phrog dga' bas ba spu g.yos/ /na chung mdzes sdug gzugs kyi phul byung yid 'ong gzhon nu khyed la bdag gi glo ba snying nas dga'/ /pa sangs sgrol ma'i mtshan can kho bo'i yid dbang 'phrog mkhas 'jo sgeg gar ma'i tshul ldan khyed/ /pha lam lta bu rin chen snying nor mdzes sdug ldan pa'i khyed zhal nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i tshe/ /ba gam bajid nyams nang du gnas pa'i bdag lus pad+ma'i tshal rnams rab tu g.yos shing chags pa'i dri/ /ma rmos lo tog bzhin du 'bad pa med kyang lhag par 'phel zhing lus sems yongs las chil chil 'thul/ /tsa ri'i smyug ma 'dra ba'i sku gzugs 93

ldem ldem khyug khyug mdzes sdug yid 'ong snying nor khyed kyi ched/ /tsha grang dka' sdug ji tsam phrad cing gces pa'i lus srog shor yang phangs zhus med pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /dza dzor bral ba'i brtse dung mdud pa bkrol yang grol med ser bya ngang pa 'dra ba'i brtse ldan khyed/ /wa ler kho bo'i mig sngar ma gyur bar du mtha' med rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru 'tshol bar 'gro yang spobs/ /zha nye ma 'dres khyed dang nga yi dwangs gtsang lhad med brtse sems gcig 'dus dngul dkar me long ngos/ /za 'og mdza' gcugs dkar gtsang dar gyis legs par 'phyid pas rdul g.ya' med pa'i dwangs gtsang gzugs brnyan 'di/ /'a cag gnyis po'i las smon mthu las brtse dung mtshon byed 'char bas sus kyang bzlog med rten 'brel gshis/ /ya rabs kun spyod bzang ba'i gnam bskos mdzes ldan lha mo sa steng mi phran bdag gi mdun ma dran/ /ra bas bskor 'dra khyed kyi brtse dung dwangs gtsang lhad med dar dkar zhags pas bdag yid 'chor med bzung / /la rgya brtse ldan khyed dang skad cig tsam yang 'bral 'dod med mod las dbang rkyen gyis cung bral yang / sha tsha'i snying gtam smin legs khyed kyi zhal nas ji gsungs nga yi dran shes me long ngos su 'char/ /sa le sbram ltar 'gyur med rin chen snying gi nor bu rab mdzes mig yangs ma khyed rab tu dran/ /ha ha bdag gi rtsom 'chal 'di ni brjod don mi legs su yis gzigs kyang bzhad gad 'phya dmod gzhi/ /ha cang 'chal gtam mang bas lhad med sdom gsum 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i spyan sngar mi mdzes mi 'os kyang / /a skya 'ga' zhig 'di yi rigs la spro ba 'phel zhing nyan 'dod che ba'i sgra 'dzin bu ga mā /a mchod 'khyam pos ku re'i tshul du smyu gu'i rtse mos shog steng snag tsha'i ri mo 'bri bar thal/ / rang lo 20 2000 lo'i zla 2tshes 9nyin/

po/thamand /khyibazus/ ma/ka li'i nang du yang yang bsam pa'i don/ /kha nas gsal bar shad pa ma phad pas/ /ga ler yi ge'i gzugs su bkod gyur te/ /nga yis drang por bris la nyes pa ci/ /ca co spangs nas kher rkyang gnas pa'i tshe /cha 'jog med pa'i chung 'dris yid la dran/ /ja tshwa lta bu dngos su phrad tsa na/ /nya chu bzhin du mi gnas 'gal 'di ci/ /ta la'i 'jings dang kyag kyog lam bu brgyud/ /tha ma rang yul spangs nas gzhan yul 'grim/ /da lta gzhan gsang tshul du khong mjal yang / /na tsha snying khar bzo las don gzhan ci/ /pa lo bzhin du mtshan snyan ring dor te/ /pha mes spre 'u'i spyodaspra bskyangs na yang / /ba lang seng ger rlom zhing cher 'gying ba'i/ /ma rabs dga' grogs bsten kyang snying po ci/ /tsa na yin yang lhad med brtse dung gi /tsha gdung sel ba'i bdud rtsi phul na yang / /95

dza dzor rdzab chur dgyes pa'i brtse grogs kyis/ /wa ltar bslu bar mi 'gyur the tshom ci/ /zha ra ji bzhin 'dod chags kyis ldong ste/ /za tsho dga' grogs sgrig par bde skyid rtsi/ /'a chad skyo gdung drag pos mnar ba 'di/ /ya mtshan brtse dung zer ba yin nam ci/ /ra smad bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' slob rnams/ /la mor nyams su blang bar mi nus 'bras/ /sha khrag lus po sems gcong gis mnar bas/ /sa steng 'di ru bde skyid yod dam ci/ /ha ha re sgug nam zla'i sa bon la/ /a kha mi 'dod sdug bsngal 'bras bu smin/ /ha cang bzod dka'i sems kyi blo pham 'di/ /a tsi rin gyis nyos pas mi legs ci/ /rang lo 23 003lo'i zla 9dzes 4nyin/za/sdo ma gabayig zeng/a tsi g.yung mos ci bshad ltar nyan na/ /ha cang rnyed dka'i dal 'byor chud zos 'gro/ /96 sa le sbram lta'i lha chos 'di spangs nas/ /

sha khrag mi gtsang lus la 'khrul don ci/ /la thel bskyon pa'i sdom gsum tshul khrims 'di/ /ra ma lug bzhin 'chal na ngan song rgyu/ /ya re yo re med pa'i dran shes ngang / /'a cag lus srog bas kyang gces srung gyis/ /za zi 'dra ba'i phal pa g.yung mo'i lus/ /zha long mi gtsang yin yang gtsang 'dzin na/ /wa ltar g.yo sgyu'i rang bzhin 'jud mthun mas/ /dza dzor ngang nas mi tshe stong zad brlag /tsha grang snyoms pa'i mi tshe bskyal bsam na/ /tsa tur las kyi bya ba ci byed kyang / /ma med bla ma'i gdams ngag gus nyan na/ /ba ru ra 'dra'i chos sman nyon nad gso/ /pha lam lta bu'i dam chos 'dul ba'i khrims/ /pa sangs dkar bzhin gtsang bar gnas gyur na/ /na raka ka yi gnas sogs nyam nga yang / /da lta gtsang mar bsrungs na bag mi tsha/ /tha chad sdug bajal 'byung rtsa 'jud mthun ched/ /ta thā ga tas gsungs pa'i 'dul khrims dor/ /nya nyor mi gtsang bud med bsten gyur na/ /ja lung bu gar mgrin chud sdug mnar nges/ /cha lugs tshul ldan bag phebs zhi dul ngang / / 97

ca le ca le'i 'chal gtam nyung gsung ste/ /nga yis gong bshad rang gi sems la bcangs/ /ga dus yin kyang thos bsam sgom brtson byos/ /kha tsha dgod bro'i byis pa'i rtsom 'chal 'dir/ /kha che pha lu 'dra ba'i don med kyang / /ka li'i nang du klad med bdag 'dra la/ /ka re ku re'i don gcig yod snyam brtsams/ /thogamada'/ka ye gson dang deng sang btsun gzugs 'gas/ /kha ba'i ljongs kyi grong khyer grong rdal sogs/ /ga sar sa shing tshul min yid byed rnams/ /nga dang gcig mtshungs bstan pa'i chom rkun mthong / /ca co'i ngag nas 'chal gtam kha 'don ngom/ /cha rkyen rig gnas lnga dang bral na yang / /ja chang longs spyod sgyu ma'i grong khyer du/ /nya nyor dwangs gtsang 'dzin mkhas ngo mtshar che/ /ta thā ga ta'i gzhung lugs lta ci smos/ /tha na skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo tsam mi shes/ /da dung rang mkhas rlom zhing dam par 'phya/ /

na bun snang ba 'dzin mkhas ngo mtshar che/ /pa pha a ma'i bslab bya khyad du gsod/ /pha rol 'gro ba kun la dgra bas 'tshe/ /ba bla gser du brdzu ba'i zog pos kyang / /ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon smra ngo mtshar che/ /tsa hral spyod ngan dang len zhi dul 'chor/ /tsha grang dka' thub kha grod don yin yang / /dza ya'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs yin no zhes/ /wa skyes las kyang g.yo mkhas ngo mtshar che/ /zha nye ma 'dres dngul dkar 'dul khrims 'chol/ /za yon ched du sngags min mdo min spyod/ /'a cag shākya seng ge'i bstan pa'i bla/ /ya ma zung tshos 'tshong mkhas ngo mtshar che/ /ra gan gser brdzu'i mkhas rlom khengs skyung gnyis/ /la shan dbye ba zhib par ma phye na/ / sha tsha mtshungs bral sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /sa srub sbrul zhugs rnams kyis 'jig nyen che/ /ha lam deng dus sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dir/ /ha cang blun me+ongs wa skyes brtul zhugs can/ /a sdug rnams kyis bstan pa'i bla 'tshong dus/ /a ma'o bdag gi sor rtses 'bri bar thal/ /

ma'(11tha'agrisbasadathertomatshoni da ba/a she mjal dar dri med rab dkar lag 'byer pus mo sar btsugs te/ /ha cang bsngags brjod brjod bral dpal gyi bsam yas nang bstan slob gling zhes//sa 'dzin dkyil 'khor kun tu snyan pa'i dbyar rnga phyogs bcur ldir ba 'di/ /sha tsho'i ngang nas yid can kun gyi sgra 'dzin lam du sgrog par 'dod/ /la rgya thugs mthun khrims gtsang ldan pa'i 'dus tshogs li khri'i rgya mtsho 'dis/ /rwa ba gangs kyis bskor ba'i dbus nas bshad sgrub rlabs phreng srid rtser 'phyur/ /ya bo phal gyi rgol ba mtha' dag rigs pa'i rlabs kyi 'og tu nub/ /'a cag rnam dpyod rkyen rtsal ngom pa'i bshad grwa 'di ni rig pa'i mtsho /za rgyag spyod gsum brtul zhugs spangs te dben zhing nyams dga'i slob grwa'i nang / /zha long skyon dang bral ba'i thugs mthun slob ma'i tshogs rnams dga' spro'i ngang / /wa skyes lta bu'i g.yo sgyu'i skyon rnams spangs te drang bden lung rigs kyis/ /dza ya'i bstan la byi dor byed mkhas bshad grwa 'di bstan mig gcig pu/ /tsha grang dka' thub dang len zur phud bregs shing ngur smig cod pan 'chang / /tsa ri'i gnas 'dra'i bsam yas nang bstan slob grwa'i nang du legs bzhugs nas/ /ma rgan 'gro drug don du brtson pa'i go cha bzhes nas dkar phyogs kyi/ /ba dan srid rtser bsgrengs shing nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' glu len/ /pha mtha' bral ba'i bskal pa'i me dpung nang don rig pa'i tshig don gyis/ /slo pa ṭa'i log smra'i tshang tshing bsregs shing ma rig mun sel sgron mer gyur/ /

na chung blo gsal mkhas mang 'dus pa'i nang bstan slob grwa 'di kun gyis/ /da sgos bho ṭa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin zhes bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor/ /tha mal chos brgyad dri mas ma gos rnam dpyod ldan pa'i blo gros kyis/ / ta thā ga ta'i bstan par me 'byin ma rungs tshar gcod rjes 'dzin cing / /nya nyor tshig gi lo mas ma bsgribs tshad mar gyur pa'i gsung rab don/ /ja chang bzhin du ngom med bzhes yod bshad grwa 'di bzhin srid na dkon/ /cha rkyen tshul dgu 'dzoms pa'i lung rigs nyi ma lnga rig smra ba'i gsung / /ca co'i tshig dang bral zhing rtsod na phas rgol 'joms pa'i gnam lcags bzhin/ /nga rgyal dri mas ma gos rtsom na thub bstan gsal ba'i nyin byed skad/ /ga sar khyab cing wa skyes klad 'gems bshad grwa'i mkhan 'di seng ge'i rgyal/ /kha lnga pa ltar slob ma'i tshogs rnams gsung rab ral pa'i khur gyis brdzid/ /ka ci'i gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rnam dpyod rtsal sbyangs rigs pa'i mche sder ngom/kha ba'i ljongs kyi mkhas rlom khengs dregs can rnams zil gnon bshad grwa bar/ka ca'i rgyu nor dbul ba med kyang rab snyan tshig gi bstod 'di phul/ /

'cha 'i'adzum zer/skya rengs thos pa'i snang ba shar ba'i rjes/ /rnam dpyod nyi gzhon 'char kha'i 'dzum zer gyis/ /lhug rtsom chu skyes tshal rnams rab g.yos pas/ /brjod bya'i bung ba gang 'dod phyogs su lding / /

snyed mar bayigasadung ma /bod zla bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin der/ kho bos bsam yas has po ri dang /khams gsum gling ga sogs phyi rol gyi khor yug kun tu 'cham 'cham du 'gro dus/ dbyar gyi dus su yid dbang dbang med 'phrog pa'i dwangs gtsang in+d+ra'i yang zhun lan brgyar byugs pa'i rin chen g.yu yi yid 'ong gi skyed tshal dang / /mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa'i rab yangs kyi rtswa thang rnams kyang mthong ba tsam gyis yid sems rab tu skyo ba'i bye ma'i skya thang lta bur gyur/ mdzes ldan mig gi rgyan du gyur pa'i khor yug gi rkang 'thung rnams/ bar snang ngos nas kha ba'i me tog babs pa ltar yal 'dab rnams sa la lhung ste/ /rin chen 'bru sna lnga yi rba rlabs 'phyur ba'i g.yur za'i zhing bzang gi 'bras bu kun bang mdzod nang bsdus zin/ dwangs shing gtsang ba'i shang shang chu bo yar klung gtsang po yang / rim bzhin je phrar 'gro ba'i skabs/ dgung sngon dbyings su chu 'dzin sprin dkar gyi me tog nyung la/ bar snang ngos nas thal zhag lang long du g.yo/ yul gru kun tu 'ur lding gi ngar rlung drag po 'tshub pa'i mthar/la klung kun la kha ba'i na bza' bsgron/ de bzhin spu sdug mdzes pa'i 'dab chags rnams kyang rang rang gi gnas mal du skyod skabs/ bu chung nga yang mdzes ldan slob grwa'i dga' tshal nang /rab yangs shes bya'i thang chen gyi steng du blo gros kyi gshog rtsal sbyong bzhin yod pas/ phyi rol yul rnams kyis sems skyo ba'i rkyen byas te/ glo bur du brtse ldan drin chen skyed ma rab tu dran pas/ dran gdung gi skyo glu 'di ltar len par thal/ /dgun gyi dus 'dir ri klung thams cad dang / /sngo ljang g.yu yi dga' tshal skya thang gyur/ /de'i steng kha ba'i me 103

tog 'bab pa'i tshe/ /dbyar skyid dpal mo'i longs spyod dran bzhin skyo/ /chu 'dzin sprin gyi me tog dgung sngon 'phyur/ /ri bo kun la kha ba'i na bza' bsgron/ /'ur lding dgun rlung ngar ma ldang ba'i tshe/ /brtse ldan drin chen skyed ma dbang med dran/ /skru sdug mdzes pa'i ngang ser ma bu zung / /mnyam du gshog rtsal ngoms nas ci dgar 'phur/ /ma bu'i glu brtse sems 'bral med mthong ba'i dus/ /nga yi blo sems ngang ser ma bur shor/ /chung dus rang gi yul du skyed ma'i drung / /'dug pa'i tshe na skyed ma'i drin ma shes/ /da lta cha med gzhan yul 'grim pa'i dus/ /skyed ma'i sku drin shes kyang mchi ma'i rgyu/ /kye ma kye khud bdag gi brtse ba'i ma/ /ma khyed ma mjal bu nga'i blo sems skyo/ /skyo gdung 'di 'drar skyed mas thugs kyis gsan/ /gsan nas skyed mas byams brtses dgongs su gsol/ /gsol 'debs bshags pa'i smre ngag 'di ltar zhu/ /zhu don brtse ldan skyed ma'i snyan du bsgron/ /bsgron rgyu'i bkra shis 'bel gtam mi shod de/ /de sngon khrel med bu ngan ma rabs ngas/ / ngas byas mi 'os las kyis khyed thugs dkrugs/ /dkyugs pas mi tshad skyed ma sdug la sbyar/ /sbyar ba da lta nga yi blo la dran/ /dran pas snying nas blo 'gyod chen pos bshags/ /bshags pas nyes sgrib 'dag par thugs rjes gzigs/ /gzigs nas 'dzum zhal bu la myur du bstan/ /bstan mdzod khyed kyi sku drin legs par gso/ /gso thabs bral yang gso sems snying nas skyes/ /skyes pas mi tshad bdag gis dam bca' bzhag /bzhag nas brtse ldan skyed ma gtsug tu bkur/ /bkur nas bdag gi mig las gces par 'dzin/ /'dzin 'os pha ma min pa su zhig yod/ /yod med the tshom bcad nas skyo glu rdzogs/ /de ltar brtse ldan drin chen skyed ma'i bka' drin ni/ gting mtha' med pa'i rgya mtsho las kyang zab/ lhun po las kyang brdzid cing mtho/ zhing rdul las kyang grangs mang / pha lam bas kyang rtsa che/ gser dngul las kyang rin thang che/ gangs ri lasakyang dkar ba sogs kyi bka' drin bsam ste/ ma bzang gi bu 104

chung rnams kyis/ skyed mar byams skyong dang / gdung sems/ bsam shes/bsnyen bkur/ rtsi 'jog gces spras/ lta skyong / gus zhabs sogs byed rgyu ni gnam 'og gi bu phrug nga tsho kun gyi 'dor thabs med pa'i 'gan 'khri yin pas/ skyed ma'i thugs sems blo bde bag phebs kyi ngang nas bde skyid phan bde'i dpal la longs su spyod cing dga' ba 'bum gyis khengs pa'i sgo nas/ skyed ma 'tsho bzhugs gnang thub min ni/ bu phrug tshor rag lus yod pas/ mtha' gcig tu skyed mar rang gi khog pa'i snying dang/ dpral ba'i mig ltar gces spras gnang ba'i mdzad bzang gi re bar g.yur za'i 'bras bzang smin pa'i smon 'dun dang / byas pa mi shes shing drin du mi gzo ba'i khrel med kyi bu phrug 'gas/ gong gi re 'bras de bzhin bsgrub mi nus kyang / tha na/ skyed mar khong khro dang / dma' 'bebs/ brnyas bcos/ skyug bro/ tha tshig rdung rdeg byed mkhan gyi bu phrug mi yi lus la khrel med blo sems khyi spyang las kyang ma rabs tha shal rnams la/ ther 'don/ dma' 'bebs sogs byas te/ gsang spyod nang gi srin bu las kyang ches mi gtsang ba dang / ches skyug bro/ zhe log bya yul gyi gnas su nges par du brtsi dgos/ des na bu phrug rnams kyis skyed ma'i bka' drin gzhan bsam mi shes kyang /rang nyid kyi lus rten 'di bstsal ba'i bka' drin dang / chung dus rang gi mi gtsang ba'i gcin skyag 'jam mnyen phyag gis phyi ba dang / mi gtsang ba'i snabs lud kha yis 'jibs pa la yang /skyug bro dang zhe log spu tsam yang med pa'i byams brtse mtshungs med kyi bka' drin de/ ma mthar yang shes dgos nges kyi shes bya zhig yin/ /rang lo 19 1999 lo'i zla 7tshes 4nyin/105

nya ris 'pho bi/ma gzhi/ kher rkyang zhes pa de/ pha ma spun mched dang bral zhing / bza' mi bu phrug sogs ma mchis pas/ cha med kyi lam bur/ myong med kyi 'tsho ba skyel mkhan zhig yin rung / 'on kyang / de ni bla na med pa'i bde skyid cig red/ gang yin zer na/ rang nyid kyi sems nang bde skyid dang / stabs bde'i 'tsho ba/ ci dgar gyi kun spyod/rang dbang gi tshor snang / bag yangs kyi gnas stangs/ ngom med kyi slob sbyong / dka' spyad kyi 'bras bzang / spro skyid kyi mi tshe/ gu yangs blo bde kher rkyang gi bde skyid ni/ bza' mi bu phrug yod pa'i 'byor ldan gyi khyim bdag rnams kyang thob 'dod dang / spyod 'dod kyi re smon dang yid smon dbang med du shor zhing rnyed par dka' ba'i go skabs shig dang / gces par 'os pa'i khyad nor zhig kyang red/ yang na sdug bsngal zhig kyang red/ gang yin zer na/ kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba'i lam bu'i steng du dka' spyad dang sdug bsngal du ma zhig rang nyid gcig pus myong dgos shing / lhag tu lus nad gcong gis zin cing / yid sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung dus/ rang gi nad g.yog dang sdug bsngal sel grogs tshang ma rang kho nas byed dgos pas/ kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba ni/ kun gyis spang bya'i gnas dang / ya nga snying rje'i yul du gyur pa zhig kyang red/ kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis bde skyid kho na dang / 'ga' zhig gis sdug bsngal kho nar bsam zhing mtha' gcig tu kha mtshon gcod par dka' yang / rang myong gi tshul du cung zhig gleng na/ da lta'i char/ 'du 'dzi nyung zhing / gnas babs bde ba/ 'tsho ba skyid cing / grogs po dang ci dgar 'grogs pa/ shes rig la ngom med du slob skyong byed pa'i go skabs bzang ba rang 106

nyid gang la dga' ba'i bya gzhag der ltos med du 'jug nus pa/ dwogs zon dang ngo srung gi mnar gcod dang bral zhing / skyid pa'i yul/ ngo mtshar gyi gnas/ dga' ba'i grogs/ 'khrug pa'i mi tshogs/ gang du yod kyang / rang nyid tshegs med sleb cing /gu yangs blo bde nang gi skyid nyams ldan pa sogs bde skyid brjod las 'das pa'i 'tsho ba zhig red/ 'on kyang 'byung 'gyur ji ltar 'byol min skog gyur yin pas rtogs par dka'/ /rang lo 8 998le'i zla 0tshes 3nyin/dran lang/yangs shing rgya che'i 'jig rten 'di yi steng gi skye bo su la'ang re skug gi dran 'char zhig yod pa ni 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin la/ kho bor dbang ba'i re skug gi dran 'char yang /rang sems kyi steng du yang yang 'char ba'i thag ring lung khug gi mdzes ma de yin la/ ngas khong re skug byed pa'i ngang tshul ni/ grang ngar che ba'i dgun gyi dus su/ gangs 'khyags dang bu yug gi rlung po'i khrod du'ang / ya nga med par brtse dung gi lus po dmar rjen du mngon nas/nga yi thag ring lung khug gi mdzes ma/ dro 'jam bde skyid kyi nyi ma khyod/nam zhig nam zhig 'khyam po'i lus sems kyi gangs rir 'char bar nges snyam nas re sgug gis dus 'da' la/lhag par dpyid kyi skabs der bya rgyal khu byug dpyid kyi dpal yon re sgug byed pa bzhin/bdag sems 'jig rten gyi zhing khams su/ med byung dpyid kyi dpal yon/ nga yi thag ring lung khug gi mdzes ma/ rab mdzes mig gi bdud rtsi/ gces 'os snying gi nor bu/brtse ldan yid kyi me tog khyed/ myur bar/ myur bar/ zol med brtse sems kyi sdum rwar rab tu bzhad nges pa'i yid ches kyis khengs shing / khu byug dang dbyar rngas dpyid ka 'bod ༵

bzhin/ kho bos dran gdung dang re 'bod kyis yang yang 'bod pas/ thag ring lung khug gi mdzes ma khyed/ spyon pa'i yid kyi dpyid kar phebs pa'i re skug byed bzhin yod/mdzesaldan dbyar gyi dusader/ sngo ljang gi gling gar skyod skabs/ d+dha rgyun gyi bzhur sgra dang / 'jolamo'i glu stipasathosapas/ ṣ+ka gsungalhapanger ga la/ rkangalasagomar+sā lcugadang / tshetogagi mdzesa'amosamathong bas/ khyed kyi sku gzugasadang bzhin rasadabang med du mig sngar yang yang la4/ de bawo k+ṣe tshing gi nagasakhrod du bsil ldan gyi sbrang char 'bab tshe/ kho bo dran gdung dang skyo snang ṣ+kakhyod du gnasaskabs/ khyed kyi zolamed snying gi khong nas brdol ba'i snying gtam gyi sbrang char 'bebs pa'i ngang tshul dran zhing dus rtag tu khyed re sgug byed baṣ+ka mchis/ston gyi dusader nam mkha' dwangs shing zla 'od rab tu dkar la/ dbyig 'dzin khyon du/ snyo gi lo tog g.yur du za ba mthong dus/ khyed dang kho bo/ dwangs gtsang rab tu dkar zhing / 'od stong 'phro ba'i lam bu'i thog tu bskyod nas bde skyid kyi mjug 'bras thob par nges snyam nasathag ring lung khug gi mdzes ma khyed/ kho bo'i sems dbus su phyir log yong ba'i re sgug byed bzhin nyin mtshan dbyer med du gnas lags/ kye ma/ thag ring lung khug gi mdzes ma/ las bskos kyi dga' grogs/ dran gdung gi mi che'i nang / ngas khyod la sdug yus kyis re 'bod kyang byed srid la/ 'gyur med kyi re skug kyang nam 'tsho'i bar du byed nges yin/ de ni khyed kyis dgongs sam thag ring lung khug gi brtse ldan ma/ /rang lo 004lo'i zla 4tshes 4nyin/bcosamamibatshedung bgabogabami grogs po'i dgod sgra dang grogs mo'i glu dbyangs kyis dben pa'i khu sim gyi mtshan mo 'dir/08

bzod dka'i gcong nad kyis mnar bas/ dkar gtsang zla 'od kyi 'og/ gcig pur lus pa'i sdug bsngal da gzod tshor bas/ yid chad dang sdug yus kyis dbugs ring zhig dbang med du shor/ snying sdug ma/ do dgong kho bo/ gzhen nu gling khar sbyar sdong skam po'i 'gram der / khyed dang nga yi sngar song gi sgrung gtam rnams la dran gso'i tshul du mchi ma'i 'bras chang 'thung zhing smre ngag gi sgra snyan dkrol te/ bde skyid dang dga' spro'i yal 'dab dang bral ba'i kho bo ni/ sbyar sdong skam po 'di dang 'dra bar kher rkyang ngang krong nger gnas lags/ khyed kyis kho bo'i lhad med brtse dung dang / nyam chung gi re sgug mi gtsang gi rgya mtshor 'phangs shing / gzhan gyi brtse dung dang re skug la rgyal kha'i me tog yang yang 'thor ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ ma gzhi rang rang so sor mi gang 'dra zhig dang / brtse don sgrig pa'i rang dbang yod rung / 'on kyang de sngon khyed kyis sbyang sdong 'di yi 'og tu bshad pa'i 'gyur med dang lhad med yin zhes pa de dag mi dran nam/ da dung khyed dang nga yi mdza' sems kyi dpang por gyur pa'i sems med drang skyes kyi sbyar sdong 'di la yang / ngo tsha dang ngo gnong mi skye'am/ kho bos khyed la gang gi thog nas 'grig min mi shes kyang / 'das zin pa'i kho bo'i mdza' sems kyi rtswa thang skam po'i steng du bdag med kher rkyang du lus pa'i brtse dung gi me tog de/ ya nga dang snying rje med pa'i mi mthun sad ser gyis bcom pas/ bag yangs kyi yal 'dab dang bral zhing / bde skyid kyi ze 'bru sogs ma mchis kyang / brtse grogs kyi bung ba zhig 'phur lding byed pa'i re sgug de/ dngos gnas dgod bro ba dang ya nga ba zhig tu gyur/ yin na'ang / nga'i lhad med brtse dung gi sdong por mi 'dod sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu smin pa 'di/ kho bo'i sngon bsags kyi rnam smin zhig yin par sems/ kho bo drag spyod dang gdug rtsub u tshugs bcas kyi sgo nas pham pa zhig yin rung / 'on kyang / yid chad kyi rgya mtsho dang / the tshom gyi ri bo brgal nus na/ dwangs gtsang dben zhing nyams dga'i brtse sems kyi mtsho gling zhig tu/ rmad byung bde skyid kyi rtswa thang / rab mdzes brtse dung gi me 109

tog bsil ldan mdza' gcugs kyi mtshe'u sogs rang nyid la dbang tshul grags pas/snying stobs dang rtsod len gyi go cha rgyan te/ lhad med brtse dung dang / 'gyur med kyi re skug byed pa'i ngang tshul gyi thog nas/ kho bo 'jig rten 'dir 'gran zla bral ba zhig ma yin rung /drang bden du gnas pa'i spobs sems skye dgos pa zhig los yin/ kho bo gzhen nu ma rnams kyi lhad med brtse dung thob pa'i bdag po zhig ma yin kyang / da lta gzhi nas me+ongs gnyid las sangs pas/ khyed kyi bcos ma'i brtse dung gis g.yog pa'i thang khug de dus nam yang rgyan 'dod med/ 'das zin pa'i sgrung gtam rnams khyed kyis snying med kyi bya ba zhig tu brtsis te 'dor srid la/ ngas kyang zhabrugs cha dod pa'i rmi lam zhig tu rtsi nges yin/ nga gnyis mnyam gshib kyi dus der/ kho bos khyed la chad pa'i sems pham dang ngo gnong gi blo 'gyod sogs med kyang / khyod kyi bcos ma'i brtse dung dang / rgyab mdun gyi dga' po gnang ba'i gshis bzang la/ kho bos zur za dang / dgod bro'i tshul du dgongs pa ma 'tshom dang / ga le bzhugs zhes brngod rgyu yin/ /rang lo 22 2002 lo'i zla 10tshes 20nyin/sku'akham/'dod pa'i khams 'dir/ rang 'dod ji bzhin bya ba 'grub mi srid la/ gang yang tshod dpag ltar du yin mi srid/ khong dang mjal 'dod kyang yod nges yin la/ skabs re khong la g.yol 'dod kyang skye myong / ngas byas tshad thams cad yang dag ma red la/ khong gis gnang tshad thams cad nor zhabrul ma red/ nga'i bsam tshad thams cad brtse dung ma red la/khong gis gnang tshad thams cad kyang yid ches yin gyi ma red/ phan tshun bsam 110

shes dang / yid ches med na bde skyid dang / dga' spro 'thob mi srid la/ dran gdung dang sems gcong med na/ brtse dung dang re sgug yong mi srid/ drang gtam bshad na/ngas khong la dpral ba'i mig dang / khog pa'i snying ltar gces spras byed myong la/ skabs re go med tshor med kyi khrod du'ang brjed myong / lhag par du/ ngas khong dran pa'i dus tshod ni/kher rkyang dang skyo snang gi khrod du yin pas/ khong brjed pa'i dus tshod ni/ mi dmangs kyi dbus dang / bde skyid kyi khrod du yin par smos ci dgos/ kho bor khengs ldan brtse dung gi gcong nad phog tshe/ byas tshad thams cad nus med yin rung / bsam tshad thams cad re smon yin/ nang du myong tshad sdug bsngal yin rung/ kha nas bshad tshad bde skyid kyi skor yin/bcos ma'i brtse dung gi mgo bor ngo srung gi zhwa mo gyon dus/ bsam tshad dogs zon dang the tshom/bcangs tshad rdzun bzo dang / mgo skor yin rung / bshad tshad lhad med dang 'gyur med/dran gdung dang yid ches sogs kyi 'bel gtam red/ gal srid brtse dung gi rlung bu langs na/mtshan ngan gyi thal zhag 'khrigs nges/ re skug gi sbyar sdong yod na/ sdug bsngal gyi shun lpags yod nges/ brtse ldan gyi dga' grogs yod na/ mi sangs pa'i sdug bsngal los yod/ kun rtog kyi mtsho mor/ ci yin mi shes pa'i skyo sems dang / gso bar dka' ba'i gcong nad kyi rlung bus bslangs pa'i drag tu 'phyur ba'i phog thug dang / blo 'gyod kyi rba klong zhi ba'i ched du/ ngas ma 'ongs pa'i lo zla'i nang / brtse dung gi lcags kyu/ dga' grogs kyi 'thom zhwa/ re sgug gi 'ching thag las bsgral te/ bag yod dang rang dbang ldan pa'i bde skyid kyi rtswa thang zhig gi steng du bskyod nas/ rab mdzes lta na sdug pa'i shes bya'i me tog gi sdum ra dang / 'dzad mtha' med pa'i yon tan gyi chu bo'i 'jug ngogs su lhing 'jags dang /bag yod/ rig pa'i rol rtsed kyi tshul du/ nam 'tsho'i bar gu yangs blo bde kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba'i lam bu'i thog tu bskyod 'dod kyi chod sems snying dbus su 'chang bzhin yod/gson dang grogs mchog tsho/ nga'i ma 'ongs pa'i mi tshe'i bgrod lam gyi sngon 'gro'i bsam blo 111

gtong bawo/ rnyog 'dzing dang tsha gdung can gyi nyin mor mdang song gi rmi lam du brtsis nas/phebs skyel zhus te rang dbang ldan zhing / ngo srung gi sprin dang bral ba'i dwangs gtsang / kher rkyang gi mtshan mo'i nor bur bsu ba zhu rgyu de 'dor thabs med pa'i nga'i 'gan 'khri zhig yin/ /rang lo 23 2003 lo'i zla 8tshes 27nyin/15/ /ste/ ////kye ma/ rang shag gru bzhi'i nang du gcig pur lus pa'i nyam chung ngas/ sa sros kyi dus 'dir/ sge'u khung nas rgyang lta byed skabs/ rta bdun dbang po nub ri'i rgyab tu gshegs zin pas/ 'dzam gling 'di ni skyo snang dang mya ngan gyi mun pa rub ste/ bya byi'u rnams kyang skyo gdung gi ca co sgrog bzhin rang rang gi tshang mal du log sge'u khung gi 'gram du yod pa'i rgya lcang de yang mya ngan gyi tshul du mgo bo sur bzhin gnas 'dug cog tse'i steng nas chu tshod kyi tshag sgra dang / rgyang ring po zhig nas dpe cha ba 'ga' zhig gi skad sgra chung ngu tsam las gzhan gang yang thos rgyu mi 'dug skabs der kho bo'i sems nang / tshe gcig gi chos grogs/ las bskos kyi gcen po/ mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i gshes gnyen/ blo dkar gzhung drang can gyi phu nu/ zhi dul kun dang mthun pa'i nyam chung / lhad med brtse sems can gyi grogs mchog nga'i yod tshad kyi yod tshad/ brtse ldan gyi grogs po tshangs dbyangs bzang po khyed rang shin tu dran nas/ sems nang bzod du med pa'i skyo gdung dang bral gdung gis mnar bas/ mig zung gnyis nas chil chil du bzhur ba'i mchi mas sna yi rtse mo brgyud / sna chu dang 'grogs te dkar 'jam shog bu'i thang du babs/ mgrin 112

pa 'dzer ba'i ngu sgras 'o dod kyi smre ngag bton te/ nga yi grogs mchog tshangs dbyangs bzang po zhes sdug yus kyi re 'bod drag tu byas kyang gsung lan tsam yang mi gnang ba ni/ brtse ba'i grogs pos kho bo ma brjed dam/ tshangs dbyangs bzang po lags/ khyed kyis kho bor gsung lan ma gnang na/ nga'i mgrin pa 'dzer ba'i ngu sgra 'jag mi thub la/ khyed kyi dgyes zhal ma mjal na/ nga'i mig zung las bzhur ba'i mchi ma'i zhur rgyun nam yang mi 'chad/ khyed kyis kho bo'i gam du ma phebs na/ nga'i bral gdung gi zug rngur sel thabs mi 'dugatshangs dbyangs bzang po lags gsan nam/ khyed kyi khra sgor bkra ba'i spyan mig zung /mthong bar 'dod pa'i bzhin ras/ dang ba 'dren pa'i kun spyod/ bab chags ldan pa'i bka' mol/ lhag tu rnam dbyod skya bas rig gzhung gi rgya mtsho bsrubs shing / bzod par bral ba'i thal skad kyi nga ros 'jig rten hril po rmongs gnyid las slong ba'i ngang tshul sogs/ nga'i mig lam du yang yang 'char zhing / rmi lam gyi nang du khyed rang thengs mang mjal yang / dngos su mjal ba'i skal bzang gis phongs pa'i ngang tshul 'di ni/ rkyen ngan gang gi las dbang yin nam/ tshangs dbyangs bzang po lags/ khyed dang bral na dga' skyid khri srong slob gling du bsdad kyang skyo snang las mi 'dug khyed dang bral na 'jig rten 'dir gang la yang snying po mi 'dug kha bral zhes pa'i phrag dog can gyi tsher mas nga yi grogs mchog gang du sbas sam/ las dbang zhes pa snying rje med pa'i rlung bus/ nga'i grogs mchog da lta gang du khyer ram/ kye hud/ skal dman nga'i bsod nams dang la rgya'i bden mthu chung bas/ mig mdun nas grogs mchog tshangs dbyangs bzang po glo bur du yal ba 'di rmi lam ma yin nam/ 'di 'dra sems kyis kyang bzod dam/tshangs dbyangs bzang po lags/ khyed dang bral bas nyin mtshan kun tu bde skyid mi 'dugakhyed dang bral bas bdag gi sems khams stong pa chags song / khyed dang bral bas bdag gi sems par rang dbang mi 'dug kye ma las 'bras kyi chos nyid/ chos skyong gi nus mthu/113

la rgya'i bden mthu zhes pa da lta gang du yal lam/ gal srid yod na/ yid chad dang skyo gdung / bral gdung dang skyo snang gi mun pa'i nang gcig pur lus shing grogs dang bral ba'i skal dman bdag la grogs mchog tshangs dbyangs bzang po myur du mjal ba'i skal bzang gi go skabs thengs gcig rang stsol rogs gnang / 'di ni nyam chung bdag gi tshe gcig nang khyed tshor zhu ba'i re smon gcig pu de rang yin/ tshangs dbyangs bzang po lags/ bsam yas bshad grwa'i phu nu yongs kyis bshad tshad khyed kyi skor/ bsam tshad khyed kyi don du yin/ la rgya'i bden mthu dang / lhag bsam dkar po'i smon tshig gdung ba'i dbyangs su gyer te/ khyed mchog gang du phebs rung lus sems gnyis la skad cig tsam yang sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / gang mgyogs mjal ba'i skal bzang gi nam zlar nyin mtshan kun tu re skug byed bzhin mya ngan gyi zas dang mchi ma'i btung bas dus 'da' bzhin gnas lags/ /'bra'( /e ma/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i 'jig rten 'di yi steng gi yang rtser gnas pa'i gangs can bho ṭa zhes phyogs bzhi'i skye bo kun gyis bsngags pa'i me rtag lan brgyar 'thor ba de yi mdzes ljongs dang sgyu rtsal rig gnas khyad chos sogs ni/ dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor 'di yi steng du bskrun thabs med pa zhig dang / 'gran zla bral ba zhig red/ de yi lo rgyus dang khyad chos sogs zhib phra rjod pa'i tshe/ skye bo su 'dra zhig yin rung blo gros kyi spobs pa'i rtsal yang ngal bar nges la/ ro 'dzin gyi dbang po yang dbang med du ngal bar nges/ lhag tu gangs can bho ṭa'i mdzes ljongs ni/ phun tshogs byed po'i pir gyis kyang bskrun par dka' ba zhig yin te/ mthon mthing g.yu ltar sngo ba'i rtswa thadzadang / dben zhing nyams dga'i ne'u 114

gsing / dwangs gtsang gi chu 'gram dang / grib bsil can gyi nags khrod du 'tsho sdod byed pa'i spu mdog rnam par bkra zhing mig gi bdud rtsi dang / yid kyi dpyid kar gyur pa'i ri dwags rnam pa sna tshogs dang / g.yang dkar lug khyu/ rta drel/ 'bri g.yag la sogs pa rnams bag phebs ci dgar rgyu zhing phan tshun rtse 'jos dus 'da' ba mthong ba'i tshe/ gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir sum rtsen lha yi mdzes ljongs dngos su 'phos pa min nam snyam nas dbang med du/ ne+e'u gsing dga' tshal mthon mthing g.yu ltar sdo/ /'bab chu'i chu klung bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzhin bzang / /rkang 'thung rin chen gdugs ltar bsil grib can/ bho ṭa'i yul ljongs 'chi med grong bzhin mdzes/ zhes brngod par mi thal ba'i rang dbang ci/ de bzhin bho ṭa'i shes rig ni/ 'od stong chem chem 'phro ba'i rdo rje pha lam gyi lhun po dang gnyis su ma mchis/ de yang lo ngo stong phrag gi snga rol du/ bod rgyal so gsum pa/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i blon chen/ gangs can mun pa'i sgron me/ gdong dmar bod kyi bla srog blo gsar gzhon nu'i skyed ma/ bka' drin mtshungs med kyi mnga' bdagamatshan nas brjod par dka' ba'i gangs can gyi mes po ste/ thon mi sam bho ṭas shes rig gi ba dan 'dzam gling gi ri bo'i mtho shos su grags pa'i jo mo glang ma'i steng du sgrong nus pa'i snying stobs dang / mig rgyang la bsam pa tsam gyis kyang / gangs can gyi mes po rnams sgyid lug dang bag 'khum gyi dgra bo las rgyal te/ shes rig gi thad gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ stong gsum skad kyis chod pa'i mkhas mdzangs can gyi dpa' bo zhig yin par ra sprod gsal por byas yod la/ lhag tu bho ṭa'i shes rig gi ngang tshul ni/ thon mi mchog gis gsar gtod mdzad pa'i gangs can gyi skad yig med byung gi shes rig ces phyogs bzhir grags shing / gna' bo'i gzhung bzang las da bar nyams med sra brtan du gnas pa'i/ 'chad rgyun chu bo las ring zhing / rtsod tshul dar seng las ngar ba/ brtsam chos gangs ri las mtho ba'i khyad nor rnams/ ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs mkhyen rab kyi lang tsho bkra ba'i gangs ljongs kyi bu 115

phrug rnams la/ mdzes rgyan du bzhag pa'i mes po'i snying nor zhig kyang red la/ gangs ljongs kyi snyan grags phyogs bcur sgrog pa'i snyan 'jebs kyi gling bu zhig kyang yin par dngos stobs kyi rigs pas grub/ de ni gangs ljongs shes rig gi rgya mtsho las chu thigs kyi drug cha tsam zhig blangs te brjod pa tsam las/ rgyas par ni/ dkar 'jam gyi shog bu dang /gnag snum gyi snag tsha/ rno ngar gyi smyu gus kyang 'dang bar dka' la/ kho bo'i rnam dpyod kyis de bas kyang / kho bo yang / le lo dang rnam g.yeng kho na'i ngang du ma bsdad par/ mi rigs kyi la rgya dang / pha yul la legs skyes 'bul ba'i ched/ rang gi skad yig dang rig gzhung la slob sbyong byed tshul du dpal bsam yas nang bstan slob grwa'i slob ma zhig yin khul lags/nga tsho'i slob grwa yang slob grwa spyi dang 'dra bar dbyar kha'i gung gseng grol nas tshur 'dzoms pa'i nyin mo der/ bu nga yang skyed ma dang zhal gyes zhu ba'i nyin mo de red/ pha yul gyi thon khungs dang bstun te sha mar thud sogs mang dag cig bskur nas/ skyed mas kho bo rlangs 'khor gyi 'gram bar skyel bar phebs/ de'i zhogs pa rlung bsil dal bur g.yo zhing / nyi 'od dang mi tshogs kyi khrod du bsang gi du ba lang long du 'byur ba'i zur nas/ skyed ma mchog kho bo dang 'bral bar mi bzod par sku skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur dang / thugs 'breng ba'i skyo gdung / gsung 'khreng ba'i snying gtam mang du gsungs nas/ dkar gtsang gi mjal dar bu nga'i ske la g.yog cing / 'jam mnyen phyag gis nga yi lag gnyis dam por bzung ste/ dkar mdzes zla ba'i bzhin las/ kho bo dang 'bral bar mi phod pa'i brtse sems kyi 'od mdangs lham mer 'char nas/rab mdzes spyan mig zung las rin thang brjod du med pa'i mu tig gi chab rgyun 'dzad med du 'bab cing / sgra gdangs shin tu dma' ba'i gsung gis 'bral kha'i gtam skyed ma'i bslab bya/ 'di ltar bstsal/ bu nyon dang / ma nga'i snying gi nor bu khyed kyis rang gi skad yig dang rig gzhung la sbyang brtson rnyad med byas te/ rang gi mi rigs dang mi rigs kyi rig gzhung ched legs skyes 'bul shub pa zhig byed rogs/ de ma rgan nga'i re ba che shos yin 116

gsungs/ de ltar rin thang gzhal bar dka' zhing nam yang brjed mi nyan pa'i drin skyed ma'i bka' slob kyi nying khu de/ sgra 'dzin gyi lam du gyur ma thag thos par dka' ba'i bka' slob kyi nus pas re zhig tshor shes bral ba'i bem po ltar yud tsam lus pas/ mgo bos lcog tsam byed pa las/ ngag nas lags so zhes brjod pa'i nus pa yang bral/ de nas rlangs 'khor dal bur skyod bzhin kho bo'i 'dren byed zung las mchi ma'i chab rgyun 'bab 'go tshugs/skyed mas phyag g.yug gnang zhing gzugs por bdag gces gyis gsungs nas/ lam gyi zur du krong nger bzhugs/ ngas kyang lag pa g.yug ste ga le bzhugs zhes rjod mur rlangs 'khor ni je mgyogs su phyin pas/ mchi zhag dang thal rlung gi khrod du skyed ma'i sku gzugs rab rib tsam nas mthar mjal ba'i skal bas dben pas/ skyo snang gi lam bu brgyud/ yid kyi pho nya drin chen skyed ma'i drung du bskyod rung / lus po ni rlangs 'khor gyis skyed ma dang thag ring 'phral bas thabs kyis dben te/ blo kha nang du phyogs nas bsam blo gtong skabs/ skyed ma'i bslab bya dran pas/ bdag gi skyed ma ni/ mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i shes yon can dang /bod kyi skad yig thad byang chub pa'i mkhas dbang zhig ma yin rung / 'on kyang / rang gi skad yig dang rig gzhung la gces spras bya dgos lugs kyi bslab bya de ltar bskyon thub pa de ni/bod kyi pha mes nas pha mes brgyud de bho ṭa'i mi rigs kyi snying dbus su gnas pa'i rang gi skad yig la bcangs pa'i la rgya'i rang mdangs zhig yin par sems/ khong tshos bho ṭa'i rig gzhung dang skad yig la de ltar gces spras bya dgos don yang / thog ma gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rig gzhung dar spel gyi ched/ bka' drin gzhal bar dka' zhing mkhas mdzangs kyi chos rgyal rnam pas rgyu nor gyi snying po rin chen gser gyi phye ma phangs med ngang slob yon du bskur zhing / bho ṭa'i shes rig dang / chos lugs/ mi rabs rjes ma'i khe phan bcas kyi ched/ rang nyid kyi bde skyid mchil ma'i thal ba ltar dor cing / btsan po'i bka' lung spyi bor blangs te/nga tsho'i mes po rnam pas lam chas rgyab tu 'khur zhing rkang gnyis kyi ngal ba kho na la brten nas/117

la klung du ma brgal/ 'dzam gling hril por myul te/ ngal dub kyi rngul chu'i sbrang char babs shing / zungs khrag dron mo'i chab rgyun bzhus na yang / lhag bsam dang snying stobs kyi me lce gyen du 'bar te/ rang gi gces pa'i tshe sgog kyang phangs med ngang kha ba'i ljongs kyi shes rig dang / mi rabs rjes ma'i bde skyid dang mdun lam/ khe phan bcas kyi ched du legs skyes su phul ba'i bla na med pa'i gangs can gyi mes po'i rlabs mdzad bzang gi bka' drin bsam tshe/ bsam shes can gyi skyes bu yin phyin lus nas ba spu g.yo ba'i me tog 'thor zhing / 'dren byed zung nas mchi ma'i yon chab bshams te/ ngag gis bla na med pa'i gangs can gyi mes po'i phyag rjes zhes bskal pa'i bar du'ang brjod nges la/ yid kyis kyang lhad med kyi gdung sems mtshon pa'i mjal dar nam 'tsho'i bar du 'bul bar nges/ des na gangs can bod kyi shes rig ni/ rin chen gser gyi phye ma las grub pa'i ri bo zhig dang /rngul chu dang zungs khrag las grub pa'i rgya mtsho zhig kyang red la/ mes po'i tshe srog dang snying stobs las grub pa'i sgron me zhig dang / mi rabs rjes ma'i mdun lam dang khe phan/bde skyid dang 'tsho gnas kyi sa bon zhig kyang red/ des na nga tsho bod gangs can gyi gzhen nu tshos/ skyid lug dang / bag 'khum gyi dgra bo las rgyal zhing / rang gi skad dang rig gzhung la yid ches dang gdeng 'jog zab mo gnang ste/ rtag tu brtson pa drag pos sbyong ba las/ dma' 'bebs dang mthong chung sogs kyi sgo nas 'dor ba ni/ nags la gnas pa'i spre'us rang gnas ljon shing bzang por mi gtsang ba'i bshang gci 'thor ba'i ngang tshul dang shin tu mtshungs pas shes ldan kun gyis dmod bya'i gnas yin/ nga tshos bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang nang don rig pa spyong dgos la/ tshan rig ni de bas kyang sbyong dgos/ gal srid bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang nang don rig pa ma sbyangs tshe/ nga tshor gzhan phan lhag bsam dang / ya rabs kyi mi gshis/ 'od stong 'phro ba'i lo rgyus sogs 'byung mi srid la/ tshan rtsal gyi lag rtsal ma sbyangs tshe/ nga tshor/ yar rgyas dang gong 'phel gyi mtho rlabs gsar pa zhig 'phyur mi 118

srid/ da dung / mi rigs gzhan gyi spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa dang / khrom ra'i dpal 'byor ni de bas rjes zin thub kyi ma red/ lhag tu nga tshos nang pa'i rig gzhung dang tshan rig ma sbyangs tshe/ mi rigs kyi skad yig dang rig gzhung la dma' 'bebs btang ste mi rigs kyi la rgya dang / mi rigs kyi khe phan la gtor bshig gtong ba'i blun rmongs de tsho'i bag 'khum gyi klad pa dang / gzhan lta mchog 'dzin gyi rmongs dad la/ dngos stobs rigs pa dang tshan rig zung 'brel gyi sgo nas gsha' bcos byas te/ nad ngan de'i rigs rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin mi nus/ nga tsho'i mes po'i dus nas gzhan gyi skad yig dang rig gzhung sogs kyi legs cha blangs te sbyong ba'i phrol bzang yod pa ji bzhin/ gangs phrug gzhen nu nga tshos kyang rang gi skad yig dang rig gzhung / mi rigs kyi 'tsho gnas ched du sngon thon gyi shes bya dang rig gnas kun brtson pa drag pos sbyong dgos/ mdor na/ rno dngar shin tu mi bzad pa'i ze mo'i sgro yis ze mo rang nyid la dus nam yang mi gnod pa ji bzhin/ gangs phrug gzhon nus sbyangs pa'i rig gzhung dang / shes yon gang gis kyang bod kyi mi rigs dang bod kyi skad yig la mi gnod pa zhig tu nges par du 'bad par 'tshal/ /rang lo 26 2006 lo'i zla 5tshes 8nyin/119

mdzo' che kyi 11 nya/ṭ+wāṃdi snang kun rdzob lkor ba'i me dong nang / /da 'ong r+ṣagasasgro sas pa'i phye leb dag /sdug bsnga~X me lte klong du bsregs pa/ na/ /dga' ba yul las gdung ba lūng 'a skyo/ /sde1)() ——

dranagadudagochil chil bzhun ba'i mchi mar 'dzad mtha' med/ /yang yang dran pa'i zug rngur sel thabs dben/ /lhang lhang 'bod sgras ri klung 'geng na yang / /brtse brtse dge slob mjal 'dzoms med 'di skyo/ /bsam yas dgon zhes rna bas thos pa 'am/ /slob thon dran rten 'dra par mthong thengs rer/ /snying nas brtse ba'i brtse ldan phu nu dang / /khri srong slob gling sems nang thengs re dran/ /skad cig 'bral bar mi phod gdung sems can/ /lus sems gnyis kyi cha shas khyed phyogs dang / / rizhal gyes zhu ba'i ngang tshul dran pa'i tshe/ /khra chung mig nas mchi ma'i thigs phreng 'thor/ /mi rtag sgyu ma zhes pa'i khrel med 'dis/ /snying gi mchog gyur bsam yas dge slob dang / / nyam chung kho bo'i lus po phral ba 'di/ /bdag gis khyed la nongs pa gang byas sam/ /121

kye ma dge slob bral ba'i skyo gdung gis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu 'khyol thabs mi 'dug pas/ /rab dkar snying nas brtse ba'i la rgya'i mthus/ /ring min kun dang myur du mjal bar smon/ /mnyam 'dzoms skal bzang bde skyid nyi ma ba.a/ /kha bral skyo gdung mun pa'i thang r+sā steng / /gcig pur lus pa'i ra smad 'khyam po yis /khri srong slob grogs dran pas smre ngag 'byin/ /nyam chung thag ring yul gyi 'khyam po ngas/ /brtse ldan khyed mchog dran pa'i smre ngag 'di/ /khri srong slob grogs su yi gsan na yang / /rab dkar la rgyar gzi mdangs 'phro bar nges /rang lo 24 004lo'i zla 0tshes8nyin/gnyan smror bami 'jin yid rdzibo nya /snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i snyan ngag gling bu dang / /rab tu mdzes pa'i tshig rgyan me tog tshogs/ /grangs las 'das pa'i mngon brngod ser phreng gis/ /22 mdun bsus gas po'i sems waṃn gsan par 'tshal /

gcen mo'i mkhyen pa'i mkha' dbyings klong dkyil nas/ /gcung por brtse ba'i glog sprin rab g.yos te/ /snyan 'jebs gsung 'phrin dbyar rnga bzhad pa'i sgras/ /bdag yid mdongs mthar dga' bde'i dpal gyis khengs/ /gcen mo'i phyag sor las thon brtse ba'i 'phrin/ /gcung po'i gam der lhags pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dren byed zung nas mchi ma'i bsu chang dang / /dwangs gtsang lhad med gdung sems mjal dar gyis/ /mdun nas bsus te mig gi lam brgyud nas/ /snying dbus gzhal yas khang nang gdan drangs shing / /mi brjed dran shes seng khrir brtan par bzhugs/ /re zhig dus sprin stug po'i rkyen gyur pas/ /brtse ldan gcen mo'i zla zhal ma mjal bas/ /bdag yid ku mud dran gdung gis zum yang / /gsung 'phrin bdud rtsi'i nying khu'i chab bsil gyis/ /med byung bde skyid bstsal bas bka' drin che/ /phran yang cha rgyus med pa'i gzhan yul du/ /brtse ldan yab yum spun mched dang bral yang / /shes rig yon tan rab mdzes smin legs dang / /123

shin tu mdza' bas nyin maphywa 'grogs bawo mchis/ /sh+kas bzang ṣ+kan mo ma 'ongs lo zla'i nang / /tshe ring nad med ci bsam yid bawo hrūb/ /chos spyod bya bas nyin maphywa dus 'da' zhing / /bde skyid dga' bde'i dpal gyis phyug par smon/ /de skad smra ba po yang shes sos pa/ /khyed la gdung ba'i lkong po dge legs nas/ /lhag bsam zol med gdung sems mardzo pa'i r+sā/ /gcen mo'i phyogs su zla tshes bzang por phul/ /rang lo 00po'i zla tshes 9nyin/waṃ d+kugyigru sa///ba nga gnathag ga3ston rje /lhing 'jags rgya mtsho ji bawo zhi dul gyi/ /sh+kas 'jam dro skyid ldan pa'i grogs mchog khyed/ /ngo mjal byung ba'i m+mu rma nyin mo der/ /kho bo'i yid la sngon med dga' ba 'phel/ /24 de nas sngo bsangs mdangs 'dzin dwangs gtsang gi/ /

rab yangs gtsang chu sngon mo'i klong dkyil du/ /myur mgyogs 'phrul gyi gzings nang zhugs gyur nas/ /chu mo'i pha rol 'gro ba'i sta gon bshams/ /gtsang chu ṇaphre mo'i rba rlabs chil chil 'phyur/ /glog gru'i 'khor sgra rna bar lhang lhang grags/ /zhogs pa'i bser rlung bsil bsil g.yo ba'i khrod/ /khyed kyi bzhin las 'dzum mdangs 'tsher 'tsher bzhad/ /bzod par dka' ba'i dgun gyi grang ngar dang / /shin tu bsil ba chu mo'i ngar shugs kyis/ /gzings nang lhan cig gnas pa'i sku mgron gyi/ /lag zung gnyis la grang reg tshor ba sbyin/ /de nas gang gi reg 'jam phyag zung la/ /bzhes pa'i phyag shubs zung gnyis phud gyur nas/ /de yi lag tu bkon par gyur pa'i tshe/ /bkon bya'i yul der sngar med sems 'gul thebs/ /reg 'jam phyag shubs zung gi tsha shugs dang / /zla bral sems khur gnang ba'i dro skyid kyis/ /grang ngar dgun gyi reg bya rab zhi nas/ /lus sems kun la dga' bde'i drod 'jam 'phel/ /dga' rtsom phyogs bsgrigs deb chung pho nya yis/ /mdza' gcig brtse ba'i 'brel ba dam sbrel nas/ /gshis bzang lang tshos phyug pa'i smin legs de'i/ /125

yid kyi zhags pa'i nang du kho bo chud/ /ngag 'jam smra mkhas rna ba'i bdud rtsi dang / /byams brtse'i 'dzum mdangs lhan cig bshad pa'i mod/ /bdag gi sems nang gdung ba kun zhi ste/ /ngo mtshar brjod par dka' ba'i bde skyid thob/ /rab mdzes chu skyes ma yin pad dkar zhal/ /'bad pas btsal ba ma yin las bskos 1snags/ /sha rus spun gyis ma sbrel khyed dang nga / /ma bcos sems kyi thag pas dam du bcings/ /dwangs gtsang lhad med mdza' gcugs gtsang po'i nang / /brtse sems gzings nang zhugs pa'i nged gnyis la/ /gser zhun dpal 'dzin ngang ser zung gnyis kyang / /yid smon 'chor te phyi mig blta bar rtsom/ /rab dkar mu tig mog pa'i bye ma'i ri/ /mthon mthing g.yu la 'khu ba'i gtsang po dang / /brtse ldan ngang ser skyengs pa'i gzhon nu sogs/ /nyin de'i ngo mtshar brngod la smra lce ngal/ /e ma gru 'di mgyogs su ma phyin nam/ /nam rgyun chod par dka' ba'i gtsang po de/ /de ring khyed nyid mjal ba'i dga' spro'i ngang / /ngang thung zhig la brgal ba'i snang ba 'char /yid 'ong khod snyoms snum nag lam chen steng / /126

myur mgyogs bya ltar 'phur ba'i 'phrul 'khor nang / /bde skyid dga' lha'i ngang nas skyod pa'i skabs/ /mi phod zhal gyes zhu ba'i dus la slebs/ /blo dkar gshis rgyud bzang ba'i grogs mchog dang / /mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral dgos ngang tshul 'dis/ /bdag gi sems nang skyo ba'i 'char snang zhig /'gog med 'char yang mi 'bral thabs med lags/ /bdag nyid gcig pu rlangs 'khor nang zhugs te/ /shin tu ring ba'i lam bur skyod pa'i skabs/ /skyo gdung yid kyi dngul dkar me long nang / /khyed kyi spyod bzang slar yang gsal bar mngon/ /nyin shas rjes su mjal skal thob pa'i dus/ /mdzangs ma khyed kyi ya rabs spyod bzang dang / /zhi dul thugs gshis 'jam pa'i 'od mdangs de//bzod par dka' bas mi g.yol thabs med lags/ /khyed kyis kho bor lhad med sems khur sogs/ /sngar 'dris grogs ltar gang legs gnang na yang / /bdag gis khyed la ci yang ma nus pas/ /yang yang snying gi dbus nas gnong 'gyod skyes/ /cha rgyus med pa'i 'jig rten lam bu'i steng / /ngo mjal med pa'i gus gnyis mjal ba ni/ /sngon gyi las dang phral gyi stes dbang gnyis/ /127

gang gis rkyen rung shin tu dga' ba'i gnas/ /'on kyang bsam khyer ngang tshul mdun lam sogs/ /yod 3 sgo nas gus gnyis tha dad pas/ /brtse ldan khyed mchog gcung mor bkur ba las /kho bo'i yid la'ang re g.yin 'chang thabs bral /gal te khyed kyi thugs la'ang 'khyam po bdag /spyon por 'dzin pa'i snyun bzang yod gyur na/ /de ring nas tshong gus ga3sa nam 'a྾ bar/ /rnyan r+ṣang la rgya 'gyur ba med par smon/ /rang lo 00lo'i zla 7che'i(7nyin/zusgo (da sku tshoṭa/tshe sngon legs byas bzang po'i 'bras bzang las/ /rab dkar gangs ri dkar d+ku bu brgyud du/ /skyes te kher rkyang lam bu'i thog bskyod pa'i/ /nyam chung kho bo'i las dbang ci zhig yin/ /brtse ldan skyed ma'i pang las ring bral te/ /rang yul rgyab dor mi yul pang blangs shing / /28 cha med yangs pa'i 'jig rten thang r+sā steng / /

mi tshe'i gom bgrod thog ma chos phyogs spos / /re zhig mtha' bral shes bya'i nam mkha' la/ /ci dgar rgyu ba'i blo gsar tshes gsum zla/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor 'phel bar phyogs ma thag /mi 'dod bar chad gzhan dbang sprin gyis bsgrib/ /phyi yi lus por mi 'dod sdug gis mnar/ /nang gi rang sems dngangs skrag 'ba' zhig las/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bag yod skabs bral ba'i/ /brjod dka'i sdug bsngal lam bu'ang brgyud nas yong / /kho bor sems khur byed pa'i brtse grogs dang / /skyo dus sems gso gtong ba'i brtse ldan gnyen/ /legs na gzengs bstod nyes na dma' 'bebs sogs/ /byed mkhan thams cad kho bo rang las med/ /bya gzhag 'ga' zhig ched du mtshan snyan dang / /gces pa'i rgyu nor blos gtong byed phod kyang / /mig ltar gces pa'i rab dkar la rgya 'di/ /nam 'tsho'i bar du blos gtong byed thabs bral /gces pa'i bu yang med la snying khongs nas/ /129

mdza' ba'i brtse grogs med kyang rang gshis la/ /lhad med brtse dung zab pa'i ngang tshul 'di/ /kun gyis khrel bgad byed pa'i yul du zad/ /'on kyang la rgya'i nor gyis cung phyug cing / /thabs dang nor gyis dbul ba'i kho bo la/ /gshis bzang la rgya don gnyer grogs mchog gcig /mjal ba'i re skug smon 'dun 'chang bzhin mchis/ /rab dkar la rgya gtsang ba'i grogs mchog rnams/ /rab mdzes lhag bsam dkar pos phyug gyur nas/ /rab tu brtse ba'i zhags pas mi lhod par/ /rab gsal lam bu'i steng du mjal bar smon/ /rang lo 23 2003 lo'i zla 9tshes 19nyin/dran ba /g.yo med drang zhing bdag la rab brtse ba'i/ /yang rtse'i nang gi brtse ldan grogs mchog drung / /don dang brjod bya dag sogs ma mchis kyang / /cung zad brtse ba'i gdung dbyangs 'di 'bul lo/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong mdzes sdug me bya'i lus/ /130

rna bar sbrang rtsi'i gan ster khu byug gsung / /zuring 1de/lnga/ /ste/ ///yadalaṭ+wāṃbadapal snyir r+shaja ga nyams/ /brtse ba groṭ+wāṃsamachogangaspyor bu dranatsho/'i/mtshar spyu nazlo gar+sha brgyad ṭ+wāṃnyaso lang dpal/ /lta bas ngamag bdud ṭ+wāṃngardzu/na /rab mdzes pad ṭ+wāṃkar dgyes pa ṭ+wāṃ ras las/ /g.yolda/bungab 'dren byed zur ga mdas/ /baXg dran shes go ṅgib la sogs gtor/ /ṭ+wāṃnyadangangalasemasadabang meṭ+wāṃ du/ /'ismi'agyur brtse snging zhags pas 'ang mkhas pa/ /yin le+ogaṭ+wāṃ ma k+ta groga~X mchog sdug gu ma/ /da 'ang ga bdud rab tu dran/ /gsamatsho'i lha zasadathādaga' tshasalha mo'i rgyud/smrebagazhi/byamasadar+sha snying rje'i chu shel las/ /baṭ+wāṃbs 'ing ṭ+wāṃwo dpeḍi dkyil wor rdzogs/ /ma byung yad dung zla yakā/ /blo snas kun da rgyaṭ+wāṃ rnyir mad/ /'ag rten rnyog ma nga bu stso / 3

skyes pa'i gtam rgyud 'dam bu'i tshal/ /rnyog ma'i dri mas sbags na yang / /rang bzhin brjod pa'i ngang nas gleng / /lha lam g.yu yi lding khang 'og /rab dkar chu 'dzin bla re g.yo/ /rgyu skar nor bu'i drwa phyed dang / /rlung gzhon dril chung sing sing bzhad/ /shel dkar ka ba gangs ri'i mgul/ /smug sprin dar gyis brdzid par brgyan/ /spel legs g.ya' spang nags ri yi/ /bsham bu'i 'ja' 'od rab tu bkra/ /gser 'od gzi byin 'bum 'phro ba'i/ /me shel nor bu'i sgron me'i 'og /maṇ+ḍal g.yu yi sa gzhi'i steng / /g.yang dkar mu tig tshom bur bkod/ /srab med kha dkar rkyang phrug dang / /rlung gi shugs rta mchog gnyis/ /myur mgyogs bang rtsal 'gran pa'i tshe/ /g.yag gu rag pa'ang 'ur bas na/ /rnga ma'i lto sprin rab 'phyur te/ /ngur sgra'i dbyar rnga ldir bzhin 'phyo/ /yid 'ong bag phebs ri dwags rnams/ /132

rtse 'jo'i gar la rol ba'i tshe /gser mig 'chang ba'i nya mo yang / /dga' bas 'phar mchongs ci yang byed/ /nam mkha'i glang po'i lang tsho la/ / chags pa'i spang rgyan me tog tshogs/ /mdzes sdug bzhin ras gyen phyogs te/ /dga' 'dzum ge sar rab tu bzhad/ /dri bzhen gzhon nu'i brtse se+oms kyis/ /bskul bas rkang 'thung bu ma rnams/ /mthon mthing lan bu g.yo bzhin du/ /mos pa'i mgo lcog yang yang byed/ /ling ling lang tsho'i gar stabs g.yo ba'i tshe/ /dkar dkar lha ba'i 'dzum mdangs gsal bar bshad/ /ldem ldem glog sprin smin ma'i gzhu mo nas/ /mtshar mtshar zur mda' 'phen pa'i g.yu mtsho med/ /rab dwangs dbang sngon zhun ma las grub pa'i/ /g.yu yi me long g.yu mtsho'i nye 'gram du/ /srid pa'i mdzes sdug ma lus gcig bsdus pa'i/ /g.yu mtsho'i grong zhesagrags pa'i yul gru na/ /legs bris bdag po'i pho brang mog pa'i bkod legs yid 'ong khang bzang dang / /rnam thos bu yi mdzod la 'bu ba'i rin chen nor gyi bang mdzod la/ /mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i gtong phod lhag bsam dpal gyis phyug pa'i khyo shug zung / /133

bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i rtse dgar longasasu spyod cing dga' bar rol /gang tshe yum gyi mngal bzang pad ma'i mtshor/ /khye'u ngang pa'i rgyal po zhugs pa'i dus/ /de tshe brang gi reg 'jam myos 'bur zung / /dga' ba mchog tu rgyas pa'i mdzes sdug ni//rab dkar zho yis bkang ba'i shel bum la/ /be+eḍār ya yi thig les bskus pa bzhin/ /mdzes pa'i pang gdan nam mkha' 'ja' ris 'og /sprum ma'i lto ba shin tu 'bur ba ni/ /grang ngar bzod par dka' ba'i dgun gyi dus//dkar 'jam 'khyag 'bur gzhon nu'i dbyibasadang mtshungs//de nas zla dgu ngo bcu rdzogs pa'i mthar/ /chu gter klong nas ri bong 'dzin pa 'am/ /lhun po'i spo nas rta ljang 'char ba bzhin/ / brtse ldan yum gyi mngal las bde bar btsas/ /chubadu michu'i/de tshe tsan dan gzhong pa'i nang / /drod 'jam chu yis khrus gsol te/ /dkar gtsang ka ci'i dar gos kyis/ /34 khye'u'i sku lus mdzes par bsgron/ /

de yi legs byas bgo skal du/ /thob pa'i nu 'bur zung gnyis kyi/ /zhim mngar nu zho 'dzin pa'i tog /ro 'dzin gzhen nu'i bdud rtsir bstsal/ /byams pa'i gter chen skyed ma yis/ /pang du la'i ba'i khye'u de'i/ /mtshungs zla bral ba'i mdzes sdug ni/ /mig gi bdud rtsi 'di ltar lags/ /bzhin ras zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /smin ma'i ri bong gzugs kyis mdzes/ /dpral ba'i dbyibs ni rab che zhing / /mgo bo gdugs kyi spun zlar 'os/ /dkar nag cha rnams ma 'dres pa'i/ /shin tu dwangs pa'i mig 'bras dang / / sna yi dbyibs mtho mchu sgros dmar/ /lus kyi yan lag kun mdzes pa'i tshoyid 'ong gzhon nu 'di mthong na/ /'dren byed gzhan du g.yo re kan/ /de ltar mtshar sdug gzhon nu der/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i yab dang / /nye du ma lus gcig mthun gyis/ /g.yu mtsho'i grong du bltams pa dang / /135

lha yi sras ltar rab mdzes pas/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras zhes su btags/ /drin chen skyed mas nyin dkar khyim gyi las rnams kun dor zhing / /shin tu skyid pa'i mtshan mo'i gnyid kyang bcag ste legs bskyangs pas/ /g.yu mtsho'i sras kyi lang tsho zla ba yar gyi tshes pa 'am/ /nyi zer 'phros pa'i mtsho nang pad ma ji bzhin rgyas par 'gyur/ /rab dmar mchu sgros byu ru'i me tog dbus su shel dkar gyi/ /tshems kyi ze 'bru cung zad mngon zhing yid 'ong mgrin pa nas/ /dog pa'i skad cha ne sdu'i dbyangs kyi rjes mthun smra ba'i tshe/ /yum gyi yid la dga' skyid dpyid ka bshad pa'i pho nyar mtshungs/ /de yi lang tsho rgyas par myur bas na/ /rkang pa zung yang dngangs shing rab 'dar bas/ /re zhig yan lag bzhi ka sar btsugs te/ /ba lang bu dang mi 'gran thabs med byung / /brang 'gro'i brtul zhugs bzung ste ngal brgya yis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun gzhal ba'i dka' thub la/ /ngo mtshar 'bras bu ci yang ma byung bas/ /nor 'dzin sgeg mor shin tu khros drag ste/ /snying stobs chen pos rang lus bsran tshugs shing / /rdog pas brdzis te 'khon lan mtshon par byas/ /byis pa'i skyed tshal sdum ra'i nang / /thal ba'i rtsed mo'i dga' ston dang / /136

ngo mtshar med byung rtsed mo ste/ /g.yang dkar lug gu'i a lhug gi/ /rtsed mor shin tu rngam pas na/ /'khyog po'i gom bgrod la brten nas/ /yang yang 'gyel yang bzod bsran dang / /ches cher brtson pas myur ldangs te/ /rab dkar dung la 'khu ba'i g.yang dkar dang / /gnag snum char sprin mdangs 'dzin 'bri dang g.yag /myur mgyogs rkyang dkar skyengs pa'i cang shes dang / /yid 'ong ri dwags gshone nus yongs khengs pa'i/ /dbang sngon lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i rtswa thang steng / /shin tu mthun pa'i rtse rogs bstan 'dzin dang / /dri zhim me rtag sna tshogs 'thu ba sogs/ /rnam grangs du ma'i rtse 'jo'i dpal la rol /gzhon nu de gnyis sngon bsags las smon nam/ /yang na kun spyod shin tu mthun pas sam /chu dang nya mo'i brtse sems yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /brtse ldan de gnyis ye ma shin tu mdza'/ /lhag par char ldan dus kyi tshe/ /chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i nying khu ste/ /sbrang char bdud rtsis sku khrus gsol/ / smug sprin na bza' mdzes par bklubs/ /137

dbang po'i gzhu yi ska rags 'chang / /me tog du ma'i rgyan gyis spud/ /mthon mthing lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin pa'i/ /rtswa thang g.yu yi gzhen nu ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos phyug gyur pa'i/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhen nu yi/ /chung nas 'dris pa'i dga' mar gyur/ /she bya rigadamakhyen dbyod yangs pa'i lha lam klong du byams brtse'i chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs/ /shes rig gru char zim bus bu chung yid kyi zhing sa brlan pa'i ched/ /re ba'i mig zung glog zhags g.yo zhing don ldan bslab bya dbyar rnga'i sgras/ /ma nga'i gces phrug o lo khyed nyid slob grwa'i dga' tshal 'grims shig gsungs/ /gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shin tu legs shing slob grwar bskyod pa'i bkra shis rten 'brel nyin mo der/ /der yod sku mgron kun gyis gdung sems mtshon pa'i dkar gtsang mjal dar dga' bas g.yogs dang lhan/ /lhan skyes blo rig bkra ba'i g.yu mtsho'i lha sras khyed kyis mi rigs 'di dang pha yul ched/ /ched las bod kyi rig gzhung bslabs te nga tsho'i mig dpe bya dgos zhes pa'i re smon bcol/ /mdzes mdzes dpe khug rgyab tu legs par 'khur/ /mthun mthun spyod yon gnyis ldan slob grogs dang / /rings rings mnyam du 'grogs te slob gling gi/ /138

brdzid brdzid rgyal sgo 'dzul ba'i tshul 'di med/ /yangs yangs mkhyen dpyod lha lam yangs pa'i klong / /dkar dkar lhag bsam dkyil 'khor yongs gang ba'i/ /brtse brtse bshes gnyen rgyu skar dbang po des/ /mtshar mtshar rig pa'i 'od stong stsol dus skyid/ /zhogs pa dkar zhing gtsang ba'i 'dzin grwa'i nang / /dbyangs gsal 'gyur khug len pa'i dbyangs de snyan/ / dgong dro gnag snum 'jam pa'i nag pang steng / /ang rtsis ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi sgyu rtsal ngom/ /brtse ldan bshes gnyen spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur/ /slob grogs kun la phu nu'i 'du shes bcangs/ /brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brten pas na/ /bzang gsum slob ma'i mtshan snyan tshegs med thob/ /lo 'jug yig tshad sgrog pa'i nyin/ /brtse ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen des/ /kho bo'i ming nas 'bod gnang ste/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras yar longasazhes/ /rab brdzid spobs pa stsol ba'i gter/ /ske dar dmar po mgul du bcings/ /rin thang shin tu gzhal dka' ba'i/ /skul lcag gzengs bstod lag tu bstsal/ /de tshe dga' bsu dbyar rnga'i sgras/ /139

yid kyi mdongs mthar dga' bde sbrum/ /slob grwa'i rgyal sgo don ma thag /dga' bas myos pa'i gar stabs te/ /'phar ma mchongs kyi gom bgrod kyis/ /dbugs thengs gcig la nang du rgyugs/ /khyim gyi sgo mo 'dzul ma thag /a ma 'dir phebs zhes bos te/ /de ring kho bor bzang gsum gyi/ /slob ma'i mtshan snyan thob byung smras/ /de tshe brtse ldan skyed ma'i rab yangs byams brtse'i klong du dga' ba'i chu 'dzin lang long g.yos/ /khra sgor rnam par bkra ba'i 'dren byed zung nas sbrang char bdud rtsi'i gzegs ma 'bab dang lhan/ /mdzes sdug pad dkar gzhen nu'i bzhin ras dbus su gting nas dgyes pa'i ge sar rab bzhad de/ /gcesaphrug khyed kyis ma nga'i re ba don ldan 'gyur zhes 'jam pa'i phyag gis mgo bor byugs/ /yid 'ong slob 'bring shes bya'i dga' tshal nang / /rab mdzes yon tan me tog legs 'thu ba'i/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras mtshungs bral gzhen nu de'i/ /mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal gyi gzi byin dang / /med byung rnam dpyod yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis/ /ri bong 'dzin pas mtsho dang kun da bzhin/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rgyas par gyur/ /shes rig pad dkar gzhon nu'i nying bcud ze 'brur rab tu sred pa'i lha sras rwa yig 140

gnyis pa des/ khres bya'i nam 'phang gcod phyir brtson pa'i gzhog zung rgyun du g.yo zhing mngon zhen rlung gi shugs 'chang nas/ khres rig yon tan me tog du ma'i dri bsung 'thul ba'i lho kha yar klung mtho rim slob 'bring gi khes bya'i lham rar zhugs pa'i sta gon sna mang shes bya rig pa'i nying bcud gzhib par shin tu brel/ /dbyar zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhon nu de/ /g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin g.yu mtsho dang / /g.yu mtshor zhabrul ba'i rtswa thang las /zhal gyes zhus te slob grwar bskyod/ /myur mgyogs rlung gi shugs 'chang ba'i/ /bya ltar 'phur ba'i rlangs 'khor des/ /rang yul g.yu mtsho'i grong tsho dang / /yangs pa'i rtswa thang rab brgal te/ /dus yun shin tu thung ngu'i nang / /gam pa la yi 'gram du slebs/ /margad mdag can gam pa las/ /sprin dkar dar gyi na bza' bklubs/ /a sngon g.yu yi mching zhwa rgyu+on/ /kyag kyog lam bu'i mjal dar dang / /g.yu mtsho'i dngul phor mdun du thogs/ /'dzum po'i gzi byin rab 'bar te/ /yar 'brag bla gsar gzhan nu rnams/ /141

shesarig nor bu 'tshol ba'i ched/ /gzhan yul slob grwa 'grim pa la/ /sgol med sems khur mtshon pa'i phyir/ /skyel ma'i tshul du chas pa bzhin/ /smug pa'i na bun rab 'thibs pa'i/ /gam pa la mo'i rtse mo nas/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhon nu des/ /rang yul phyogs su phyi mig 'phangs/ /byed po'i blo las ma thon la/ /mkhas pas pir gyis ma bris kyang / /mig dang yid kyi lcags kyu ste/ /yul 'di'i mdzes ljongs 'di ltar lags/ /rta bdun dbang po'i tsha ngar gyis/ /gnam sngon bzhur ba'i g.yu mtsho dang / /sbrang char zim bus bas dang lhan/ /smug sprin dar gyis rab phyis pa'i/ /rtswa thang margad me long nang / /dkar nag phyugs rigs bkrag mdangs ldan/ /spang ljongs sngon mo'i gar stegs steng / /khra chil me tog bzhad pa'i khrod/ /bag phebs ri dwags gshone nu yis/ /rtse las zlos gar ci yang lkob/ /142

rab bajid sbra gur nag po las/ /du zhag lang long 'byur ba 'di/ / —byang 'brong dar ma rab khros te/ /kha rlangs na bun 'tshub pa bzhin/ /chu shel nor bu'i gangs ri dang / /g.yu yi lhun po spang ri'i klong / /sprin dkar thur du dpyang 'dra ba'i/ /dwangs bsil rbab chu yi gar 'ong / /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhon nu de'i/ /kun rtog yid kyi 'char sgo la/ /mig gi bdud rtsi'i gter gcig pu/ /pha yul rang byung mdzes ljongs 'dir/ /sum rtsen tshal yang rab skyengs te/ /lha yi yul du bros sam snyam/ /myur mgyogs rlangs 'khor dal khom bral te mdun du rim bzhin skyod pa'i tshe/ /sngo ljang can gyi ljon pas brgyan pa'i rgyus med yul gru sna tshogs dang / /khod snyoms lag mthil skyengs par byed pa'i snum nag lam chen yangs pa'i steng / /'dra min rlangs 'khor che chung sna tshogs gcig las gcig mgyogs tshul du rgyugs/ /dka' chad ngal dub bral ba'i rlangs 'khor des/ /phyi yi lus po skyid pa'i pha yul las/ /le dbar du mas ring du phral na yang / /nang gi sems pa yul dang nye bar phyin/ /143

dran gdung chu 'dzin stug po lang long 'khrigs/ /skyo ba'i mchi ma'i sbrang char 'bab par nye/ /yul dang bral ba'i zug jus rab gdungs pas/ /rlangs 'bor nang du yid chad gnyid du yur/ /de mur rmi lam zhing khams 'grims ma thag /byams dang snying rje'i bdag nyid skyed ma yis/ /spyan mig zung nas spyan chab bsil bzhin du/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bu yi ming nas bos/ /brtse ba'i phyag gis mgo bor byugs dang lhan/ /dkar gtsang a she'i mjal dar g.yog pa sogs/ /de ring zhogs pa'i skyel ma byas tshul rnams/ /mngon sum rmis pas de yid rab gdung ste/ /a ma zhes pa'i smre ngag dbang med shor/ /shin tu mdza' ba'i slob grogs bstan 'dzin gyis/ /lha sras zhes pa'i ming nas 'bod ma thag /gnyid las sad kyang 'dren byed zung gnyis las/ /bzhur ba'i mchi ma pang du lhung ba mthong /dran gdung gcong nad sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ /brtse ldan grogs po'i lhad med sems khur dang / /rgyus med ngo mtshar che ba'i yul gyis kyang / /skyo ba'i yid kyi gdung ba cung zad zhi/ /rab mdzes sprin dkar lha reg 'chang ba'i gangs dkar yar lha sham po dang / /144

chu shel me tog rab tu bshad pa'i ngo mtshar shel brag ri bo yi/ /gsham du margad ting nang g.yu chu'i yon chab dngos su phul 'dra ba'i/ /yar klung mdzes rgyan slob grwa de'i nang lha sras 'khor bcas rab tu bzhugs/ /brdzid brjid thog brtsegs can gyi bkod legs yid 'ong khang bzang dang / /mdzes mdzes med du byung ba'i dbang sngon byugs pa'i sdum ra sogs/ /gtsang gtsang yid kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i yid 'ong khor yug dang / /mtshar mtshar rgyan gyis sbud pa'i slob grwa nga tsho'i pha khyim lags/ /tha dad yul gru sna tshogs nas/ /lhags pa'i cha med slob ma rnams/ /slob grwar 'byor tho bkod ma thag /so so'i 'gan khur dge rgan gyis/ /rang rang mal khang nang du 'khrid/ /rgyab tu mal chas 'khur dang lhan/ /pang du skye phad cig bzung 'i/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhon nu yang / /rang gi nyal khang nang du 'byor/ /bkod legs dkar cha rab dod pa'i/ /dwangs gtsang dben pa'i nyal khang nang / /bang rim can gyi nyal khri dang / /snum zhag dod pa'i sgrog ce'i steng / /slob ma so so'i ja dam sogs/ /nyer mkho'i yo byad 'thus sgo tshang / /145

de nas lha sras gzhon nu des/ /ang grangs bzhi pa'i mal khri'i steng / /'jam pa'i mal gdan legs bting nas/ /ngal gso'i tshul du cung zad gnas/ /de mtshams rta bdun dbang po yang / /nub ri'i rgyab tu dal bur bzhud/ /slob ma'i sems kyi 'jig rten du/ /skyo ba'i grib so rim bzhin langs/ /dgong dro'i kha zas zos pa'i rjes/ /nyal khang gcig pa'i slob ma kun/ /dkar gsal glog bzhu'i 'od mdangs 'og /bang rim can gyi mal khri'i steng / /'khod de ngo sprod byed bzhin du/ /yul dang bral bas rab gdung pas/ /phan tshun shin tu mdza' ba'i ngang / /nyin de'i mtshan mo de ltar 'das/ /de ring mal khang gcig nang 'dzoms pa'i slob grogs rnams/ /de sngon phan tshun ngo mjal tsam yang med na yang / /de ring nas bzung rjes su slob mthar ma phyin bar/ /de rnams khyim tshang gcig nang 'tsho ba'i nang mir gyur/ /phyi nyin so so'i 'dzin grwa dang / /slob grwa'i khor yug yongs rdzogs la/ /146

brtse ldan dge slob zung 'brel gyis/ /gtsang sbra'i las la shin tu gzhol/ /byams dang brtse bas thugs rgyud rab dul zhing / /zhing mchog dam pa brtse ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen du mas sku ngal khyad bsad de/ /de mur cong brdas bskul te slob tshan tshugs/ /med byung dben zhing nyams dga'i 'dzin grwa sa /ru star bsgrigs pa'i shes brtson slob bu la/ /la 'ur rgya bod dbyin yig slob dang lhan/ /lhan cig blang dor bka' slob du ma bstsal/ /rab mdzes mthon mthing mdangs 'dzin gling kha dang / /rab dwangs lhung lhung bzhur ba'i chu yi 'gram/ /rab mtshar rang byung nyi gdugs rkang 'thung 'og /rab brtson slob ma rang sbyong byed par brel/ /ring ring thag ring yul nas 'ong pa dang / /nye nye grong khyer 'dabs nas yin pa sogs/ /gzhon gzhon slob grogs gsar rnying pho mo rnams/ /yang yang yun ring gshibs pas rim bzhin 'dris/ /de nas rigs mthun phyogs la dga' zhen dang / /mi mthun phyogs la ngang gis sdang ba sogs/ /snying gi dbus su chags sdang slong byed pa'i/ /tshor snang skyur mo de yang gsal bar mngon/ /147

lhag par grong khyer nang gi slob ma 'gas/ /mthun sgril bla srog gcod pa'i gtam gyi mda'/ /grong gseb glen pa zhes pa'i brnyas bcos 'dis/ /lha sras yid la gdung ba drag po byin/ /nyin zhig bsam nor zhes pa'i slob grogs des/ /deng dus brda 'phrin dus rabs yin pas na/ /bod yig sbyangs na mdun lam til tsam med/ /rgya yig dbyin yig sbyangs na legs smrasapar/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhon nu rab khros te/ /mi rigs la rgya 'tshong ba'i klad med dang / /kha phor chab tog byed pa'i spyon pa'i rigs/ /rang nyid rang gis brlag pa'i glen pa khyod/ /bod yig rin bral gser gyi nyi ma 'dis/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi mun pa sel na yang / /'byung po'i bya khyod snang bas long pa 'di/ /bod yig rta ljang gzhon nu'i skyon ma yin/ /zhes pa'i rgol lan drag po smra ba'i tshe/ /nga tsho'i rgyab nas sgam bagling sgra dang bcas/ /dngos gnas yag po zhe drag smras so zhes/ /mkhyen ldan bshes gnyen 'jigs med dbang phyug gis/ /lha sras gzhon nur yid smon chen po gnang / /da dung khong gis khyed cag gzhon nu tsho'i/ /148

lag tu bod kyi dar rgud yod pas na/ /skad yig la rgya mig ltar gces pa las/ /bod pa'i rang tshugs shor na mi rung gsungs/ /na gzhon nged cag slob gling 'grim pa'i skabs/ /skabs 'gar slob grwar yong ba'i dmigs yul dang / /brtse ldan pha mas bskyon pa'i sku las rnams/ /gting nas brjed de 'khyam po 'ga' zhig dang / /mnyam du ngal gso'i nyin mor khyi smyon bzhin/ / rtsed thang grong khyer yongs rdzogs skor ba dang / /pha mas dka' bas bsags te bskur ba'i dngul/ /phangs sems spu tsam med par gang byung gtor/ /lhag tu za khang 'dra min nang 'dzul te/ /lkog tu tha mag 'then bzhin dgong dro'i mtshams /gsang ba'i ngang nas slob khang nang du log /tshul ldan kun spyod bzang ba'i slob ma dang / /brtse ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen mjal ba'i tshe/ /rang gis brtsams pa'i ma rabs spyod ngan la/ /bzod bral ngo tsha sang dka'i blo 'gyod kyis/ /mtshan mo'i gnyid thebs bcag pa grangs las 'das/ /skabs 'gar mi rigs 'di nyid ched du dang / /drin chen pha mar bka' drin gso ba'i ched/ /dka' ngal yod tshad rang gis khyad bsad de/ /149

shes bya'i gnas la shin tu brtson pa dang / /dge bkur slob gces byed bzhin slob grwa yi/ /sgrig khrims rnams la srung brtsi zhu bzhin mchis/ /de ltar legs nyes spyod pa spel ma'i ngang /dga' skyo 'dres ma'i cha med gzhan yul du//bag phebs dngangs skrag tshor snang zung 'brel gyi/ /nyin mtshan dbyer med slob ma'i lam bur bskyod/ /brgyad gnyis bcu drug lang tsho'i rta mchog la/ /bcib pa'i lha sras mtshungs bral gzhon nu de'i/ /yid kyi cang shes smin legs ma zhig gi/ /dwangs gtsang sems kyi ljang gzhen sdum rar shor/ /mdzes mdzes med byung lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin pa'i/ /mtshar mtshar g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gcig pu'i ngang / /snyan snyan dpe deb brtson pas klog bzhin du/ /dben dben slob grwa'i rgyab kyi gling khar bskyod/ /ba dubagyicug/sngo bsangs gnam sngon gdan du bting ltar me bya'i mgrin pa'i dpal 'dzin rab yangs rtswa thang dang / /khu byug bu mo'i glu dbyangs snyan zhing med byung bsil grib 'chang ba'i sngo ljang ljon shing 'og /ling ling lang tsho'i gar stabs bsgyur te rab dkar lha ba'i 'dzum phreng ba'ad pa'i chu 5ṭ+wāṃgram du/ khyun du brtse dung spyan mda' 'phen pa'i slob grogs gzhen nu ma de glu dbyangs

len bzhin mchis/ /dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i dbyangs las snyan/ /ne sdu'i ngag las shin tu 'jam/ /snying gi gdung ba kun sel ba'i/ /sgra 'dzin gzhen nu'i bdud rtsi mchog /na chung glu yi lcags kyu des/ /lha sras dbang med phyogs der bkug /med byung mtshungs bral mdzes ldan mar/ /dga' ba'i myu gu ba'ad pas na/ /mchu yi yal 'dab rab gsil te/ /gtam gyi sbrang char 'di ltar phob/ /bzhin ras ston zla'i dkyil zhabor dgyes pa'i sbun/ /bung ba'i rnam 'phrul g.yo ldan ri dwags mig /mthon mthing smin ma.āt+pal bshad pa'i tshal/ /dri zhim mchu sgros pad ma'i 'dab ltar dmar/ /tshems kyi ze 'bru mu tig phreng ba dngos/ /reg 'jam shel gyi myos 'bur dal bur g.yo/ /mtshang ra rgyas shing gangs ri lta bu'i lus/ /sked skabs phra la ste ba shin tu dma'/ /pad ma'i rtsa ba lta bu'i 'jam mnyen phyag /skra yi zhags pas bdag yid 'ching dang lhan/ /mig zur mda' mos zug rngu sbyin mkhas pa'i/ /151

yid kyi chom rkun khyod kyi mtshan ming dang / /skyid pa'i pha yul gang nas yin nam ci/ /mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal gyis nya gang ba'i/ /dwangs gtsang lhad med mtshan mo'i mgon po khyod/ /kho bo'i ku mud tshal nang chos nyid bzhin/ /'dod gdung mun sel sgron mer mi 'char ram zhes pa'i yid kyi nam mkha' la/ /brtse ba'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs te/ /don ldan dri ba dbyar gyi rngas/ /smin legs mdongs mtha' dga' bas myos/ /de tshe shin tu mdzes pa'i lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg ngom nas sgeg pa'i gar stabs ci yang sgyur/ /mtshar sdug pad dkar gzhen nu'i bzhin ras dbus su g.yo ldan bung ba'i zur mig yang yang 'byug /byi ru'i mchu yi me tog bshad de rab dkar thags bzang so yi ge sar mchog tu 'bar/ /ut+pal dris bsgos yid 'ong zhal nas gtam lan sbrang rtsi smra bar 'dod kyang ngo tshas bcings/ /de ltar gzhon nu'i brtse sems lde mig gis/ /mdza' mo'i sems kyi gsang sgo rab phye bas/ /dga' dang skyengs pa'i tshor ba 'dres ma'i ngang re zhig brgyal bas smra ba'i spobs pa bral /'on kyang khra sgor bkra ba'i 'dren byed nas/ /brtse sems gsang ba mtshon pa'i zur mig mda'/ /gzhon nu'i gdong la yang yang 'phen bzhin du/ /152

skyengs pa'i zol gyis dal bur slob grwar bskyod/ /mdzes ma'i rgyab gzhung 'phyo ba'i sgra lo yis/ /rjes su 'bod pa'i g.yab mo ltar byas pas/ /g.yu mtsho'i sras kyi brtse sems rta mchog des/ /thogs pa med par dga' ma'i rjes su bsnyegs/ /gser zhun mdangs 'dzin yid kyi ngang ser la/ /gzhon nu'i brtse sems mda' mo phog pas na/ /bzod dka'i tshor bas lus sems kun gdung pas/ /smin legs ma de mtshan gang mnal dang bral/ /phyi nyin zhogs pa rab mdzes mdzangs ma des/ /snying gi dbus nas brdol ba'i brtse 'phrin 'di/ /brtse dung rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i mdza' bo'i drung / /grogs mo mtshams gcod dbang mo brgyud de springs/ /lang tsho dar yang blo gros rgan/ /lus stobs che yang khengs pa chung / /mig dang yid kyi lcags kyu ste/ /yid 'ong gzhon nu khyed gson dang / /rab brjid brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i ri bo'i spor/ /rab mdzes bzhin ras rta ljang gzhon nu des/ /rab gtsang kho mo'i mdza' sems pad ma'i tshal /rab tu g.yos te dga' bas khyed la phyogs/ /pad ma'i 'dab ltar yangs pa'i mig zung mdzes shing smin ma gnag /153

yar ngo'i zla ltar dpral ba rab rgyas dkyus ring sna ni gzengs mtho zhing / /gnag snum dbu skra gyen du 'phyur ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi rjes su 'gro/ /stobs dang blo gros mtshungs zla bral ba'i khyed dang mardzal 'di skal ba bzang /khyed kyi mchu sgros sdum ra nas/ /snying gtam kun da bshad pa'i tshe/ /kho mo'i rnam shes ri bong 'dzin/ /gzhan du g.yo ba'i mthu dang bral/ /khyod kyi lang tsho'i me rtag gis/ /bdag yid bung ba rab bzi bas/ /mdza' gcugs gshog zung g.yo ba las/ /snying gtam smra ba'i dran shes nyams/ /mthong bas ngom pa med gyur pa'i/ /gzhon nu khyod kyi ming ni ci/ /yid 'ong shin tu nyams dga' ba'i/ /skyid pa'i pha yul gang nas yin/ /kho mo'i pha yul 'phyongs rgyas zhes/ /mtho sgang bu mo'i rgyan gcig pu/ /mdzes ldan zla ba sgrol ma mchog /de nyid 'khrungs sa'i yul nas yin/ /pha mas btags pa'i 'dod rgyal ming / /lha mo zhes su brjod na yang / /phyis su rjes grub rgyu mtshan gyis/ /154

dga' tshal lha mo zhes su 'bod/ /ye ma kha sang ngo mtshar med/ /rab yangs nam mkha'i klong dkyil nas/ /chu 'dzin me rtag sil ma 'thor/ /yangs pa'i sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor la/ / rtswa ljang myu gus mdzes par bklubs/ /ljon shing rma bya'i dbu gdugs dang / /smug sprin mjal dar lhab lhub g.yo/ /byi'u chung 'jol mos rdza rnga brdungs/ /ri dwags gzhon nus zlos gar 'khrab/ /khu byug sngon mos shis pa brjod/ /rten 'brel me tog gang sar bshad/ /dwangs gtsang dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i/ /yid 'ong dga' tshal sdum ra'i nang / /ngo mjal byung ba'i nged gnyis po'i/ /sngon bsags legs byas bgo skal las/ /gnyen ston cho ga 'byed pa'i slad/ /sems med rang byung khor yug dang / /sems yod bya dang ri dwags rnams/ /dga' bas ma gros gcig mthun gyis/ /gnyen sgrig dga' ston 'gyed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa'i 'phrin lan sbrang rtsi'i ros/ /155
