lha sras yid kyi gser sbrang myos/ /brtse dung mig zung skem skem g.yo/ /mdza' gcugs gzhog zung rab btegs nas/ /dga' ma'i bzhin gyi pad mo yi/ /mchu sgros ge sar gzhib dang lhan/ / snyan 'jebs rna ba'i gling bu ste/ /snying gtam dar dir sgrogs par 'dod/ /nyin zhig lha sras gzhen nu brtse ldan des/ /rang gi snying grogs dga' tshal lha mo'i drung / /brtse 'phrin yid kyi pho nya bya ma rta/ /grogs mchog bstan 'dzin brgyud de 'di ltar springs/ /ka ye lan cig gson dang / /mdza' mo dga' tshal lha mo/ /kha bshad mgo skor min pa'i/ /drang gtam 'ga' zhig zhu 'o/ /ga sar mtshan ngan khyab rung / /brtse dung ched du mi 'gyod/ /nga yi mtshan dang snyan grags/ /mi kha'i rlung por bskur chog /ca co'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i/ /g.yu mtsho nga yi pha yul/ /cha lugs mthun pa'i rang ming / /156

g.yu mtsho'i lho sraso 'bod do/ /ja chang rgyas spras dan du/ /nged gnyis ngo shes mi sgrig /nya chu'i brtse dung lta bu/ /thob pa'i ched du yin no/ /ta la'i 'dab ma lta bu'i/ /rnam dbyod yangs pa khyed dang / /tha tshig dam bca' bzhag nas/ /'bral med gtan grogs zhus chog /da bar khyed las gzhan pa'i/ /brtse ba'i grogs kyang med la/ /na rgas ma shi'i bar du/ /'tshol 'dod blo la'ang mi 'dug /pa pha yab chen rgyal por/ /bka' 'khrol gnang ba zhus te/ /pha lam lta bu'i grogs khyed/ /nam yang kho bo'i snying nor/ /ba lu'i me tog 'dra ba'i/ /lhad med brtse sems me tog /ma lus yod tshad thams cad/ /khyed kyi phyag tu phul yod/ /tsa ri'i smyug ma 'dra bar/ /157

rang gshis drang po'i sgo nas/ /tsha grang mnyam myong grogs la/ /sba gsang med par zhus yod/ /dza dzor bral ba'i brtse sems/ /kho bor gnang gi yod na/ /wa ler snying la bcangs te/ /mig ltar gces spras byed nges/ /zha nye'i bsres lhad med pa'i/ /lhad med dngul dkar la rgya/ /za zi'i dri ma bral ba'i/ /shel dkar me long dngos red/ /'a cag mnyam du gshib skal/ /da lta dngos su med kyang / /ya mtshan che ba'i nyin zhig /khyim tshang gcig nang 'dzoms nges/ /ra sprod bden dpang thub pa'i/ /brtse 'phrin yid kyi pho nya/ /la rgya bcangs te bskur bso/ /gzhan la gsang ba gnang rags/ /sha tsha snying nas yod med/ /kho bos dpog par dka' yang / /sa rub mun pa'i nang du/ /158

brtse dung mda' mo 'phangs song / /ha ha gang dran rtsom 'dis/ / snying gtam mtshon khul yin yang / /a tsi go 'dzol byung tshe/ /brtse grogs dgongs pa ma 'tshom /brtse dung me lce spar te/ / mig gi mchod chang btsos yod/ /khyed kyis gtsang mchod gnang ste/ /rus par 'thims par gnang rogs/ /zhes pa'i sems 'phrin khu byug sngon mo des/ /lha sras sor mo'i ljon shing rtse mo nas/ /brtse dung drug 'gyur glu dbyangs sgrogs pa'i tshe /de yi yid la dga' bde'i dbyid dpal ba'ad/ /gcig sems gcig la chags pa'i gzhon nu gnyis/ /phan tshun lhad med brtse sems ldan pas na/ /mtshan mo rang rang rmi lam nang du yang / /'bral med mnyam du 'grogs pa yang yang rmis/ /slob khang shes bya'i skyed tshal yangs pa mā /shes bya'i 'bras bus rnam dpyod rgyas dang lhan/ /dwangs gtsang lhad med sems kyi 'jig rten du/ /med byung brtse dung gser gyi myu gu zhagrungs/ /res gza' nyi ma'i snga dro zhig /159

g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhen nu des/ /mdzangs ma dga' tshal lha mo la/ /de ring nged gnyis dga' spro'i ngang / /yar klung gtsang po'i gling phran du/ /ngo mtshar rang byung khor yug dang / /yar klung gtsang po'i mdzes ljongs la/ /spro 'cham ltad mor phebs na smras/ /de mur dga' tshal lha mo yis/ /'thad pa'i mgo bo dud dang lhan/ /'dzum pa'i ge sar rab bzhad de/ /khyed kyis 'khrid na los 'gro zhes/ /dga' ba'i nyams dang bcas te smras/ /dri bsung 'thul ba'i shing 'bras dang / /ro mchog ldan pa'i bya rnams/ /mdzes pa'i dpe khug nang bsdog ste/ /lha sras gzhan nus rgyab tu 'bur/ /bcu drug lang tshos rab sgeg pa'i/ /mdzes ma dga' tshal lha mo yis/ /myos pa'i mig 'phrul g.yo bzhin du/ /'jam mnyen lag po g.yas pa de/ /lha sras lag pa g.yan ma la/ /'chang zhing gtsang po'i phyogs su bskyod/ /160

dkar dkar gangs ri'i lang tsho rab bzhus ba'i/ /chil chil rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i gtsang 'gram du/ /ldem ldem g.yu yi ldon pa'i gdugs kyi 'og /brtse brtse gzhen nu pho mo zung gnyis zhugs/ /bag yangs dben zhing nyams dga'i gling phran 'di/ /lhad med brtse dung myu gu rab bshad pa'i/ /pho mo'i snying gtam smra ba'i dga' tshal du/ /'jig rten byed pos ched du bskrun pa dngos/ /gser zhun mdog can brtse ldan ngang ser zung / /med byung shel ltar dwangs pa'i gtsang po'i nang / /'bral med brtse dung dpal la rol ba 'dis/ /gzhon nu gnyis por ched du bskul ba bzhin/ /de nas lha sras yid kyi rgya mtsho'i nang / /brtse dung rba rlabs drag tu 'phyo bas na/ /dgyesapa'i bzhin ras mdza' mor macan phyogs nas/ /ma bcos snyan rtsom rgyud mangs 'di ltar dkrol/ /bsregs bcad mi 'gyur rin chen gser gyi lus/ /dwangs gtsang brtse dung pha lam phra rgyan can/ /brtse sems nor bus phyug pa'i ngang ser la/ /kho bo snying gi dbus nas yid smon 'chor/ /zhes pa'i snyan rtsom rna bas thos ma thag /dga' tshal lha mos de mur 'di ltar smras/ /161

srid 'dir bde ba'i 'byung gnas brtse sems mchog /rang la thab par 'dad na rnam kun tu/ /smin legs me bya'i bu mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /khog pa'i snying ltar gces nas brtse bas skyongs/ /lha sras mig zung nyi mar gzigs dang lhan/ /mdza' mor gzigs te snyan pa'i dbyangasadang bcas/ /nyi ma'i 'od sogs bkrag mdangs 'tsher na yang / /dbang du mi 'gyur mdzes ldan kun da nga / /bsil zer dwangasagatsang nya gang khyed mjal dus/ /lus zungs brtas shing brtse dung zhal kha 'byed/ /de nas dga' tshal lha mos gtsang po'i nang / /ci dgar rgyu ba'i gser nyar lta bzhin du/ /dri med dwangs gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /gser gyi mig can kho mo 'chag pa'i khyim/ /nged gnyis dbar la dbyen 'byed rkyen mang yang / /nyal 'gros brtse bsami 'dor mkhyen zhes bskul/ /lha sras gzhon nur sems 'gul cher thebs pas/ /shel brag ri bor phyag 'dzub gtad dang lhan/ /khyed kyi brtse dung yangs shing brtan pa'i sa/ /kho bo'i brtse dung mi 'gyur rdo rje'i brag /thog dang ser ba ji tsam rgod na yang / /bskal pa'i mthar yang 'jig par mi nus gsungs/ /162

dga' tshal lha mo'i dwangs gtsang sems kyi mkhar/ /brtse dung glog sprin drag tu 'phyur bas na/ /kho mor 'dzad med bde skyid kun 'byung gzhi/ /brtse ldan lha sras gzhon nu khyed kyi ched/ / gces pa'i sgyu lus dum bu brgyar gtong ngam/ /me 'bar lcags kyang za bar spobs zhes smras/ /g.yu mtsho'i sras kyis drod 'jam phang ba mā /dga' tshal lha mo bstabs te 'di ltar gleng / /mdzes sdug yid 'ong 'jo sgeg nu 'bur can/ /nya yi dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs 'dzum zhal mdangs/ /ri dwags mig can khyed kyi zur mig gis/ /bdag yid rab dga' brtse dung gter sgo bzhad/ /dga' tshal lha mos rang gi mgo bo de/ /g.yu mtsho'i sras kyi brang la glan bzhin du/ /kho mo'i lang tsho gsar pa'i skyed tshal nang / /bzhad pa'i brtse dung ge sar bdud rtsi'i ro/ /thog mar gzhib mkhan rkang drug khyed nyid kyis/ /snying gtam dar dir lhug por sgrogs shig gsungs/ /lha sras gzhon nu'i yid 'ong pad+ma'i mchu/ /lha mo'i rna bar sbyar te shub bu'i ngang / /dkar zlum brla yi rlabs phreng drag tu g.yo/ /nu 'bur ngang pa'i rgyal po dal bur rgyu/ /163

khyed sku 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong / /kho bos rkyen rtsal ngom par nam zhig 'gyur/ /zhe+os par lha mo skyengs te ba sbu+o g.yos/ /'an kyang dpal mdangs mchag tu rgyas pas na/ /khyed zhal drod 'jam nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag sems pad+ma'i tsharme yang chags pas g.yos/ /lang tsho'i dwangs ma brtse dung ze 'bru sogs/ /gser sbrang khyed la 'bul lo dga' bder spyod/ /ces gsungs gnyis ka mdza' bas rab myosate/ /mnyam du rtse gcig smon lam 'di ltar btab/ /drod gsher ldan pa lus kyi zhing sa la/ /dwangs gtsang lhad med brtse dung sdong po zhabrungs/ /de steng gser bya ngang pa brtse ldan zung / /dus dang rnam kun 'bral med smon 'dun zhu/ /zhes pa'i snyan rtsom smra ba dang / /snying gtam lhug por shod pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar rtse 'jor g.yengs pas na/ /tshor med ngang nas rta ljang de/ /chu lha'i phang bar gzim nye bas/ /nyin de'i spro 'cham dga' ston yang / /rdzogs po'i mtha' la shin tu nye/ /'bral kha'i brtse sems me lce yis/ /164

de gnyis lus sems kun bsregs shing / /'dod pa'i skom gyis gdung bas na/ /shing bzang sbyar sdong dkar po'i 'og /dwangs gtsang sku lus gser bum gyi/ /mgul nas lag zung gis bskul te/ /mchu yi 'bras chang bzhibs ma thag /bzi bas lus sems 'dar bzhin du/ /gnyis ka smra bsam brjod 'das kyi/ /bde ba'i dpal gyis rab tu brgyal/ /de tshe shin tu mdza' ba'i ngang ser zung yang yid smon 'chor te yang yang phyi mig lta bar byed/ /chu mo'i gting du rgyu ba'i gser mig can yang yid dbang g.yos te dga' bas 'phar mchongs drag tu ldings/ /dgong dro'i mtshams sprin sgeg mo de yang skyengs pa'i zol gyis ngo gdong pad+ma ra ga'i mdog ltar gyur/ /rkang 'thung gzhon nu'i tshogs kyang dga' ba'i rlung gis bskul te phan tshun brtse ba'i lag gdang sbrel bzhin mchis/ /mim naba'i de chagaci chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i brtse sems sbrang char gyis/ /rkang 'thung sgeg mo'i lus sems brlan na yang / /mgyogs myur ston gyi ba mos gtses dwogs pas/ /zim bu'i chu thigs mig chu lhung lhung bzhur/ /yid 'ong grogs mchog dbyar gyi dpal mo dang / /165

bral ba'i zug rngur lus sems rab gdung pas/ /spu sdug mdzes pa'i dpyid kyi rgyal mo yang / /snyan 'jebs glu dbyangs smra ba'i mgrin pa nyams/ /mtho rim slob 'bring shes bya'i skyed tshal nang / /shes yon brtse dung myu gu rab bzhad pa'i/ /g.yu mtsho'i sras dang dga' tshal lha mo yang / /tshe sngon las kyis 'bral kha'i dus la slebs/ /snying gi dbus su skyo gdung slong byed pa'i/ /cong brda'i sgra yis bskul te dge slob kun/ /dga' skyo 'dres ma'i tshor bas myos bzhin du/ /slob 'bring mthar phyin dgong tshogs mnyam du rol/ /rgyun du slob thon bde skyid bsam na yang / /slob thon dgong tshogs skabs 'dir shin tu skyo/ /dran rten 'dra par 'bral kha'i sems 'phrin sogs/ /kun kyang skyo gdung slong ba'i grogs su gyur/ /'on kyang 'dus bral dngos po'i chos nyid la/ /mdza' sems che yang bya thabs ma mchis pas/ /skyo ba'i dbyangs kyi glu gshas len pa dang / /lhad med smon 'dun zhu ba sems kyi sman/ /dar dkar la rgya'i zhags pas rab bcings pa'i/ /snying nas mdza' ba'i brtse ldan slob grogs rnams/ /sang nyin bral ba'i gdung ba ma bzod pas/ /166

do+o dgong mtshan gang dga' spros 'da' bar byas/ /slab grags la las kha par ang grangs ba'ag /slob grogs 'ga' yis 'dra par sprod pa sogs/ /mdor na brtse sems stug po'i mtshan tshogs 'di/ /nam 'tsho'i bar du gtan nas brjed thabs bral/ /phyi nyin chu tshod dang po'i skabs/ /g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhon nu dang / /mdza' mo dga' tshal lha mo gnyis/ /ro brgya'i dri bsung legs 'thul zhing / /lhing 'jags dben pa'i za khang ste/ /'char dus dga' 'dzoms za khang nang / /kha zas yi gar med na yang / /'bral kha'i gsol ston rol bzhin mchis/ /bral nad dus mtha'i rlung chen gyis/ /yid kyi ljon shing rab g.yos pas/ /skyo gdung 'dres ma'i gsol ston yang / /skyo ba'i ngang nas myur du grol/ /lus dang grib ma'i ngang tshul yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /skad cig 'bral bar mi phod slob ma gnyis/ / 'jam mnyen lag zung dam por sbrel bzhin du/ /slob grwa'i rgyab kyi dben pa'i gling khar bskyod/ /brtse ldan gzhon nu gnyis po yi/ /167

mdza' gcugs mar khu'i rgya mtsho'i klong / /bral gdung me lce rab 'bar te/ /brtse sems gangs ri bzhur gyur pa'i/ /dwangs gtsang mchi ma nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i gsos su babs/ /lhad med gzhon nu 'di gnyis po'i/ /lhad med brtse dung dpang po ste/ /lhad med sbyar sdong dkar po'i 'og /lhad med dam bca' 'di ltar bzhag /gcig sems gcig la chags pa'i brtse dung la/ /brten nas nged gnyis slob chen mnyam du 'grim/ /slob chen slob thon lag khyer thob ma thag /gnyen ston dbye rgyu'i 'gyur med g.yar dam bcas/ /med byung lang tshos rab sgeg cing / /med byung shes yon mtshungs zla bral/ /rmad byung snying gi mdza' na mo/ /med byung dga' tshal lha mo des/ /khyed thugs gangs dkar lhun po las/ /bzhur ba'i brtse sems chab rgyun gyi/ /dbus su 'tsho ba'i gser nya nga / /nam 'tsho'i bar du 'bral med skyongs/ /khyed dang bral na kho mo la/ /168

bde skyid til tsam ma mchis kyang / /drin pha ma lja/na mched rnams/ /mjal phyir kho mo rang yul du/ /thengs 'dir mi 'gro ka med lags/ /khyed nyid rang yul phebs ma thag /gdung bas mnar ba'i kho mo la/ /dga' 'bod mtshon pa'i zhal par dang / /gdung sems mtshon pa'i sems 'phrin sogs/ /chu mo'i rgyun bzhin bskur bar 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i snying gtam smra ba'i skabs/ /skyo snang shin tu ma bzod pas/ /mkhur tshos mchi mas brlan bzhin du/ /gzhon nu'i gdong la lta bzhin gnas/ /lha mo bral gdung than pa yis/ /lha sras yid kyi rtswa thang bskams/ /skyo snang dgun gyi rlung po des/ /sems kyi nam mkhar rdul gyis g.yogs/ /mthong bas mig las bdud rtsi dang / /gshibs pas yid kyi thig le mchog /bu nga'i sems kyi kha lo ba/ /yid 'ong ma khyed gsan par rigs/ /kho bos nyin mtshan dus kun bsam/ /169

bsam rgyu khyed dang dran rgyu khyed/ /khyed ni nga yi khog pa'i snying / /snying dang bral bas kho bo yang / /yang yang bzod dka'i gdung bas mnar/ /mnar gcod sems kyi zug rngu de/ /de ring kho bor phog pas na/ /na gzhon nga yi sems khong na/ /na chung ma khyed brjed thabs bral/ /bral khar smras pa'i snying gi gtam/ /gtam 'di snying dbus gzung bar 'tshal/ /zhes smras lhad med sems kyi rten/ /gnam lcags rdo rje chung ngu zhig /rang gi ske nas myur bar bkrol/ /dga' tshal lha mo'i mgul du bsgron/ /brtse sems rdo rje'i lhun po las/ /brtan pa'i smon 'dun lan gsum zhus/ /gdung ldan dga' tshal lha mo dang / / mi phod bzhin du zhal gyes zhus/ /gzhon nu gnyis po'i mig gi mkha' la sprin phung med kyang mchi ma'i sbrang char sim sim babs/ /mdza' ba'i yid la bud shing med kyang 'bral kha'i skyo gdung me lce dmar po drag tu 'bar/ /yid 'ong mgrin par glog zhags med kyang shin tu skyo ba'i smre ngag 'brug sgra phyogs bcur ldir/ /dwangs gtsang sems ni gzugs can min yang gdung bas bcings pa'i gzhon nu 170

gnyis por snying re rje/ /de nas snum nag lam steng myur mgyogs bya ltar 'phur ba'i 'phrul 'khor nang / /pha yul gcig pa'i slob grogs rnams dang rang yulwa phyogs su bskyod pa'i skabs/ /brjed par dka' ba'i mtshan tshogs de dang la rgya mthun pa'i dge slob dang / /snying grogs gang de'i sku brnyan dran shes ngos su 'char bas yang yang skyo/ /lha sras la klung du ma brgal ba'i mthar rang yul g.yu mtsho'i grong du gzhi nas 'byor/ /brtse ldan skyed ma'i bzhin ras mjal ba'i tshe/ /'dren byed zung gi lteng ka dbang med brdol/ /m+mu byung yid 'ong galko nu'i lang tsho dang / /rnam dpyod blo gros lhan du rgyas gyur pas/ /g.yu mtsho'i tsha bo a ma'i gces phrug der/ /skye bo kun gyi smon bya'i yul du gyur/ /lha sras rang gi yul du 'byor ba'i rjes/ /snying grogs lha mo shin tu dran gyur pas/ /mtshams 'dri'i zhal par dran sems mtshon pa'i gtam/ /thengs mang phul yang len mkhan gtan nas med/ /g.yu mtsho'i sras kyi kun rtog mtsho mo'i klong / /nga dang khong gi lhad med brtse dung la/ /mi brtan g.yo 'gul thebs pa mi srid kyang / /gang gis rkyen nam snyam ste thugs sems 'tshab/ /lha sras thugs la lha mo dran bzhin du/ /g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du gcig pur 'gro ba'i skabs/ /171

snying gi mdza' mo slar yang dran byed pa'i/ /bral gdung slong ba'i gsal 'debs 'di ltar mthong / /sngo bsangs mdangs 'dzin yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i klong / /mdza' gcig rtse dgas myosapa'i ngang ser zung / /brtse dung gshog rtsal bom nas ci dga' r+sā/'bral med mnyam du rol 'di ye ma med/ /tshul 'di mthong bas snying gi mdza' mo mchog /dga' tshal lha mo shin tu dran drag pas/ /rab dkar pha bong zhig la stegs byasate/ /dran sems yid kyi pho nya 'di ltar bris/ /dkar 'jam yid 'ong shog bu'i ngos yangs 'dir/ /dkar dkar lhad med la rgya mtshon pa'i ched/ /dkar mdzes lhag bsam dkar po'i brtse 'phrin 'di/ /dkar gtsang brtse grogs khyed kyis gsan par rigs/ /phan tshun zhal mjal med pa'i nyin shas ring / /brtse ldan khyed kyi pad+ma'i sku lus la/ /mi 'dod 'byung bzhi'i nyer 'tshes ma 'gos par/ /mdza' ba'i dri bsung 'thul bar bzhugs yod dam/ /zol med brtse dung zhags pas rab bcings pa'i/ /brtse ba'i grogs mchog snying gi mdza' mo khyed/ /nyin mtshan kun tu yang yang dran na yang / /mjal 'dzom med pa'i sdug gis bdag yid skyo/ /172

tshe sngon legs byas bzang po'i 'bras bzang las/ /tshe 'dir ngo mjal byung ba'i grogs khyed dang / /mjal nas mi 'dod bzhin du bral dgos na/ /bral nas 'dzom pa'i stes dbang los kyang yod/ /la klung sa thag ring pos chod gyur pas/ /khyed phyogs mig gi lam du mjal dka' yang / / bdag sems ma bcos dngul dkar me long nang / /khyed kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba su yis 'gog /dran gdung me lce 'bar ba'i thab khung nang / / rlan gsher mdza' gcugs mar khu blugs pas na/ /slar yang brtse dung me lte rab 'bar te/ /bu nga'i glo snying brang gsum dbang med bsregs/ /mya ngan mun pa'i khrod kyi kun da ngas/ /khyed zhal ston zla'i bdud rtsi 'thung snyam yang / /dran pa'i tsha gdung zhi ba'i bsil zer gyis/ /phongs pa'i las dbang 'di ni ci zhig yin/ /zhes pa'i snyan rtsom smra ba'i tshe/ /dkar 'jam shog bu'i zhing sa'i steng / /mchi ma'i gru char babs pas na/ /yig 'byu 'ga' zhig 'dres par byas/ /de nas khyar khyor gom bgrod la/ /brten nas rtswa thang yongs gzhal te/ /173

sa rub mun pa 'thibs pa'i mtshams/ /da gzod khyim gyi nang du 'byor/ / rang byung dga' tshal g.yu yi rtswathang steng / /rang re'i gces nor dkar nag phyugs rigs khrod/ /rang sems bral nad gcong gis mnar bzhin du/ /rang gi yul du nyin zhag sum cu 'das/ /skyo snang bzod par dka' ba'i nyin mo zhig /tir tir zhes pa'i srin bya'i than skad des/ /lha sras snying gi bde skyid 'ja' ltarayal/ /de ni lha mo'i grogs mo gcig pu ste/ /'tshams gcod dbang mos btang ba'i kha par red/ /dbang mos ngu ngag 'dres mar bshad don du/ /khyed kyi snying gi cha shas gyur pa'i grogs/ /nyam chung dga' tshal lha mor pho skran gyi/ /na tsha phog ste mi dmangs sman khang nang / /mal khri bzhi pa'i steng du lus 'dug pas/ /phrad 'dod yod na myur bar shog ces smras/ /than 'phrin smre ngag 'brug sgra yis/ /'phangs pa'i mya ngan gnam lcags mda'/ /lha sras snying la phog ma thag /'jig rten 'di yang mun par byas/ /sdug bsngal me lces de yid kun bsregs pas/ /174

rtag tu mya ga drag po'i kha zas dang / /skyo gdung mchi ma'i gas bas dus 'da' bzhin/ /smra bcad dgun gyi khu byug bzhin du gyur/ /de ltar lha sras mya ngan gyi/ /mun pa'i khung bur lhung ba'i tshe/ /skyed ma thugs kyis ma bzod pas/ /gces phrug khyed kyi lus semasal/ /nad dang sems gcong ma phog gam/ /zhes pa 'jam po'i gsung gis dris/ /'on kyang ngo tsha 'jigs gnong gis/ /drang por zhu bar ma spobs pas/ /kho bo slob grwa'i gtan 'bebs ltar/ /'dzin grwa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig dang / /mnyam du srong btsan bang so la/ /zhib 'jug bya phyir 'gro dgos pas/ /skyed mas cis kyang gtong bar zhu/ /zhes pa'i 'u thug rdzun gtam zhig / thengs 'dir mi shod ka med gyur/ /de rjes lha sras sems kyi nang / /lha mo 'phrad par 'gro ba la/ /bang sor blta bar 'gro bo zhes/ /rnam rtog slong ba'i rdzun gtam 'di/ /175

bshad par rnam rtog cung zad skyes/ /phyi nyin zhogs pa shar ri'i spo nas nyi gzhon dal bur 'char ba'i skabs/ /mya ngan dngangs skrag bral gdung drag pos rus pa tshos pa'i bu chung de/ /du zhag lang long 'byur bzhin khug sna'i khrod kyi g.yu mtsho'i grong tsho dang / / zhal gyes zhus te brtse dung ched du kher rkyang ngang nas lam bur chas/ /bya ltar 'phur ba'i rlangs 'khor dal snang dang / /rtsed thang grong khyer gnam mthar yod snang 'char/ /lhag tu mdang gi rmi ltas ngan pa de/ /bsam tshe lus sems 'dar zhing ba spu gzengs/ /'phrul 'bor nang du yun ring bskyod pa'i mthar/ /rtsed thang grong khyer dbus su gzhi nas 'byor/ /de mur babs te 'phur ma mchongs dang bcas/ /mi dmangs sman khang phyogs su myur bar rgyugs/ /dkar gtsang dar gyi gos dkar 'chang ba'i lha rje rnams/ /brel bas khengs shing nyen brda'i glog dmar drag tu g.yo/ /mal khri bzhi pa'i mtha' ru ngu ba'i smre ngag de/ /lha sras snying dmar 'don pa'i dug gi lcags kyur gyur/ /lha mo zhes pa'i smre ngag 'byin gzhin lha sras re zhig brgyal la khad/ /gos dkar 'chang ba'i sman pa zhig gis khong gnyis phrad du bcug pas na/ /gdung sems chen pos lha mor 'chang ste kho bo slebs yod ces smras pas/ /dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'chad kha'i lha mos mig chu 'byin zhing 'dzum mdangs bshad/ /gnad gcod ser ba'i rdung rdeg dang / /176

pho skran zug rngu'i ba mo yis/ /gtses pa'i lha mo'i snying khongs na/ /lhad med brtse sems me tog steng / /mdza' gcugs yid kyi bung ba des/ / bsran par dka' yanga.u tshugs kyis/ /mchu sgros 'dab ma'i bar gseng nas/ /'dzer 'dzer skad khing chung ngu'i sgras/ /lha sras ming nas 'bod bawo du/ /'chi bdag rma pos dbang med 'byer/ /kye ma bsod dman lha sras gang der snying re rje/ /kye o ces pa'i smre ngag 'don bzhin brtse grogs kyi/ /mgul du g.yu 'byug ji basmi 'byud de brgyal bas na/ /der yod kun kyang 'dren byed lteng ka dbang med brdol/ /1sde kha 'phubasakye rma brtse ldan snying gi tshi lu 'phyongs rgyas kyi/ /dman chung khyed kyis kho bo dor te gang du byon/ /khyed dang bral ba'i skyo gdung snying nas mi bzod pas/ /brtse bas dgongs te 'dzum zhal lan gcig gzigs par zhu/ /snyan pa'i glu yang smre ngag nyid du thos/ /snyo tsho zas la bro ba til tsam dben/ / 77

'jig rten 'di yang nag khung nyid mthong bas/ /khyed dang bral na kun la snying po ci/ /dal rten gser las dkon par gragasan yang / /khyed dang mjal ba'i skal ba yod gyur na/ /kho bos mchil ma'i thal ba ltar bor nas/ /the tshom med par khyed kyi rjes su 'ong / /kho bo'i snying grogs lha mo khyed gson dang / /de ring khyed kyi phung po'i sku mdun 'dir/ /bsod dman nga yis dam bca' 'di ltar 'jog /khyed ni kho bo'i dpral ba'i mig zung dang / /srog gi cha shas khog pa'i snying yin pas/ /khyed las gzhan pa'i bu mo su yin kyang / /mtshan mo rmi lam nang du'ang mi 'dod pas/ /khyed kyi rjes su tshe srog 'dor ba dang / /khyed kyi ched du lha chos byed rgyu las/ /gzhan pa'i blo med mkhyen nam snying grogs lags/ /de ltar lha sras mya ngan gyis sdongs pas/ /rang gi dam bca' snying khong sba bzhin du/ /kho bo slob grwa'i rgyab kyi gling kha'i nang / /nga dang khong gi bla shing sbyar sdong der/ /lta tsam byas te myur du 'ong smras shing / /mtshams gcod dbang mo lha mo'i skyed ma dang / /178

zhal gyes zhus te sman khang nang nas don/ /mya ngan me ltes snying khams bsregs dang lhan/ /skyo ba'i mchi mas nor 'dzin brlan bzhin du/ /gcig pu'i ngang nas kyag kyog lam brgyud de/ /slob grwa'i rgyab kyi gling khar dal bur bskyod/ /de tshe ldon pa'i tshogs rnams mya ngan tshul du mgo bo dud/ /dwangs gtsang rdzing bu de yang bral gdung than pas rab tu bskams/ /lhad med mdza' sems dpang po sbyar sdong dkar po mthong ba'i tshe/ /sngar gyi 'das don mtha' dag mig lam gsal bar snang bas na/ /snying gi dbus su 'char ba'i bzod dka'i tshor snang stong lhang lhang / /brtse bral gshin rje'i pho nya sgra gcan gyis/ /brtse ldan snying grogs dung zla zin pas na/ /brtse dung srog las gces pa'i lhasras de/ /brtse dung ched du rang srog 'dor bar rtsom/ /sdug bsngal tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /mya ngan dbang gis skya bo'i kha dog can/ /drang por gnas pa'i sbyar sdong khyed nyid dang / /grogs dang bral ba'i kher rkyang nga nyid mtshungs/ /de sngon drang srong sbyar sdong khyed kyi 'og /nga dang nga yi brtse grogs dam pa des/ /nam yang 'bral med dam bca' bzhag na yang / /de ring kho bo'i nyam thag las dbang 'dir/ /179

sbyar sdong khyed kyang snying rje mi skye 'am/ /kye ma nga yi gnyen gcig sbyar sdong lags/ /khyed rang mjal dus snying gi thig le mchog /brtse grogs dam pa gang de dran drag rkyen/ /yun ring bsnad na kho bo spyo nges pas /de las rang sgog dor te bar do mā /khong dang mardzal phyir 'gro ba mi legs sam/ /zhes smras skyo ba'i ngu 'bod drag tu 'then/ /'dren byed mchi mas gang ste dbugs ring phyung / /gdung ldan gnyis po'i lhad med mdza' sems kyi/ /dpang por gyur pa'i sbyar sdong yal ga la/ /lha mos gnang ba'i sems rten kha dkris de/ /myur bar bkon te lha mo'i rjes su lceb/ /de mur rgyab nas ca co drag tu 'byin/ /mtshams gcod dbang mo lha mo'i skyed ma gnyis/ /myur bar rgyugs te g.yu mtsho'i lha srasakyi/ /ske yi kha dkris de ma thag tu bkrol/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal da lta'i dngangs skrag gis/ /smra ba'i spobs pa bral te re zhig lus/ /de nas byams ldan bgres song skyed ma des/ /mya ngan dang bcas smra sgo 'di ltar phye/ /gshis gzang khrel gzhung ldan pa'i gzhon nu khyed/ /180

khyed kyis bsod dman nga yi bu mo la/ /la rgya brtse dung bcangs pa legs na yang / /yang sgos rang srog rang gis lceb pa yi/ /yi mug bya ba 'di 'dra spel mi drang / /lhag par bdag gi bu mo gcig pu de'i/ /sems nang bsam rgyu khyed las mi 'dug pas/ /da lta dur khung nang nas khyed nyid la/ /nyin mtshan kun tu blta bar nges pas na/ /khyed kyis 'di ltar sdug bsngal byas gyur na/ /bu mo'i snying dmar ral gris gtub pa dang / /masas pas bu rang snying stobs cher bskyed de/ /phyin chad 'di 'dra nam yang ma byed cig /ces pa'i bslab bya bskyon te lha sras la/ / byams brtse po'i dro skyid gnang bas na/ /lha sras gzhen nus gdung sems chen po'i ngang / /a mar 'bod de ma gcig bu gcig ltar/ /shin tu mdza' ba'i ngang tshul yongs su 'dzin/ /de rjes mtshams gcod dbang mos gsang ba'i ngang / /'di ni lha mo sman khang lus pa'i skabs/ /khyed la phul ba'i mtha' ma'i lag rtags lags/ /zhes smras mig la chu zhag 'khor bzhin du/ /phyi shog dmar pos g.yog pa'i 'bri deb gcig /181

g.yu mtsho'i sras kyi lag tu dal bur bzhag / de ni rang gi snying grogs lha mo mchog /slob 'bring skabs kyi brjed dka'i 'das don dang / /khong gnyis dbar gyi lhad med brtse sems kyi/ /gsang ba yod tshad bris pa'i nyin tho red/ /da dung lha mos nyin tho'i bar gseng du/ /kher chad bltabs pa'i shog ste zhig gi steng / /gang nyid 'jig rten phyi mar masakha'i skabs/ /khojibor gnang ba'i zhal chems 'di ltar 'dug /skyo snang me lces bde skyid chu mo bskams/ /bral nad gcong gis snying la zug ju sbyin/ /kho mo'i sems kyi sbrang char bsil ma khyed/ /da lta gang du yod dam kye ma skyo/ /bzod med pho skran nad kyisalus kun gzer/ /khyed dang bral ba'i tshor bas sems kun gdung / /mal khri dkar po'i steng gi nyam thag can/ /bsod dman nga yi 'phrin 'di brtse bas gson/ /sdug bsngal mun pa 'thibs pa'i mtshan mo 'dir/ /brtse grogs skar tshogs mnyam du 'dzomasan yang / /las dbang dman pa'i pa sangasaskar chen nga / /gcig pur bral dgosalas 'di bzlog med lags/ /gshis bzang lang tshos phyug pa'i brtse ldan khyed/ /182

tshe 'dir kho mo'i grogs su ma gyur kyang / /zol med brtse sems gser gyi pad+ma mchog /nyin mtshan dbyer med khyed kyi phyogs su 'bul/ /kho mor sngon nas bcos bral pho skran gyi/ /na tsha yod kyang khyed la zhu ma spobs/ /da res kho mo lus sems bral nges pas/ /khyed la bzod dka'i sdug bsngal bzhag par gnong / /'on kyang kho mo'i sems kyi lde mig mchog /khyed las gzhan pa su yang ma mchis pas /khyed kyis lhad med brtse sems gnang bas na/ /kho mo da lta 'chi yang 'gyod pa ci/ /lha sras khyed kyi sku drin gso ba'i ched/ /khyed kyi tshe 'di'i mi 'dod bar gcod dang / /nye bar 'tshe ba'i rkyen ga yod do cog /zhi ba'i ched du kho mo 'chi bar smon/ /g.yu mtsho'i nu zhos bskyangs pa'i pho gzhon lags/ /kho mo 'jig rten 'di nas bral ba'i rjes/ /nga yi ched du mya ngan mi mdzad par/ /snying stobs cher bskyed bho ṭa'i mi brgyud dang / /skad yig rig gzhung legs skyes 'bul ba'i ched/ /mtha' med shes bya'i rgya mtshor 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di ni snying gi re 'dun dang / /183

'chi kha'i kha chems gcig pu de yin pas/ /lha sras gzhon nus nges bar 5ba par mdzod/ / ces pa'i zhal chemasaskyo gdungapho nya der/ /spyan mig zung nas mchi ma'i bsu chang dang / /mya ngan bzod par dka' ba'i dar dkar gyis/ /sngon nas bsus te 'dren byed lam brgyud nas/ /snying dang bral ba'i brang gi khang stong nang / /sdug bsngal rba rlabs 'phyur ba'i dran shesamatshor/ /nam 'tsho'i bar du 'gyur ba med par zhugs/ /de nas lha sras pus mo sar btsugs te/ /rang gi stod gos tshal par dbral ba'i steng / /zungs khrag dmar pos lha mo zhesabris te/ /mdza' sems dpang po sbyar sdong dkar po'i steng / /spobs sems chen pos btags te de ring nas/ /brtse ldan snying grogs dga' tshal lha mo'i ched/ /rnam dag lha chos byed rgyu'i dam bca' bkod/ /lhad med brtse dung sra mkhregs thag pa yis/ /sdug bsngal ri bo phrag steng 'khur dang lhan/ /grogs dang bral ba'i yid chad myong bzhin du/ /kher rkyang ngang nas rang gi yul du bskyod/ /lam bar shin tu mtho ba'i ri bo dang / /tshang tshing lo 'dab stug po'i nags kyi klong / /184

rab yangs mu bral rtswa thang sogs kyi steng / /snying grogs dam pa gang de yod snang 'char/ /yang na gnam dang ri klung rgya mtsho'i mthar /tshe gcig rkang gnyis ngal ba la brten nas/ /lag zad dpung par thug kyang snying rus kyis/ /btsal tshe lha mo nam zhig rnyed srid snyam/ /'on kyang zhib mor blo yis brtag pa'i tshe/ /de rnams gtan nas 'grub thabs ma mchis pas/ /bsam blo'i lam bur zhugasate bskyod pa'i mthar/ /g.yu mtsho'i grong tsho mig gi lam du mngon/ /nyin de'i dgong mo brtse ldan yab yum la/ /rang dang lha mo'i dbar gyi gnas tshul kun/ /'khyog med drang po'i ngang nas zhus pa'i tshe/ /brtse ldan skyed ma'ang spyan chab dbang med bsil/ /da dung rang nyid lubor bar yido 'grang ste/ /rnam dag lha chas bsgrub par mas pas na/ /yab yum zung gis byams brtse cher dgongasate/ /kho bor dgongs 'khrol skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i tshe/ /mkhyen spyan byams brtse che ba'i skyed ma yis/ /khyed ni khyim 'di'i ma 'ongs bdag po dang / /nged gnyis rgan rgon zung gi brten sa yin/ /lhag tu bu rang slob grwar gtong ba'i don/ /185

bod kyi skad yig ched du ma yin nam/ /der brten bsam blo nan to gtong dgosagasungs/ /lha sras gzhen nus pus mo sar btsugasate/ /kho bo dga' tshal lha mo 'dasapa'i rjes/ /'khor ba'i bya bar chen pa log pa las/ /pha ma'i drin dang rang re'i skad yig don/ /nam yang sems kyi dbus nas ma brjed kyang / /deng skabs nga tsho'i slob grwa'i nang du yang / /bod yig slob tshan ha lam mi 'dug pas/ /gcig nas nga rang lha chosabyed rgyu dang / /gnyis nas bho ṭa'i skad yig kho na'i ched/ /dwangs gtsang ngur smig 'jig rten 'grim 'dod pas/ /bshad sgrub thos bsam gling gi dgon pa'i nang / /brtse ldan yab yum gnyis pos gtong rogs gnang / /zhes pa'i re smon snying nas yang yang zhus/ /de ltar lha sras dam bca' rab brtan pas/ /mkhyen spyan shin tu yangs pa'i pha masakyang / /rjes su lha chos byed rgyu'i mos mthun gnang / /nyin zhig g.yu mtsho'i lha sras gzhon nu des/ /rang gi brtse ba'i gcung mo chos skyid la/ /pha mar sri zhu kun dang mthun sgril dang / /ya rabs spyod bzang la sogs blang dor gyi/ /186

bslab bya bskyon te khyim nas dgon par bskyod/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs dug gi spu gri dang / /khams gsum 'khor ba me yi 'ob tu mthong / /skyo ba'i snang bas rtag tu dus 'da' ba'i/ /ya rabs khrel gzhung ldan pa'i lha sras des/ /gnag snum skra yi zur phud dga' bas dor/ /ngur smig cod pan spro ba'i blo yis blangs/ /zhi bde dwangs bsil so thar lam bur zhugs/ /sdom gsum tshul khrims srog las gces par 'dzin/ /'phags yul grub mtha' kha babs rnam bzhi las/ /legs par babs pa'i rig gzhung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'gal med gcig tu 'khyil ba'i chu gter klong / /rnam dpyod thos pa'i gru chung brtson pas bskyod/ /'gal 'brel gcod pa'i shes rab skya ba yis/ /rig gzhung rgya mtsho yang yang bsrubs pas na/ /ston dang bstan pa tshad ma nyid mthong bas/ /bsam pa'i sgro 'dogs rba klong rab tu zhi/ /mang du thos pa'i rin chen nor bu'i tshogs/ /phra zhib bsam pas rang bzhin rig byas te/ /kun kyang gdams par nyams len shes pa la/ /yang yang goms pas sgom gyi yang rtser gyur/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi rtsa ba ma rig dang / /187

nyes pa kun gyi 'byung rtsa bud med nyid/ /mthong bas sems dbus nyar ba'i sdug bsngal kun/ /nyi ma'i mdun gyi mun pa ji bzhin yal/ /thosapa'i nor bus dbul ba'i bla sprul dang / /brgya lor yi dam brtsi ba'i 'bul sdud mkhan/ /'dod yon dug mtshor rol ba'i ral can la/ /lha sras de nyid nam yang yi ga chud/ /ngan ngon 'tsho bas chog pa'i grwa rkyang dang / /slob la sdug rus can gyi mtshan nyid pa/ /gcig pur dben pa 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /lha sras de nyid snying nasayid smon skyes/ /rang gi rigs la 'khu ba'i wa skyes dang / /gzhan 'byor dpal la sdang ba'i dug can sbrul/ /ngo srung skad gnyisa'abyin pa'i ne+e tso rnams/ /lha sras de yi nam yang bshes ma yin/ /skad yig rig gzhung gces pa'i gzhen nu dang / /la rgya dam tshig gtsang ba'i lhad med grogs/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang ba'i skyes bu la/ /lha sras de yis 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis bsu/ /de ltar ngur smig 'chang ba'i lha sras des/ /de sngon rang gi 'das don bsam pa'i tshe/ /de nyid snyag pur khong dgod shor bawo du/ /188

de yi gzan sne rma gis g.yo ba'i ngang / /de mur dben pa'i lam bur rgyu bzhin mchis/ /mtha' med 'khor ba mya r+pā thang r+sā steng / /sdug bsngal gsum gyi tsha gdung gis gzir ba'i/ /gdung ldan gso nu gnyis po'i gto rgyud 'di/ /snyan ngag smra ba'i dpal la goms phyir sbyar/ /dge'o///tso spod/shā sprul thab spyordon /ji /zugam/khri srong slob gling slob thon dran rten du phul/mtshar mtshar bde skyid g.yang sas nyin mo 'dir/ /dung dung brtse ba'i grogs rnams lhan 'dzoms nas/ /skyid skyid dga' spros khengs pa'i skal bzang 'di/ /ring ring lo mang 'das kyang brjed thabs bral /snyan snyan grags pas nor 'dzin ma lus khyab/ /mthun mthun la rgya bu spun las kyang zab/ /mkhas mkhas blo gsar gzhon nus yongs gang ba'i/ /mtshar mtshar khri srong slob gling do zlas dben/ / 89

brdzid brdzid slob thon bkra shis rten 'brel nyin/ /dkar dkar mjal dar sgron dang chabs gcig tu/ /dmar dmar rab mdzes lag khyer sprod pa'i skabs/ /gsal gsal yid la brjod dka'i tshor snang sbyin/ /che che khri srong slob gling thon gyur pas/ /yang yang sems kyi gting nas dga' 'os kyang //mthun mthun snying nas brtse ba'i chos grogs dang / /rang rang bral ba'i tshul 'di cang bzod dam/ /gcig gcig pha yul gcig tu ma skyes shing / /dmar dmar sha khrag 'dres pa'i spun min yang / /brtse brtse dge slob kun dang bral ba'i tshe/ /skyo skyo 'dren byed lteng ka dbang med brdol/ /skyid skyid mi lo drug ni yud tsam 'das/ /ga bas ga bas mtha' bral dus la slebs gyur pas/ /zab zab la rgya ldan pa'i phu nu rnams/ /yang yang mjal ba'i smon 'dun snying nas zhu/ /dga' dga' skyo skyo slob thon rten 'brel skabs/ /190
